Berakhot 35b:6-12: Tanu rabbanan: "veasafta deganecha" ma talmud lomar? — lefi shenneemar: "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha" — yachol devarim kichtavan, talmud lomar: "veasafta deganecha" — haneheg bahen minhag derech eretz, divre rabbi yishmael.

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: efshar adam choresh bishat charisha, vezorea bishat zeria, vekotzer bishat ketzira, vedash bishat disha, vezore bishat haruach, tora ma tehe aleha? ella bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom — melachtan naaset al yede acherim, shenneemar: "veamdu zarim verau tzonchem vegomer", uvizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom — melachtan naaset al yede atzman, shenneemar: "veasafta deganecha". velo od ella shemmelechet acherim naaset al yadan, shenneemar: "veavadta et oyvecha vegomer".
Amar abbaye: harebe asu kerabbi yishmael, vealta beyadan. kerabbi shimon ben yochay, velo alta beyadan.
Amar lehu rava lerabbanan: bematuta minnayychu, beyome nisan uveyome tishre la titchazo kammay, ki hechi dela tittardu bimzonayychu kulla shatta.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: bo uree shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim. dorot harishonim asu toratan keva umelachtan aray, zo vazo nitkayyeyma beyadan. dorot haacharonim sheasu melachtan keva vetoratan aray, zo vazo lo nitkayyeyma beyadan.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: bo uree shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim. dorot harishonim hayu machnisin perotehen derech teraksemon kede lechayyeyvan bemaaser, dorot haacharonim machnisin perotehen derech gaggot, derech chatzerot, derech karpefot, kede lefotran min hammaaser. deamar rabbi yannay: en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser ad sheyyire pene habbayit, shenneemar: "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit".
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chatzer kovaat, shenneemar: "veachlu visharecha vesaveu".
Chullin 142a:3-9: Gemara tanya, rabbi yaakov omer: en lecha kol mitzva umitzva shebbattora shemmattan secharah betziddah, sheen techiyyayt hammetim teluya bah. bechibbud av vaem ketiv: "lemaan yaarichun yamecha ulemaan yitav lach", beshilluach hakken ketiv: "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim".

Hare sheamar lo aviv: ale labbira vehave li gozalot! veala, veshillach et haem velakach et habbanim, uvachazarato nafal vamet. hechan arichut yamav shel ze? vehechan tovato shel ze? ella "lemaan yaarichun yamecha" – beolam shekkullo aroch, "ulemaan yitav lach" – leolam shekkullo tov.
Vedilma la hava hachi? rabbi yaakov maase chaza! vedilma mehareher baavera hava? machshava raa en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase.
Vedilma mehareher baavoda zara hava, dichtiv: "lemaan tefos et bet yisrael belibbam", veamar rav acha bar yaakov: zo machshevet avoda zara.

Hachi kaamar: im ita deikka sechar mitzvot behay alma, tahane leh vetaggen aleh dela lete lide hirhur velittazzak, ella sechar mitzvot behay alma lekka. vehaamar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokim! bachazaratam shane.

Vehaamar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva enan nizzokim, lo bahalichatan velo bachazaratan! sullam raua hava, umakom dekavua hezzeka shane, dichtiv: "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani".

Amar rav yosef: ilmale darsheh acher lehay kera kerabbi yaakov bar beratte – la chata. may chaza? ikka deamri: ki hay maase chaza, veikka deamri: lishshana derabbi chutzepit hameturegman chaza, dahava muttelet baashpa. amar: pe shehefik margaliyyot yilchoch afar?! vehu la yada "lemaan yitav lecha" – beolam shekkullo tov, "ulemaan yaarichun yamecha" – beolam shekkullo aroch.
Gittin 64b:6-65a:2: Vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gittah. tanu rabbanan: ketanna hayyodaat lishmor et gittah – mitgareshet, vesheenah yodaat lishmor et gittah – enah mitgareshet. veezo hi ketanna yodaat lishmor et gittah? kol shemmeshammeret gittah vedavar acher.
May kaamar? amar rabbi yochanan, hachi kaamar: kol shemmeshammeret davar acher mechamat gittah.
Matkef la rav huna bar manoach: ha shota bealma hi! ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: kol shemmavchenet ben gittah ledavar acher.
Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi assi: tzeror vezorko, egoz venotlo – zoche leatzmo, veen zoche laacherim. chefetz – umachziro leachar shaa, zoche ben leatzmo uven laacherim.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: da veda achat hi. may "da veda achat hi"? amar rav chisda: echad ze veechad ze – zoche leatzmo, veen zoche laacherim.

Metiv rav chinnana vavrdan: ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy? manniach et hechavit, veomer: "hare zo lechol bene hammavoy", umezakke lahem al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim.
Hay shifcha – hechi dame? i deatya shete searot, may baaya gabbeh? ella lav dela atya shete searot, vekatane zocha laacherim?
Amar rav chisda: ishtik vavrdan. may hava leh lememar? kol detakkun rabbanan –
Veiddach – ki amrinan: kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayyta takkun – bemilleta deit la ikkar min hattora, aval milleta delet la ikkar min hattora – la.

Mishnah Eduyot 3:10-4:1:
Shelosha devarim rabban gamliel machmir kedivre vet shammay. en tomnin et hachammin miyyom tov leshabbat, veen zokfin et hammenora beyom tov, veen ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amar rabban gamliel, mimehen shel bet abba lo hayu ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amru lo, ma naase levet avicha shehayu machmirin al atzman umekillin al yisrael lihyot ofin pittin geritzin vachori: 
Af hu amar shelosha devarim lehakel. mechabbedin ben hammittot, umenichin et hammugmar beyom tov, veosim gedi mekullas belele fesachim. vachachamim osrim: 
Shelosha devarim rabbi elazar ben azarya mattir, vachachamim osrin. parato yotza virtzua shebben karneha, umekardin et habbehema beyom tov, veshochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahen. rabbi yehuda omer, en mekardin et habbehema beyom tov, mippene shehu ose chabbura, aval mekartzefin. vachachamim omrim, en mekardin af lo mekartzefin: 
Ellu devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. betza shennolda veyom tov, bet shammay omrim, teachel. uvet hillel omrim, lo teachel. bet shammay omrim, seor bechazzayit vechametz bechakkotevet. uvet hillel omrim, ze vaze bechazzayit:
Mishnah Eduyot 4:11-5:2:
Mi shennadar nezirut merubba vehishlim neziruto veachar kach ba laaretz, bet shammay omrim, nazir sheloshim yom. uvet hillel omrim, nazir battechilla. mi shehayu shete chitte edim meidot oto, ellu meidim shennadar shetayim veellu meidim shennadar chamesh, bet shammay omrim, nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut. uvet hillel omrim, yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim, sheyyihye nazir shetayim: 
Adam shehu natun tachat hassedek, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, adam chalul hu, vehatztzad haelyon mevi et hattuma: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, shishsha devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. dam nevelot, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. betzat hannevela, im yesh kayyotze vah nimkeret bashshuk, mutteret. veim lav, asura, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel osrin. umodim bevetzat terefa shehi asura, mippene sheggadla veissur. dam nachrit vedam tohora shel metzoraat, bet shammay metaharin. uvet hillel omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. ochlin perot sheviit betova veshello vetova, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, en ochlim ella vetova. hachemet, bet shammay omrim, tzerura omedet. uvet hillel omrim, af al pi sheenah tzerura: 
Rabbi yose omer, shishsha devarim mikkule vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechol, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, eno ole veeno neechol. tormin zetim al shemen, vaanavim al yayin, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, en tormin. hazzorea arba ammot shebbakkerem, bet shammay omrim, kiddesh shura achat, uvet hillel omrim, kiddesh shete shurot. hammeisa, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevin. matbilin bechardalit, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, en matbilin. ger shennitgayyer arve fesachim, bet shammay omrim, tovel veochel et pischo laerev. uvet hillel omrim, happoresh min haarla, keforesh min hakkaver:
Mishnah Eduyot 4:2-6:
Behema shennolda veyom tov, hakkol modim shehi mutteret. veefroach sheyyatza min habbetza, hakkol modim shehu asur. hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, bet shammay omrim, yachpor baddeker vichasse. uvet hillel omrim, lo yishchot ella im ken haya lo afar muchan. umodim sheim shachat, sheyyachpor baddeker vichasse. sheefer kira muchan hu: 
Bet shammay omrim, hevker laaniyyim, hevker. uvet hillel omrim, eno hevker, ad sheyyuvkar af laashirim kashshemitta. kol amre hassade shel kav kav, veechad shel arbaa kabbin, ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha: 
Haomer shehu samuch laggappa velaggadish velabbakar velakkelim, ushechacho, bet shammay omrim, eno shichcha. uvet hillel omrim, shichcha: 
Kerem revai, bet shammay omrim, en lo chomesh veen lo viur. uvet hillel omrim, yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo viur. bet shammay omrim, yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot, vehaaniyyim podim leatzman. uvet hillel omrim, kullo laggat: 
Chavit shel zetim megulgalim, bet shammay omrim, eno tzarich lenakkev. uvet hillel omrim, tzarich lenakkev. umodim, sheim nikkevah usetamuha shemarim, shehi tehora. hassach beshemen tahor venitma, yarad vetaval, bet shammay omrim, af al pi shehu menattef, tahor. uvet hillel omrim, kede sichat ever katan. veim haya shemen tame mittechillato, bet shammay omrim, kede sichat ever katan. uvet hillel omrim, mashke tofeach. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum bet hillel, tofeach umatpiach:
Mishnah Eduyot 4:7-10:
Haishsha mitkaddeshet bedinar uveshave dinar, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, bifruta uveshave feruta. vechamma hi feruta, echad mishshemona veissar haitalki. bet shammay omrim, poter hu et ishto veget yashan, uvet hillel osrin. ezehu get yashan. kol shennityached immah achar shekketavo lah. hamegaresh et ishto velana immo vefundeki, bet shammay omrim, enah tzericha mimmennu get sheni. uvet hillel omrim, tzericha mimmennu get sheni. ematay, bizman shennitgarsha min hannissuin. aval im nitgarsha min haerusin, enah tzericha mimmennu get sheni, mippene sheen libbo gas bah: 
Bet shammay mattirin et hatztzarot laachim, uvet hillel osrin. chaltzu, bet shammay poslin min hakkehunna, uvet hillel machshirin. nityabbemu, bet shammay machshirin, uvet hillel poslin. veaf al pi sheellu foslin veellu machshirin, lo nimneu vet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, velo vet hillel millissa nashim mibbet shammay. vechol hattohorot vehattumot shehayu ellu metaharin veellu metammein, lo nimneu lihyot osim tohorot ellu al gav ellu: 
Shelosha achim, shenayim mehem nesuim lishte achayot veechad mufne, met echad mibbaale achayot veasa vah mufne maamar, veachar kach met achiv hashsheni, bet shammay omrim, ishto immo, vehalla tetze mishshum achot ishsha. uvet hillel omrim, motzi et ishto beget vachalitza, veet eshet achiv bachalitza. zo hi sheamru, i lo al ishto vei lo al eshet achiv: 
Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta, bet shammay omrim, shete shabbatot. uvet hillel omrim, shabbat echat. hammappelet leor shemonim veechad, bet shammay potrin min hakkarban, uvet hillel mechayyevin. sadin betzitzit, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevim. kalkalat hashshabbat, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevin:
Mishnah Eduyot 5:3-7:
Rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim, kedivre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, metamme et hayyadayim. me chattat sheasu mitzvatan, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. hakketzach, bet shammay metaharin uvet hillel metammein. vechen lammaasrot: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, shene devarim mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. dam yoledet shello tavla, bet shammay omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. uvet hillel omrim, metamme lach veyavesh. umodim beyoledet bezov shehu metamme lach veyavesh: 
Arbaa achim, shenayim mehem nesuin shete achayot, metu hannesuim laachayot, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. veim kadmu vechansu, yotziu. rabbi eliezer omer mishshum bet shammay, yekayyemu. uvet hillel omrim, yotziu: 
Akavya ben mahalalel heid arbaa devarim. amru lo, akavya, chazor becha vearbaa devarim shehayita omer venaascha av bet din leyisrael. amar lahen, mutav li lehikkare shote kol yamay, velo leasot shaa achat rasha lifne hammakom, shello yihyu omrim, bishvil serara chazar bo. hu haya metamme sear happekudda vedam hayyarok. vachachamim metaharin. hu haya mattir sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho vechallon veachar kach shechato, vachachamim osrim. hu haya omer, en mashkin lo et haggiyyoret velo et shifcha hameshuchreret. vachachamim omrim, mashkin. amru lo, maase becharkemit, shifcha meshuchreret shehayta virushalayim, vehishkuha shemaya veavtalyon. amar lahem, dugma hishkuha. venidduhu, umet benidduyo, vesaklu vet din et arono. amar rabbi yehuda, chas veshalom sheakavya nitnadda, sheen azara ninelet bifne chol adam miyyisrael bechachma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel. veet mi niddu, eliezer ben chanoch, sheppikpek betohorat yadayim. ucheshemmet, shalchu vet din vehinnichu even al arono. melammed shekkol hammitnadde umet benidduyo, soklin et arono: 
Bishat mitato amar livno, beni, chazor becha vearbaa devarim shehayiti omer. amar lo, velamma lo chazarta bach. amar lo, ani shamati mippi hamerubbim, vehem shamu mippi hamerubbim. ani amadti vishmuati, vehem amdu vishmuatan. aval atta shamata mippi hayyachid, umippi hamerubbin. mutav lehanniach divre hayyachid, veleechoz bedivre hamerubbin. amar lo, abba, pekod alay lachaverecha. amar lo, eni mafkid. amar lo, shemma ila matzata vi. amar lo, lav. maasecha yekarvucha umaasecha yerachakucha:
Mishnah Eduyot 6:1-7:1:
Rabbi yehuda ben bava heid chamishsha devarim. shemmemaanim et hakketannot, veshemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad, veshenniskal tarnegol birushalayim al sheharag et hannefesh, veal hayyayin ben arbaim yom shennitnassech al gav hammizbeach, veal tamid shel shachar shekkarav bearba shaot: 
Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi nechuneya ben elinatan ish kefar habbavli, al ever min hammet shehu tame, sherabbi eliezer omer, lo amru ella al ever min hachay. amru lo, vahalo kal vachomer. uma min hachay shehu tahor, ever happoresh mimmennu tame, hammet shehu tame, eno din sheyyihye ever happoresh mimmennu tame. amar lahem, lo amru ella al ever min hachay. davar acher, merubba tumat hachayyim mittumat hammetim, shehachay ose mishkav umoshav mittachtav, letamme adam uletamme vegadim, veal gabbav maddaf letamme ochalim umashkin, ma sheen hammet metamme: 
Kazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay, rabbi eliezer metamme, verabbi yehoshua verabbi nechuneya metaharim. etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay, rabbi nechuneya metamme, verabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua metaharin. amru lo lerabbi eliezer, ma raita letamme chazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay. amar lahem, matzinu ever min hachay kemet shalem. ma hammet, kazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu tame, af ever min hachay, kazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu yihye tame. amru lo, lo, im timmeta chazzayit basar happoresh min hammet, shekken timmeta etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu, tetamme chazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay, shekken tiharta etzem kasseora happoresh hemennu. amru lo lerabbi nechuneya, ma raita letamme etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay. amar lahem, matzinu ever min hachay kemet shalem. ma hammet, etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu tame, af ever min hachay, etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu yihye tame. amru lo, lo, im timmeta etzem kasseora happoresh min hammet, shekken timmeta chazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu, tetamme etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay, shekken tiharta chazzayit basar happoresh mimmennu. amru lo lerabbi eliezer, ma raita lachalok middotecha, o tamme vishnehem o taher bishnehem. amar lahem, merubba tumat habbasar mittumat haatzamot, shehabbasar noheg bannevelot uvashsheratzim, ma sheen ken baatzamot. davar acher, ever sheyyesh alav basar karauy, metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. chaser habbasar, tame. chaser haetzem, tahor. amru lo lerabbi nechuneya, ma raita lachalok middotecha, o tamme vishnehem o taher bishnehem. amar lahem, merubba tumat haatzamot mittumat habbasar, shehabbasar happoresh min hachay tahor, veevar happoresh mimmennu, vehu chivriyyato, tame. davar acher, kazzayit basar metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel, verov atzamot metammeim bemagga uvemassa uveohel. chaser habbasar, tahor. chaser rov atzamot, af al pi shettahor milletamme veohel, metamme vemagga uvemassa. davar acher, kol besar hammet, shehu fachot mikkazzayit, tahor. rov binyano verov minyano shel met, af al pi sheen bahem rova, temein. amru lo lerabbi yehoshua, ma raita letaher bishnehem. amar lahem, lo, im amartem bammet, sheyyesh bo rov verova verakav, tomru vachay sheen bo rov verova verakav: 
Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok al pidyon peter chamor shemmet, sheen bo lakkohen kelum, sherabbi eliezer omer, chayyavin beacharayutan kechamesh selaim shel ben. vachachamim omrim, en chayyavin beacharayutan ella chefidyon shel maaser sheni:
Mishnah Parah 12:1-5:
Haezov hakkatzar, mesappeko vechut uvechush, vetovel umaale, veochez baezov umazze. rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim, keshem shehazzaya vaezov, kach tevila vaezov: 
Hizza, safek min hachut, safek min hakkush, safek min haggivol, hazzayato fesula. hizza al shene chelim, safek al shenehem hizza, safek mechavero mitztza alav, hazzayato fesula. machat shehi netuna al hacheres, vehizza aleha, safek al hammachat hizza, safek min hacheres mitztza aleha, hazzayato fesula. tzelochit sheppiha tzar, tovel umaale chedarko. rabbi yehuda omer, hazzaya rishona. me chattat shennitmaatu, tovel afillu rashe givolin umazze, uvilvad shello yesappeg. nitkavven lehazzot lefanav vehizza leacharav, leacharav vehizza lefanav, hazzayato fesula. lefanav, vehizza al hatztzedadin shellefanav, hazzayato cheshera. mazzin al haadam middato veshello middato. mazzin al haadam veal hakkelim, vaafillu hen mea: 
Nitkavven lehazzot al davar shehu mekabbel tuma vehizza al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, im yesh baezov, lo yishne. al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, vehizza al davar shemmekabbel tuma, im yesh baezov, yishne. al haadam, vehizza al habbehema, im yesh baezov, lo yishne. al habbehema, vehizza al haadam, im yesh baezov, yishne. hammayim hamenattefim, kesherim. lefichach hem metammein leshem me chattat: 
Hammazze mechallon shel rabbim venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulim, patur. mechallon shel yachid venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulin, chayyav. aval kohen gadol, ben mechallon shel yachid ben mechallon shel rabbim, patur, sheen kohen gadol chayyav al biat hammikdash. machalikin hayu lifne challon shel rabbim vedorsin velo nimnain, mippene sheamru, me chattat sheasu mitzvatan, enan metammein: 
Ochez hu hattahor bakkardom hattame bichnafo, umazze alav. af al pi sheyyesh alav kede hazzaya, tahor. kamma yehe vammayim veyihye vahem kede hazzaya. kede sheyyatbil rashe givolin veyazze. rabbi yehuda omer, roim otam keillu hen al ezov shel nechoshet:
Mishnah Parah 12:10-11:
Kissuy mecham shehu mechubbar leshalshelet, bet shammay omrim, chibbur lattuma veeno chibbur lahazzaya. bet hillel omrim, hizza al hammecham, huzza hakkissuy. hizza al hakkissuy, lo huzza hammecham. hakkol kesherim lehazzot, chutz mittumtum veanderoginos vehaishsha. vetinok sheen bo daat, haishsha mesaadto umazze, veochezet lo vammayim vehu tovel umazze. im achaza veyado, afillu vishat hazzaya, pasul: 
Taval et haezov bayyom vehizza vayyom, kasher. bayyom vehizza vallayla, ballayla vehizza vayyom, pasul. aval hu atzmo tovel ballayla umazze vayyom, sheen mazzin ad shettanetz hachamma. vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar, kasher:
Mishnah Parah 12:6-9:
Hammazze veezov tame, im yesh bo chabbetza, hammayim pesulim, vehazzayato fesula. en bo chabbetza, hammayim kesherim, vehazzayato fesula. umetamme et chavero, vachavero et chavero, afillu hen mea: 
Hattahor lechattat shennitmeu yadav, nitma gufo, umetamme et chavero, vachavero et chavero, afillu hen mea: 
Lagin shel chattat shennitmeu achorav, nitma tocho, umetamme et chavero, vachavero et chavero, afillu hen mea. hazzog vehainbal, chibbur. kush shel rovan, lo yazze lo al hakkush velo al happika. veim hizza, muzze. shel pishtan, chibbur. or shel arisa shehu mechubbar lappikot, chibbur. hammalben, eno chibbur lo letuma velo letohora. kol yedot hakkelim hakkeduchot, chibbur. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, af hacharukot: 
Hassallim shebbakkantal, vehammitta shel tarbal, vekeren shel keliva, ukeranin shel yotze derachim, veshalshelet hammaftechot, ushelal hakkovsim, vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim, chibbur lattuma veeno chibbur lahazzaya:
Mishnah Shekalim 1:5-2:1:
Af al pi sheamru, en memashkenin nashim vaavadim uketannim, im shaklu mekabbelin miyyadan. hannachri vehakkuti sheshshaklu, en mekabbelin miyyadan. veen mekabbelin miyyadan kinne zavin vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot, vechataot vaashamot. (aval) nedarim unedavot, mekabbelin miyyadan. ze hakkelal, kol shenniddar veniddav, mekabbelin miyyadan. kol sheen niddar veniddav en mekabbelin miyyadan. vechen hu meforash al yede ezra, shenneemar (ezra 4) lo lachem velanu livnot bayit lelohenu: 
Veellu shechayyavin bakkalbon, leviyyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim, aval lo kohanim venashim vaavadim uketannim. hashshokel al yede kohen, al yede ishsha, al yede eved, al yede katan, patur. veim shakal al yado veal yad chavero, chayyav bekalbon echad. rabbi meir omer, shene kalbonot. hannoten sela venotel shekel, chayyav shene kalbonot: 
Hashshokel al yede ani, veal yede shecheno, veal yede ben iro, fatur. veim hilvam chayyav. haachin vehashshuttafin shechayyavin bakkalbon, peturin mimmaaser behema. ucheshechayyavin bemasar behema, peturin min hakkalbon. vechamma hu kalbon, maa kesef, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, chetzi: 
Metzarfin shekalim ledarkonot mippene massoy hadderech. keshem shehayu shofarot bammikdash, kach hayu shofarot bammedina. bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavadu, im nitrema hatteruma, nishbain laggizbarim. veim lav nishbain livne hair, uvene hair shoklin tachtehen. nimtzau, o shehechezirum haggannavim, ellu vaellu shekalim, veen olin lahen leshana habbaa:
Mishnah Shekalim 2:2-5:
Hannoten shiklo lachavero lishkol al yado, ushekalo al yede atzmo, im nitrema teruma maal. hashshokel shiklo mimmeot hekdesh, im nitrema teruma vekarva habbehema maal. middeme maaser sheni, middeme sheviit, yochal kenegdan: 
Hamechannes maot veamar, hare ellu leshikli, bet shammay omrim, motaran nedava. uvet hillel omrim, motaran chullin. sheavi mehen leshikli, shavin shemmotaran chullin. ellu lechatat, shavin shehammotar nedava. sheavi mehen lechatat, shavin shehammotar chullin: 
Amar rabbi shimon, ma ben shekalim lechatat. shekalim yesh lahem kitzva, vechatat en lah kitzva. rabbi yehuda omer, af lishkalim en lahen kitzva, shekkeshealu yisrael min haggola hayu shoklim darkonot, chazru lishkol selaim, chazru lishkol tevain, uvikkeshu lishkol dinarim. amar rabbi shimon, af al pi chen, yad kullan shava. aval chatat, ze mevi besela veze mevi bishtayim veze mevi beshalosh: 
Motar shekalim, chullin. motar asirit haefa, motar kinne zavin, kinne zavot, kinne yoldot, vechataot vaashamot, motrehen nedava. ze hakkelal, kol shehu ba leshem chatat uleshem ashma, motaran nedava. motar ola, laola. motar mincha, lammincha. motar shelamim, lashshelamim. motar pesach, lashshelamim. motar nezirim, lannezirim. motar nazir, lannedava. motar aniyyim, laaniyyim. motar ani, leoto ani. motar shevuyim, lashshevuyim. motar shavuy, leoto shavuy. motar hammetim, lammetim. motar hammet, leyorshav. rabbi meir omer, motar hammet, yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. rabbi natan omer, motar hammet bonin lo nefesh al kivro:
Mishnah Shekalim 3:1-4:1:
Bishlosha perakim bashshana, tormin et hallishka, bifros happesach, bifros atzeret, bifros hechag, vehen geranot lemasar behema, divre rabbi akiva. ben azzay omer, beesrim vetisha baadar, uveechad besivan, uveesrim vetisha beav. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim, beechad benisan, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha beelul. mippene ma amru beesrim vetisha beelul, velo amru beechad betishre, mippene shehu yom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov, lefichach hikdimuhu leesrim vetisha beelul: 
Beshalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein tormin et hallishka, vechatuv bahen alef vet giml. rabbi yishmael omer, yevanit katuv bahen alf vet gaml. en hattorem nichnas lo befargod chafut, velo beminal, velo besandal, velo bitfillin, velo bekamia, shemma yaani, veyomru meavon hallishka heeni, o shemma yaashir, veyomru mitterumat hallishka heeshir. lefi sheadam tzarich latzet yede habberiyyot kederech shetztzarich latzet yede hammakom, shenneemar (Bamidbar 32) vihyitem nekiyim meAdonai umiyyisrael, veomer (Mishlei 3) umetza chen vesechel tov beene elohim veadam: 
Shel bet rabban gamliel (haya) nichnas veshiklo ben etzbeotav, vezorko lifne hattorem, vehattorem mitkavven vedochako lakkuppa. en hattorem torem ad sheyyomar lahem, etrom. vehen omrim lo, terom, terom, terom, shalosh peamim: 
Taram et harishona umechappe biktavlaot, sheniyya umechappe biktavlaot. shelishit lo haya mechappe, shemma yishkach veyitrom min haddavar hattarum. taram et harishona leshem eretz yisrael, usheniyya leshum kerachin hammukkafin lah, vehashshelishit leshum bavel uleshum maday uleshum medinot harchokot: 
Hatteruma me hayu osin bah, lokchin bah temidin umusafin veniskehem, haomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim, vechol karbenot hatztzibbur. shomre sefichim bashsheviit, notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. rabbi yose omer, (af harotze) mitnaddev shomer chinnam. amru lo, af atta omer, sheenan bain ella mishshel tzibbur:
Mishnah Shekalim 4:2-5:
Para vesair hammishtalleach velashon shel zehorit, bain mitterumat halishka. kevesh para, vechevesh sair hammishtalleach velashon shebben karnav, veammat hammayim, vechomat hair umigdeloteha, vechol tzarche hair, bain mishsheyare hallishka. abba shaul omer, kevesh para kohanim gedolim osin oto mishshel atzman: 
Motar sheyare hallishka me hayu osin bahen, lokchin bahen yenot, shemanim uselatot, vehassachar lahekdesh, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, en mistakkerin mishshel hekdesh velo mishshel aniyyim: 
Motar teruma me hayu osin bah, rikkue zahav tzippuy levet kadshe hakkodashim. rabbi yishmael omer, motar happerot lekayitz hammizbeach, umotar hatteruma lichle sharet. rabbi akiva omer, motar hatteruma lekayitz hammizbeach, umotar nesachim lichle sharet. rabbi chananya segan hakkohanim omer, motar nesachim lekayitz hammizbeach, umotar hatteruma lichle sharet. ze vaze lo hayu modim bapperot: 
Motar hakketoret me hayu osin bah, mafrishin (mimmenna) sechar haummanin, umechallelin otah al sechar haummanin, venotnin otah laummanin bischaran, vechozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha. im ba hechadash bizmanno, lokchin otah mitteruma chadasha. veim lav min hayyeshana:
Mishnah Shekalim 4:6-9:
Hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim reuyin lekarbenot hatztzibbur, yinnatnu laummanin bischaran, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo ben azay, enah hi hammidda, ella mafrishin mehen sechar haummanin, umechallelin otan al maot haummanin, venotnin otan laummanin bischaran, vechozrin velokchin otan mitteruma chadasha: 
Hammakdish nechasav vehayta bahen behema reuya legabbe hammizbeach, zecharim unekevot, rabbi eliezer omer, zecharim yimmachru letzarche olot, unekevot yimmachru letzarche zivche shelamim, udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit. rabbi yehoshua omer, zecharim atzman yikkarvu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzarche zivche shelamim, veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit. rabbi akiva omer, roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua, sherabbi eliezer hishva et middato, verabbi yehoshua chalak. amar rabbi pappeyas, shamati kedivre shenehen, shehammakdish beferush, kedivre rabbi eliezer. vehammakdish setam, kedivre rabbi yehoshua: 
Hammakdish nechasim vehayu bahen devarim reuyin al gabbe hammizbeach, yenot, shemanim veofot, rabbi elazar omer, yimmachru letzarche oto hammin veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit: 
Achat lishloshim yom, meshaarin et hallishka. kol hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba, amdu mishshalosh, yesappek mearba. mishshalosh veamdu mearba, yesappek mearba, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona. veim hitlia solet, hitlia lo. veim hechmitz yayin, hechmitz lo. veeno mekabbel et meotav, ad sheyyehe hammizbeach meratztze:
Mishnah Shekalim 5:1-5:
Ellu hen hamemunnin shehayu bammikdash, yochanan ben pinchas al hachotamot, achiyya al hannesachim, mattitya ben shemuel al happeyasot, petachya al hakkinnin. petachya, ze mardechay. lamma nikra shemo petachya. shehaya poteach bidvarim vedorshan, veyodea shivim lashon. ben achiyya al chole meayim, nechuneya chofer shichin, gevine charoz, ben gever al neilat shearim, ben bevay al happakia, ben arza al hatztziltzal, hugras ben levi al hashshir, bet garmu al maase lechem happanim, bet avtinas al maase hakketoret, elazar al happarochot, ufinchas al hammalbush: 
En pochatin mishshelosha gizbarin umishshiva amarkalin, veen osin serara al hatztzibbur bemamon pachut mishshenayim, chutz mibben achiyya sheal chole meayim veelazar sheal happarochot, sheotan kibbelu rov hatztzibbur alehen: 
Arbaa chotamot hayu bammikdash, vechatuv alehen, egel, zachar, gedi, chote. ben azzay omer, chamishsha hayu, vaaramit katuv alehen, egel, zachar, gedi, chote dal, vechote ashir. egel meshammesh im niske bakar gedolim uketannim, zecharim unekevot. gedi meshammesh im niske tzon gedolim uketannim, zecharim unekevot, chutz mishshel elim. zachar meshammesh im niske elim bilvad. chote meshammesh im niske shalosh behemot shel metzorain: 
Mi shehu mevakkesh nesachim holech lo etzel yochanan shehu memunne al hachotamot, noten lo maot umekabbel mimmennu chotam. ba lo etzel achiyya shehu memunne al hannesachim, venoten lo chotam umekabbel mimmennu nesachim. velaerev bain ze etzel ze, vaachiyya motzi et hachotamot umekabbel kenegdan maot. veim hotiru hotiru lahekdesh. veim pachatu, haya meshallem yochanan mibbeto, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona: 
Mi sheavad mimmennu chotamo, mamtinin lo ad haerev. im motzin lo kede chotamo, notnin lo. veim lav lo haya lo. veshem hayyom katuv alehen mippene harammain:
Mishnah Tahorot 1:1-2: Shelosha asar davar benivlat haof hattahor. tzericha machashava, veenah tzericha hechsher, umetamma tumat ochalin bechabbetza, vechazzayit bevet habbelia, vehaochlah taun heerev shemesh. vechayyavim aleha al biat hammikdash, vesorfin aleha et hatteruma. vehaochel evar min hachay mimmenna sofeg et haarbaim. shechitatah umelikatah metaharot et terefatah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, enan metaharot. rabbi yose omer, shechitatah metaheret, aval lo melikatah:

Hakkenafayim vehannotza, mittammeot umetammeot velo mitztarfot. rabbi yishmael omer, hannotza mitztarefet. hachartom vehatztzipparnayim mittammein umetammein umitztarfim. rabbi yose omer, af rashe agappayim verosh hazzanav mitztarfim, shekken mannichim bappetumot:
Mishnah Tahorot 1:3-7: Nivlat haof hattame tzericha machashava vehechsher, umetammea tumat ochalin bechabbetza, vechachatzi feras lifsol et haggeviyya, veen bah kazzayit bevet habbelia, vehaochlah en taun heerev shemesh, veen chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. aval sorfin aleha et hatteruma, vehaochel evar min hachay mimmenna eno sofeg et haarbaim, veen shechitatah metahartah. hakkenafayim vehannotza, mittammeot umetammeot umitztarfot. hachartom vehatztzipparnayim, mittammein umetammeim umitztarfin:

Uvabbehema, haor veharotev vehakkippa vehaalal vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim, mitztarfin letamme tumat ochalin, aval lo tumat nevelot. kayyotze vo, hashshochet behema temea lenachri vehi mefarkeset, metammea tumat ochalin, aval lo tumat nevelot, ad shettamut o ad sheyyattiz et roshah. ribba letamme tumat ochalin, mimma sheribba letamme tumat nevelot:

Haochel shennitma veav hattuma veshennitma vivlad hattuma, mitztarfin ze im ze letamme chakkal shebbishnehen. ketzad. kachatzi vetza ochel rishon vechachatzi vetza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze vaze, sheni. kachatzi vetza ochel sheni vechachatzi vetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, shelishi. kabbetza ochel rishon vechabbetza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze vaze, rishon. chillekan, ze sheni veze sheni. nafal ze leatzmo veze leatzmo al kikkar shel teruma, pesaluhu. naflu shenehen keachat, asauhu sheni:

Kabbetza ochel sheni vechabbetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, sheni. chillekan, ze shelishi veze shelishi. nafal ze leatzmo veze leatzmo al kikkar shel teruma, lo fesaluhu. naflu shenehen keachat, asauhu shelishi. kabbetza ochel rishon vechabbetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, rishon. chillekan, ze sheni veze sheni, sheaf hashshelishi shennaga barishon naasa sheni. kishte vetzim ochel rishon kishte vetzim ochel sheni shebbelalan ze vaze, rishon. chillekan, ze rishon veze rishon. lishlosha o learbaa, hare ellu sheni. kishte vetzim ochel sheni vechishte vetzim ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, sheni. chillekan, ze sheni veze sheni. lishlosha o learbaa, hare ellu shelishi:

Mikratzot noshchot zo vazo, vechikkarim noshchin ze vaze, nitmet achat mehen besheretz, kullan techilla. pershu, kullan techilla. bemashkin, kullan sheniyyot. pershu, kullan sheniyyot. beyadayim, kullan shelishiyyot. pershu, kullan shelishiyyot:
Mishnah Tahorot 1:8-2:2: Mikretzet shehayta techilla vehishshich lah acherot, kullan techillah. pershu, hi techilla vechullan sheniyyot. hayta sheniyya vehishshich lah acherot, kullan sheniyyot. pershu, hi sheniyya vechullan shelishiyyot. hayta shelishit vehishshich lah acherot, hi shelishit vechullan tehorot, ben sheppershu ben shello fershu:

Kikkerot hakkodesh shebbetoch gummotehem mayim mekuddashim, nitmet achat mehen besheretz, kullan temeot. batteruma, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. im yesh benehem mashke tofeach, af batteruma, hakkol tame:

Haishsha shehayta choveshet yarak bikdera venaga veale chutz lakkedera vemakom hannaguv, af al pi sheyyesh bo chabbetza, hu tame vehakkol tahor. naga vimkom hammashke, im yesh bo chabbetza, hakkol tame. en bo chabbetza, hu tame vehakkol tahor. chazar lakkedera, hakkol tame. hayta magga teme met venaga, ben bimkom hammashke ben bemakom hannaguv, im yesh bo chabbetza, hakkol tame. en bo chabbetza, hu tame vehakkol tahor. hayta tevulat yom menaeret et hakkedera beyadayim mesoavot, veraata mashkin al yadeha, safek min hakkedera nittezu, safek shehakkelach naga beyadeha, hayyarak pasul vehakkedera tehora:

Rabbi eliezer omer, haochel ochel rishon, rishon. ochel sheni, sheni. ochel shelishi, shelishi. rabbi yehoshua omer, haochel ochel rishon veochel sheni, sheni. shelishi, sheni lakkodesh velo sheni latteruma, bechullin shennaasu letohorat teruma:
Mishnah Tahorot 2:3-6:
Harishon shebbachullin, tame umetamme. hashsheni posel velo metamme. vehashshelishi neechol binzid haddama: 
Harishon vehashsheni shebbatteruma temein umetammein. hashshelishi, posel velo metamme. veharvii, neechol binzid hakkodesh: 
Harishon vehashsheni vehashshelishi shebbakkodesh, temein umetammein. harvii, posel velo metamme. vehachamishi, neechol binzid hakkodesh: 
Hashsheni shebbechullin, metamme mashke chullin, ufosel leochale teruma. hashshelishi shebbatteruma, metamme mashke kodesh, ufosel leochale kodesh shennaasu letohorat hakkodesh. aval im naasu letohorat teruma, metamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 1:1-3: Mitzvat para adumma shettihye bat shalosh shanim o bat arba. veim hayta zekena keshera ella sheen mamtinin lah shemma tashchir vetippasel. veen lokchin egla umegaddelin otah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 b)</small> "veyikchu elecha fara" velo egla. lo matzu ella egla poskin aleha damim vetihye etzel bealeha ad shettagdil vetease para. velokchin otah mitterumat hallishka:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 19 b)</small> "temima" temimat admimut lo temimat koma ella im hayta nannasa keshera kishar hakkadashim. hayu bah shete searot levanot o shechorot betoch gumma achat o betoch shene kosot vehen munnachot zo al zo pesula:

Hayu bah shete searot ikkaran maadim veroshan mashchir ikkaran mashchir veroshan maadim hakkol holech achar haikkar. vegozez bemisparayim et roshan hammashchir veeno choshesh mishshum gizza bekadashim sheen kavvanato lagoz:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 1:13-15: Kol haoskin bappara mittechilla vead sof shehayu tevule yom kesherim lemaase happara ulekaddesh ulehazzot meefrah veaf al pi sheadayin lo heeriv shimshan. shezze shenneemar bechol happarasha <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "ish tahor" hu hattahor lemaaser sheni af al pi sheeno tahor litruma ad sheyyaariv shimsho hare ze tahor lefara:

Hatztzedokin hayu omrim sheen maase happara kasher ella bimorave shemesh. lefichach hayu bet din bevayit sheni metammein et hakkohen hassoref et happara besheretz vechayyotze bo vetovel veachar kach osek bah kede levattel divre ellu hazzedim shemmorim mehaole al rucham lo min hakkabbala. vechen kol hakkelim shemmachnisin letocham efer happara kullam tevule yom:

Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 1:7: Kol hammumin happoslin bekadashim poslin befara shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 b)</small> "asher en bah mum". hayta yotze dofen o mechir o etnan o terefa o shennirbea pesula. shekkol happoslin et hakkadashim lammizbeach poslin et happara veaf al pi shehi kekadshe bedek habbayit hoil ukeraah hakkatuv chattat. umuttar likkach otah min haakkum veen choshshin shemma revaah haakkum sheeno mafsid behemto. yetera para al hakkadashim shehaavoda poselet bah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 b)</small> "asher lo ala aleha ol" uveegla arufa omer <small>(Devarim 21 3)</small> "asher lo ubbad bah asher lo mashcha beol" ma ol haamur beegla asa shear avodot keol af ol haamur befara yifsol bah shear avodot keol. ella shehaol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda ushear avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda. ketzad. kashar aleha haol af al pi shello charash bah pesula. hichnisah ladush enah nifselet ad sheyyadush bah. vechen kol kayyotze baze. rachav aleha. nishan aleha. nitla biznavah. veavar bah et hannahar. kippel aleha et hammosera. natan tallito aleha. natan aleha kesut shel sakkim. pesula. kesharah bemosera im hayta moredet utzericha shemira keshera veim lav pesula shekkol shemira sheenah tzericha massoy hu. asa bah sandal shello tachllek. peras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvin. keshera. ze hakkelal kol shehu letzarkah keshera letzorech acher pesula. naaset bah melacha meeleha o sheala aleha ol meelav. im lirtzono pesula shenneemar asher lo ubbad bah sheim ubbad bah lirtzono hare ze kemi sheavad bah. lefichach im shachan aleha haof keshera. ala aleha zachar pesula. veen tzarich lomar shehameubberet pesula. hichnisah lirvaka vedasha meeleha keshera. hichnisah kede shettinak vetadush pesula shehare asa lirtzono. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hamelabben et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani. vechen kol kayyotze bahen mimma sheddarkan lehitlabben chayyav. vechamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut echad arko kimlo rochav hassit kaful shehu orech arbaa tefachim:

Niddah 23b:4-6: Bea minneh rav adda bar ahava meabbaye: lerabbi meir, deamar behema bime ishsha valad mealleya hu — adam bime vehema may? lemay nafka minneh? leishteroye baachila.
Vetifshot leh meha derabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona — asura baachila!
Hachi hasheta? hatam — la perasot ikka, vela parsa ikka; hacha — nehi difrasot lekka, parsa miha ikka.
Pesachim 64b:2-11: Yatzta kat harishona veyashva lah behar habbayit. sheniyya bachel, vehashshelishit bimkomah omedet. chashecha — yatzu vetzalu et pischehen.
Gemara amar rabbi yitzchak: en happesach nishchat ella beshalosh kittot shel sheloshim sheloshim bene adam. may tama? "kahal" veeda" veyisrael". mesappeka lan i bevat achat i beze achar ze,

Hilkach baenan shalosh kittot shel sheloshim sheloshim bene adam. dei bevat achat — ha ikka, vei baze achar ze — ha ikka, hilkach bechamshin name saggi, deayyli telatin veavdi, ayyli asra venafki asra, ayyli asra venafki asra.
Nichnesa kat rishona vechulei. ittemar, abbaye amar: ninalu tenan. rava amar: noalin tenan.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu lemismach annissa. abbaye amar: ninalu tenan, kamma daayaylu meallu, vesamchinan annissa. rava amar: noalin tenan, vela samchinan annissa.

Veha ditnan, amar rabbi yehuda: chas veshalom sheakavya ben mahalalel nitnadda, sheen azara ninelet al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel. abbaye metaretz letameh, verava metaretz letameh. abbaye metaretz letameh: en baazara beshaa shenninala al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel: rava metaretz letameh: en baazara beshaa shennoalin otah al kol yisrael bechochma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel.
Tanu rabbanan: meolam la nitmaech adam baazara, chutz mippesach echad shehaya bime hillel, shennitmaech bo zaken echad, vehayu korin oto "pesach meuchin".

Tanu rabbanan: paam achat bikkesh agrippas hammelech litten enav beucheluse yisrael. amar leh lechohen gadol: ten enecha bappesachim. natal kuleya mikkol echad, venimtzeu sham shishshim ribbo zuge chelayot kiflayim keyotze mitzrayim. chutz mittame veshehaya bederech rechoka. veen lach kol pesach ufesach shello nimnu alav yoter measara bene adam. vehayu korin oto "pesach meubbin".
Natal kuleya? ha bae aktura! dahadar makter lehu. vehachtiv: "vehiktiro", shello yearev chalavav shel ze baze!
Dahadar makter lehu chada chada. vehatanya "vehiktiram", sheyyehe kullo keechad! ella: tefisa bealma, deshakel minnayyhu ad deyahavin leh midde acharina.

Sanhedrin 81a:3-11: Amar rava: hachi bemay askinan? kegon sheavar avera kalla, venigmar dino al avera kalla, vechazar veavar avera chamura. salka datach amena: kevan denigmar dino laavera kalla, hay gavra ketila hu. ka mashma lan.

Bea minneh avu derav yosef bar chama merabba bar natan: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan, mi shennitchayyev shete mitot bet din niddon bachamura? dichtiv: "veholid ben paritz shofech dam [vegomer] el heharim achal veet eshet reehu timme veel haggillulim nasa enav".
"Veholid ben paritz shofech dam" – besayif, "et eshet reehu timme" – zo eshet ish bechenek, "veel haggillulim nasa enav" – zo avoda zara biskila. uchetiv: "mot yumat damav bo yihye" – biskila.

Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ema kullehu biskila. "veholid ben paritz shofech dam" – ze ben sorer umore deviskila, "eshet reehu timme" – zo naara hameorasa deviskila, "veel haggillulim nasa enav" – zo avoda zara deviskila.
Im ken, may ka mashma lan yechezkel? dilma tora ka mahdar. im ken, ibbei leh leahdora ki hechi deahdera moshe rabbenu.
Daresh rav acha berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "el heharim lo achol"? shello achal bizchut avotav. "veenav lo nasa el gillule bet yisrael"? shello halach bekoma zekufa.

"Veet eshet reehu lo timme" – shello yarad leummanut chavero, "veel ishsha nidda lo yikrav" – shello nehena mikkuppa shel tzedaka. uchetiv: "tzaddik hu chayo yichye". keshehaya rabban gamliel maggia lemikra hazze, haya boche. amar: man deaved lechullehu hu dechaye, bachada minnayyhu – la?
Amar leh rabbi akiva, ella meatta: "al tittammeu bechol elle", hachi name bechullehu – in, bachada minnayyhu – la? ella: beachat mikkol elle, hachi name: beachat mikkol elle.
Zohar, Balak 1: (Bamidbar 22:2) vayyar balak ben tzippor vegomer. ribbi shimon amar, vayyar, may reiya chama. reiya vadday mammash chama bemashkufa dechachmeta, vechama beenoy. chama bemashkufa dechachmeta, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 26:8) (140 amud bet) vayyashkef avimelech melech pelishtim bead hachallon. may bead hachallon. kema deat amer (Shoftim Adonai:28) bead hachallon nishkefa vatteyabbev em sisra (ella) (sefer acher vadday) chalon dechachmeta diznave shulehon dechochavayya, veinnun chalone dechachmeta. vechad chalon it dechol chachmeta beh sharya, uvah chame man dechame beikara dechachmeta. uf hacha vayyar balak, bechachmeta dileh.

Ben tzippor, kema deamru. aval ben tzippor mammash, deha charashoy havo bechamma zinin dehahu tzippor, natil tzippor, mekashkesh beisba, mifrach baavira. avid ovadin velachish lechishe, vehahu tzippor hava ate, vehahu isba befumeh, (sefer acher mifrach baavira) metzaftzefa kammeh. veail leh bichluv chad. mekater ketartin kammeh, veihu oda leh kama millin. avid charashoy, umetzaftzefa ofa, ufarach vetas legabbe geluy enayim, veoda leh. veihu ate. vechol milloy behahu tzippor havo.

Yoma chad avad ovadoy, venatil hahu tzippor, ufarach veazil veitakkav, vela ata. hava mitztaer benafsheh. ad deata, chama chad shalhova deeshsha detas avatreh, veokid gadpoy. keden chama ma dechama, vedachil mikkammayyhu deyisrael. ma shemeh dehahu tzippor. yadua. vechol innun dimshamshe veyade leshamsha behahu tzippor, la yadin charashoy, kema dehava yada balak.

Vechol chachmeta dehava yada, behahu tzippor hava yada. vehachi hava avid. gachin kammeh, vekatir ketarta chafe resheh, vegachin veamar. ihu amar haam, vetzippara ativ yisrael, ihu amar meod, vetzippara ativ rav. al shum rav illaa deazil behu. shivin zimnin tziftzefu da veda. ihu amar dal, vetzippara amar rav. keden dachil, dichtiv vayyagar moav mippene haam meod ki rav hu, rav hu vadday.

Uvezine charshin (sefer acher 405) dekasdiel (nusach acher 369) kadmaa, ashkechan, detzippara da havo avdin leh bezimnin yedian, mikkesef meurav bedahava, resha dedahava. puma dechesef. gadpoy minnechoshet kalal meurav bechaspa. gufa dedahava, nekudin denotze bechesef. raglin dedahava. veshavyayn befuma lishan dehahu tzippor yadua.

Veshavyan lehahu tzippara bechalon chad. ufatchin kavvin lokovel shimsha. uvelelya patchin kavvin lesihara. mekatterin ketartin, veavdin charshin, veomaan leshimsha. uvelelya omaan lesihara, veda avdin shiva yomin. mikkan ulehala, hahu lishana mechashkesha befuma dehahu tzippara, nakdin lehahu lishana bemachata dedahava, vehi memallela ravrevan miggarmah, vecholla hava yada balak betzippor da (vadday). al da ben tzippor, uvegin kach chama, ma debar nash achara la yachil leminda, vela yachil lemecheme. 40
Zohar, Chukat 10: (Bamidbar 21:5) vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe vegomer. parsheta da, baatar achara istalik, im innun me meriva demoshe veaharon.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Ester Adonai:1) vayhi bayom hashshelishi vattilbash ester malchut vegomer. megilat ester beruach hakkodesh neemra, uvegin kach ketuva ben hakketuvim. vayhi bayom hashshelishi, deitchalash chela degufa, veha kayyeyma berucha bela gufa, keden vattilbash ester malchut. may (189 amud bet) malchut. i tema bilvushe yekar veargevavna, ha lav hachi ikre. ella vattilbash ester malchut, deitlabbeshat bemalchut illaa kaddisha, vadday lavsha ruach hakkodesh. may taama zachta lehay atar. begin denatra puma dela lechavava midi. hada hu dichtiv, (Ester 2:20) en ester maggedet moladta. veolifna kol man denatir pumeh velishaneh, zache leitlabbesha beruach dekudesha. vechol man desate pumeh lemilla bisha, ha vadday hahu milla bisha aleh. (sefer acher vei lav), vei tema ha negaim, o tzaraat, demokdan kechivya aleh, veha ukemuha.

Vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe. deamru milla bisha bekudesha berich hu, uchetargumo. veim moshe natzu. lamma heelitunu, shavu kol appayay shavvevyan begin kach izdeman legabbayyhu chivvyayn, demokdan lon keeshsha, veayyil eshsha lemeayyhu venaflin metin, kema deat amer vayshalach Adonai baam et hanechashim hasserafim.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, chivvyan havo atyayn, melachashan befumayyhu, venashchin umetin. may melachashan. kema deat amer (Kohelet 10:11) im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash. eshsha havo melahatan befumayyhu, venashchin, veshadyayn eshsha behu, veittokdan meayyhu umetin veha millin illen istelaku laatar achara.
Zohar, Chukat 12: (Bamidbar 21:34) vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tira oto vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach, (Mishlei 31:21) lo tira levetah mishshaleg ki chol beta lavush shanim. ta chaze, keneset yisrael yanka mittere sitre, hasheta berachame, hasheta bedina. kad baya leyanka berachame, ishtechach atar leityashsheva beh. kad bae leyanka bedina, atar ishtechach leityashsheva beh, ulemishre alohi, dehachi hu bechol atar, la share milla dilella, ad deishtechach atar lemishre aloy. veal da, keneset yisrael lo tira leveta mishshaleg, may tama, begin dechol beta lavush shanim. la sharya hay, ella behay chivvavr besumak, vesumak bechivvavr. veha okmuha.

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tira oto, teren oto innun shelemin beorayyta bitren vavin, chad da, vechad, (Devarim 22:2) ad derosh achicha oto. may tama. begin deinnun ot mammash. ad derosh achicha (achicha mammash) oto, devae lefarsha hahu ot, dehahu aveda.

Uf hacha den oto, da og, deitdabbak beavraham, umeanshe beteh hava, vechad itgezar avraham ma ketiv, vechol anshe veto vegomer. da og deitgezar immeh, vekabbil hay at kaddisha, kevan dechama og deyisrael mekarvin gabbeh, amar ha vday ana akdimna zechuta dekaim lon, veda shavvi lekavleh.

Beh shaata dachil moshe, hech yachil leakera reshima derashim avraham. amar, vadday ha yemina dili mit, deha yemina baya lehay. i nema ha elazar, yemina desihara hu, vela dili. vehay at limina hu, deavraham limina hu.

Miyyad amar kudesha berich hu, al tira oto, la tiddechal lehahu ot dileh, vaafillu limina la itzterich. ki veyadcha natatti. semala dilach yakar leh mealma, deha hu pagim reshima dileh, uman defagim lehay at, itchaze leitakkera mealma, kol shekken semala dilach, deihu yedach, yekar leh mealma, begin kach itteakar mealma, vaafillu deihu takkifa mibbene gavrayyay, uvaa leshetzaa lehu leyisrael, nafal bideh demoshe veishtetze.

Begin kach kolla shetziu yisrael benoy vechol ammeh, vechol dileh. kema dichtiv, vayyakku oto veet banav veet kol ammo uchetiv, (Devarim 2:33) vannach oto veet banav. beno ketiv chaser yod, vekarenan banav, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.

Zakkain innun yisrael, demoshe nevia hava benayyhu, divgineh avid lon kudesha berich hu kol hane atvavn, veokmuha. vekudesha berich hu la gazar kayyaymeh im shear ammin leitkashshera beh, ella im yisrael, deinnun benoy deavraham, dichtiv bo (Bereshit 17:7) uven zaracha acharecha ledorotam berit olam. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 59:21) vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai ruchi asher alecha vegomer. lo yamushu mippicha vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
Zohar, Chukat 5: Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 104:10) hameshalleach mayanim bannechalim vegomer. yashku kol chayto saday vegomer. hane kerae david malka berucha kaddisha amaran, veit leistakkela behu. ta chaze, beshaata dechachmeta illaa batash biglifoy, af al gav dehi temira bechol sitrin, patach veitnegid minneh chad nahara, malya (nusach acher vamelayya lateraayn) betarin illain.

Kemabbua umekora demaya demalle kuzefa rabba minneh, umittamman itmashshechan mabbuin denachalin venaharin bechol setar, kach hay, bechad shevil dakik dela ityeyda, mashich venagid hahu nahar denagid venafik, umemalle lehahu nachala amika, umittamman itmashshechan mabbuin unechalin, veitmalleyayn minneh. hada hu dichtiv, hameshalleach mayanim bannechalim vegomer. illen nahare illae kaddisha deafarsemona dachyay, vechullehu itshakyayn kechad mehahu nevia denachala illaa kaddisha denafik venagid.

Levatar, yashku kol chayto saday, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim. hane 4 rashin, illen innun chayto saday, kelala dechol innun mashiryayn, vechol innun chayyaylin, daachidan behu saday, al tikre saday, ella shadday. dehu natil, veashlim shema miyyesoda dealma.

Yishberu feraim tzemaam, illen innun dichtiv behu, (yechezkel 1:20) vehaofannim yinnasu leummatam ki ruach hachayya baofannim, man chayya. ella illen chayto saday, arba innun, vechol chad vechad lechad sitra dealma. vehahu ikre chayya, veofannim lokovel kol chad vechad. vela azlin ella meruach dehahi chayya deazil alayyhu vechad illen mitshakyayn mehahu shakyu illaa, kol shear chayyaylin acharanin ishtakyayn, veitravavn, umishtarshan besharshayyhu, veitachadan illen beillen, bedargin yedian. hada hu dichtiv, alehem of hashshamayim yishkon vegomer. mashke harim mealiyyotav vegomer. illen shear dargin illain.

Levatar kol da, mipperi maasecha tisba haaretz, (sefer acher letatta vechol almin vechulei) ara illaa kaddisha. vechad ihi mitbarcha, kol almin kullehu chaddan, umitbarchan. da beshaata devirkan mishtakkeche, mishshakyu denachala (Bereshit 221 amud alef) amika decholla.

Uveshaata dealma yetiv bedina devirchan la mishtakkeche lenachta bealma, keden isteav mikdash (sefer acher uveshaata devirkan lo mishtakkeche lenachta bealma, keden alma yativ bedina, umissitra dismala rucha ittear veitpashshat bealma) vechamma chavile terikin mishtakkeche bealma, vesharan (bechamma atre) al bene nasha, umesaav hahu rucha lehu, kevar nash degava (sefer acher kevar hay ruach) veruach misava sharya aleh. hachi name sharya, lemaan deyikrav bahadeh.

Hada hu dichtiv, tastir panecha yibbahelun vegomer. hay kera may ka mayyre. ella tastir panecha yibbahelun, deha la itshakyayn leishtakkecha birchan lealmin. tosef rucham yigvaun, (nusach acher leitteara) veittear rucha achara missitra semala, veruach misava sharya al bene nasha, al innun demetin, uman dekaim bahadayyhu, veal shear bene nasha, may asvavta dilhon. ha dichtiv veel afaram yeshuvun. da afar serefat hachattat, (sefer acher da afar makdesha dilella) begin leitdakkea beh. vehayeynu raza (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar, vafillu galgal chamma.

Levatar dimhadrin lehay afar, begin leitdakkea beh, mitavar rucha misava, veittear rucha achara kaddisha, veshari bealma. hada hu dichtiv, teshallach ruchacha yibbareun, yibbareun, veyittesun beasvavta illaa, derucha achara. utechaddesh pene adama, deha itdakkiat, (itteta levalah) vechadtute desihara ishtechach, vealmin kullehu mitbarchan. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahiv lon eta, decholla asvavta, begin deyizkun lechayye alma deate, veyishtechachu dachyayn behay alma, kaddishin lealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem.
Zohar, Chukat 9: (Bamidbar 20:24) yeasef aharon el ammav vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu vegomer. hay kera ittemar veukemuha. ta chaze, kol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu, bedina ukeshot, velet man deakshe lokovleh, veyimche bideh, veyemar leh ma avdat, vechiruteh aved becholla.

Veshabbeach ani et hammetim. vechi shelomo malka meshabbach lemetayyay yattir min chayyay, veha la ikre chay ella man deihu beorach keshot behay alma, kema deat amer (Shmuel b 23:20) uvenayahu ven yehoyada ben ish chay, veha (Bereshit 6 amud alef, 164 amud alef, 207 amud bet) ukemuha chavrayyay, verasha dela azil beorach keshot ikre met, veihu meshabbeach lammetim min hachayyim.

Ella, vadday kol milloy dishlomo malka, bechachmeta ittemaru, veha ittemar, veshabbeach ani et hammetim, illu la ketiv yattir, hava amena hachi, aval kevan dichtiv shekkevar metu, ishtechach milla achara bechachmeta. shekkevar metu: zimna achara istelaku min alma, veittakkan beafra, (daazademanea di memana aleh umit bechayye alma divgin deyittakkan (sefer acher daazademanea aleh vetav behay alma begin deyittakkan) (sefer acher dimmana aleh umit behay alma veittakkan beafra begin deyittakkan baatar deyishtelim zimneh met ha vadday da hu shevacha mishshear matay alma i tema itdan zimna achara behahu alma ha ketiv lo takum vegomer) batar deishtelim zimneh mit vadday hu shevacha mishshear matay alma. i tema lo itdan zimna achara behahu alma, dichtiv lo takum peamim tzara) kol shekken deha kabbil onsha zimna uteren, veda vadday, atreh ittakkan bishvacha yattir meinnun chayye, dead la kabbilu onsha.

Veal da ketiv veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, dayyka, illen innun chayyin, veikrun metim. may tama ikrun metim, begin deha taamu taama demota, veaf al gav dekayyeyme behay alma, metim innun, umibben metayyay ahadru. veod al ovadin kadmain kayymin leatkena, veikrun metim. min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim, dead la taamu taama demota, vela kabbilu onshayyhu, vela yade i zakkan behahu alma vei lav.

Ta chaze, zakkain dezakkaan leitkashshera bitzrora dechayye, innun zakkain lemechome bikara demalka illaa kaddisha, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. veinnun madorehon, yattir veillaa mikkol innun malachin kaddishin, vechol dargin dilhon. deha hahu atra (sefer acher chedva) illaa, la zakkain illain vetattain lemechome leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha vegomer.

Veinnun dela zakkan lesalleka kol kach keinnun, (sefer acher ducheta, it vechulei) duchetayay it lon letatta kefum orchayyhu, veillen la zakkan lehahu atar, ulemechome kema dechaman innun dilella, veillen kayyme bekiyyuma deeden tattaa vela yattir. vei tema man eden tattaa. ella da eden deikre chachma tattaa, veda kayyeyma al gan divara, veashgachuta dehay eden aleh (velo yattir), veillen kayyme behay gan, veithanun meeden da.

May ben eden tattaa leillaa. kitron haor min hachoshech, eden tattaa, ikre edna nukeba. eden illaa, ikre eden dechar, aleh ketiv ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha. hay eden tattaa, ikre gan leeden dilella, vehay gan ikre eden, legan diltatta. veillen demishtakkeche began tattaa, ithanun mehay eden dealayyhu, bechol shabbat veshabbat, uvechol yarcha veyarcha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato.

Veal illen amar shelomo, min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna, deha illen bedarga illaa yattir minnayyhu. man innun. innun shekkevar metu, vekabbilu onsha tere zimne, veillen ikrun kesef mezukkak, deal lenura zimnin uteren, venafik minneh zuhama, veitbarar veitnake. (Kohelet 4:3) vetov mishshenehem et asher aden lo haya. hahu rucha dekaim leella, veitakkav lenachta letatta, dehay kaim bekiyyumeh, velet leh lekabbela onsha, veit leh mezona mehahu mezona illaa dilella leella.

Tav mekullehu, man dela itperash, vela itgalyay, vechol milloy bistima innun. da hu zakkaa chasida, denatar pikkude orayyta, vekiyyem lon, veishtaddal beorayyta yemama velele. da itachid veithane bedarga illaa al kol shear bene nasha, vechullehu itachadan (sefer acher atevakedan) mechuppa dehay.

Ta chaze, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu lemoshe yeasef aharon el ammav, itchalash chela dileh, veyada deha attebar (tetzavve 181 amud alef) deroa yemina dileh, veizdazea kol gufeh, kevan deamar kach et aharon veet elazar beno, amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe, ha deroa achara ozifna lach (zameyneyt lecha), vehafeshet et aharon vegomer, veaharon yeasef, he elazar yehe legabbach, zimna (nusach acher yemina) da techot avoy. veim kol da la ashlim atar behahu zimna kaavoy, deha anane yekar istelaku, vela ahadru ella bizchuta demoshe, vela bizchuta deelazar.

(Bamidbar 20:27) vayyaas moshe kaasher tzivva vegomer. amay leene kol haeda. ella, begin deaharon hava rechima deamma, yattir mikkolla, vela yemrun deha itnegid al yeda demoshe. umoshe mashich leaharon bemillin, ad desaliku letura, vechol yisrael havo chaman, beshaata deafshit moshe levushe deaharon, vealbish lon leelazar.

May taama moshe (nusach acher uleaharon). ella moshe albishinun leaharon kad salik lechahana, hada hu dichtiv veyalbesh moshe et aharon et begadav, uchetiv (Vayikra 8:7) veyalbesh oto et hammeil. hasheta. moshe ade minneh, ma deyahav leh. vekudesha berich hu ade minneh, ma deyahav leh. vetarvavyyhu afshitu leh leaharon mikkolla, umoshe ade levar, vekudesha berich hu lego. vead deade moshe, kudesha berich hu la ade, zakkaa chulaka demoshe.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon. atkin kudesha berich hu leaharon, arsa umenarta dedahava denahara. umiddideh natil, mehahu menarta dehava dalik bechol yoma tere zimne veastim pum mearta venachtu.

Ribbi yehuda amar, pum mearta hava peticha, dechol yisrael havo chaman leaharon shachiv, uvutzina dimnarta dalik kammeh, vearseh nafik veayil, vaanana chad kaim aleh. ucheden yadu yisrael deha aharon mit. vechamu deha istelaku anane kavod, hada hu dichtiv vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon vegomer, veha ukemuha. veal da bachu leaharon kol bet yisrael, guverin venashin vetaf, deha rechima mekullehu hava.

Ribbi shimon amar, hane telata achin illain kaddishin, amay la itkavaru beatar chad, veshayyfin itbadru, chad hacha, vechad hacha, vechad beatar achara. ella it deamre, baatar devaan yisrael leistakkena beh, mit kol chad vechad, begin leaggana alayyhu, veishtezvun, aval kol chad vechad mit kaddeka chaze alayyhu. miryam bekadesh, ben tzafon ledarom. aharon listar yemina. moshe kaddeka chaze leh. achid hahu tura letura deaharon, vechanish likvurata demiryam legabbe hahu tura, achid litre sitre. veal da itkere har haavarim, ditre sitre tura dimavre, veachid lesitra da ulesitra da.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay bealma den uvealma deate. veaf al gav deinnun baatar achara, bealma achara illaa, zechutehon kayyeyma bealma da, ledare darin. uveshaata deyisrael tayyvin betiyyuveta kamme kudesha berich hu, ugezera itgezar alayyhu, keden kare kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay dekayyme kammeh leella, veoda lon, veinnun mevattele hahi gezera, vechayes kudesha berich hu alayyhu deyisrael. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dealayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:11) venachacha Adonai tamid vegomer.
Zohar, Vayakhel 13: Ta chaze, kevan deal shabbeta, veittammar hahu maddura, kol eshshin deeshsha kashya ittemaru veitkafyayn, vaafillu eshsha degehinnam, vechayyayvin degehinnam, it lon nayycha. vecholla tatta veella it lehu nayycha. kad nafak shabbeta, umevarchin yisrael al nura, keden nafkin kol eshshin demittammeran, kol chad vechad leatreh. uvegin dela leitteara eshsha achara, ketiv (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, eshsha demadbecha amay.

Ella kad al shabbeta, karoza kare bechullehu rekiin, ittekanu retichin, ittekanu mashiryayn, lekadmut marechon. keden nafik chad rucha missitra dedarom, vehahu rucha itperash al kol innun chelin umashiryayn delistar yemina, veitlabbeshan beh, vehahu rucha ikre levusha dikar deshabbeta. keden patore dehay alma, mittakkenan bechad hechala. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, desiddura defatoreh itchaze tamman kedka yaut, vekayyeyma kolla mittakkena, bela kissufa, inish kefum cheleh.

Kad al shabbeta, itzterichu innun amma kaddisha leaschaa garmayyhu (136 amud bet) mishshimusha dechol, may taama. begin divchol, rucha achara azla veshatya veshara al amma. vechad bae bar nash lenafka min hahu rucha, uleaala berucha achara kaddisha illaa, bae leaschaa garmeh, lemishre aleh hahu rucha illaa kaddisha.

Ta chaze raza illaa demilla, kol innun shit yomin, (keyama milla decholla) itachadan beraza dechad nekuda kaddisha, vechullehu yomin itachadan beh. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin levar besitra achara. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin lego (hakedama Adonai amud bet) meiggula kaddisha, veitachadan binkuda kaddisha.

Veyisrael kaddishin, vechol innun demitassekin bikdushsha, kol yoma deshabbeta, itachadan kol innun shit yomin, beinnun shit yomin dilgo deitachadan behahi nekuda, itachadan behay, begin lenatra lon. vechol innun shit yomin (davar acher veinnun shit yomin dilgo) deshabbeta, hahi nekuda temira ihi. kevan deal shabbeta, keden salleka hahi nekuda, veitattera veitachada leella, vechullehu temirin begavvah.

Ta chaze, it yamim veit yamim. yeme chol, kema deittemar, veillen kayyeymin levar leammin. yeme hashshabbat, deinnun yeme hashavua, kayyeymin leyisrael. vechad salleka hay nekuda, kolla itgeniz, veihi salleka, kevan deihi salleka, ikre shabbat.

Mahu shabbat. i tema begin shevita, dichtiv ki vo shavat, yaut hu. aval raza demilla, kevan desalleka hay nekuda, unehora nahir, keden mitattera ihi baavahan, kevan demitattera ihi baavahan, keden itchabberat veitachadat behu, lemehve chad, veikre kolla shabbat. shabbat: 300 bat. 300 ha ukemuha, raza ditlat avahan, demitachadan bevat yechida, veihi mitattera behu, veinnun bealma deate. vecholla ihu chad. veda ihu 300 bat, lemeheve kolla chad.

Vei tema, shabbat haggadol, veihu leella, amay ikre shabbat. ella vadday hachi hu. veraza demilla, bechol atar nekuda deihi ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:8) shamreni keishon bat ayin, begin deihi (nekuda) ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat.

Alma deate, ihu (180 amud alef) hechala lehahi nekuda illaa, vechad ihi kayyeyma, venatla begadpaha laavahan, leitattera leella ikre kolla shabbat. vechad avahan mitatteran leella, bego nekuda illaa, ikre shabbat. nekuda tattaa (70 amud bet) kad mitattera baavahan ikre shabbat.

rashi: Kachalom mehakitz. keshena sheen lah ketz, shehu shenat olam, ken hayta lahem: "vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachane ashshur" (Yeshayahu 37:36; Melachim 2 19:35):
Adonay bair tzalmam tivze. birushalayim, shehereu aleha, sham nitbazza tzelem demutam venisrefu kullam:
targum: Hech chelma min gevar demittear Adonai leyom dina rabba beittear yathon min bet kevurethon birgaz demutehon tivsar:

rashi: Ki shibbar daltot nechoshet. shehayu neulim bifnehem:
targum: Arum tevar dashe nechasha veavre parzela katzetz:

rashi: El el. el hakkadosh baruch hu shehu simchat gili:
Veodcha vechinnor. al shehotzetani:
targum: Veeul likrava kurebaneh lemadbach dayya leelaha di mineh chedvat bauta veodi kodamach bechinra Adonai elahi:

rashi: Vayyelech bammidbar. min hammaarav lammizrach, bemetzar deromi shel edom umoav:
Vayyasav et eretz edom. kol deromah:
Veet eretz moav. kol deromah, ucheshehiggia lemiktzoa deromit mizrachit, pana el hatztzafon lisbov et metzar hammizrachi:

Vayyavo mimmizrach shemesh leeretz moav vayyachanun beever arnon. lesof mizrachah shel eretz moav, vesham hitchila eretz sichon veog, vechavshu ever hayyarden bemizrach eretz kenaan veavru hayyarden, venichnesu lah leeretz kenaan derech hammizrach:
targum: Vaazal bemadbera veakef yat ara edom veyat ara moav vaato mimadnach shimsha leara demoav ushero beivra dearnon vela alu bitchum moav are arnon techum moav:

rashi: Yippol mitztziddecha elef. leshon chaniyya, kemo "al pene chol echav nafal" (Bereshit 25:18):
Mitztziddecha. missemolcha yachanu elef shedim, veelecha lo yiggash lehazzik:
targum: Tadkar shema dekudesha yippelun min setar semalach alfa verivvuta min yeminach levatach la yikrevun leminzak:

ohc: Vehafeshet et aharon et begadav. amar "et aharon et begadav" shennire shehem shete hafeshatot, hagam sheen ze tzachut lashon, im kol ze efshar shennitkavven lomar lo shehabbegadim sheyyafshit yihyu bigde kehunna lo bigde atzmo, laze amar hafeshet et aharon legufe, vechazar vehitna shehahafshata hu et begadav hammeyuchadim lo leaharon shehem bigde kehunna, vaalehem hu omer vehilbashtam et elazar. veze lo haya nishma im haya omer "vehafeshet aharon et begadav", sheaz en kan yittur lidrosh mimmennu ella haddevarim kifshatan, ucheillu amar "vehafeshet aharon mibbegadav". umaamar et begadav hu gezerat "vehafeshet", ma sheen ken amro vehafeshet et aharon, maamar et aharon hu gezerat "vehafeshet" venishar maamar et begadav meyuttar lidrasha.

Od nitkavven lomar al ze hadderech "hafeshet et aharon", vehafeshata zo enah ella mibbegadav, vehu amro et begadav, aval yesh lo malbush acher techef umiyyad, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni kan) veze leshonam: haya aharon mitpashshet umitlabbesh beanne chavod. umeatta lo nishar aharon mufshat mehammalbush afillu beet shehaya mafshito moshe, lo haya nifshat ella mibbegadav vehaya malbish heanan kol chelek vechelek hannifshat mimmennu:

Zot chukkat hattora. tzarich ladaat lamma kinna lemitzva zo shem kelalut hattora, shehaya lo lomar "zot chukka" vegomer, o "zot chukkat hattuma" o "chukkat hattahara", kederech amro (Shemot 12:43) "zot chukkat happasach". veen lomar shennitkavven lehatzerich taharat efer para laasok battora, ki lo chen matzinu lerazal sheamru (berachot 22.) sheadrabba en divre tora mekabbelin tuma, ulechol sevarot razal (sham) afillu lehammachmirim bevaale kerayin mittaam shetztzarich beema uveyira vechulei modim bitmee met shemmuttarim beesek hattora.

Veyitbaer hainyan al pi ma sheamru beferek batra denazir (nazir 61:), ufasko rambam beferek 1 mehilchot tumat met, sheen hakkuti naase teme met, veze leshono: "sheim naga bammet o nesao o heehil alav hare hu kemo shello naga, ha lema ze dome livhema shennaga" vechulei ad kan. vehinne hahevdel shebbo huremu am bene yisrael mishshear haggoyim hu beemtzaut kabbalat hattora, shezzulat ze hinne kechol haggoyim bet yisrael. umeatta taamnu tzuf devash imre el bema sheamar zot chukkat hattora, perush, chukka zo shel hattuma utenae taharatah tesubbav mehattora, ki al yede shekkibbelu hattora naasu am bene yisrael davar sheharuchanim hashshefalim teevim lehiddavek bahem, leheyotam chativa shel kedushsha elyona bechayyehem gam bemotam. bechayyehem – shebbenogea bammet o yaahilu alav vechaddome tidbak bahem hattuma shebbammet velo tachpotz lehippared im lo bechoach gadol asher chakak Adonai bammitzva haamura bainyan shel para adumma, uvemotam gam ken titrabbe hattuma keamram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 114:) bappasuk "adam ki yamut" vegomer – yisrael metammeim baohel veen ummot metammein baohel.

Uchevar himshalti bemakom acher inyan ze lishne kelim shehayu etzel baal habbayit, achat melea devash veachat melea zevel, ufinna otam vehotziam lachutz mehacheder. otah shehayta melea devash mitkabbetzim lah kol hazzevuvim veharmasim, veotah shehayta melea zevel, hagam sheyyikkansu lah ketzat meharmasim lo yishve leshel devash. kemo chen adam miyyisrael shemmet, lihyoto male kedushsha hammetuka vehaareva, betzet hannefesh venitroken hagguf, yitkabbetzu hakkelippot leen ketz shehem kochot hattuma hatteevim tamid lehiddavek bakkedushsha lehanot mehearev. velaze yetamme beohel, vaafillu elef battim mekorim veachat petucha lachavertah hattuma temalle kol hechalal hammekore. ma sheen ken asher lo mizzera yisrael, lihyoto meshullal mehakkedushsha en kol kach hitkabbetzut hattuma ella chelek hammemit hannidbak bagguf. vaasher yesovev hakkol hi hattora.

Uvaze matzati nachat ruach lamma keshetztzivva Adonai pesach bemitzrayim, hikpid Adonai al shene devarim: haechad, din arel vetzivva lamul, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 17,3) befasuk "vaeevor alayich" vegomer – dam pesach vedam mila, vehashsheni al din ben nechar, sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 96) befasuk "mishchu ukechu lachem" vegomer – mishchu yedechem meavoda zara, shebbaze yatzu mikkelal ben nechar. veal din shelishi shehu hattuma lo matzinu shehikpid Adonai. vahagam shemmatzinu (fesachim oz.) shehappesach ba betuma benitma tzibbur, im kol ze haya Adonai yachol letzauot kodem sheyyizzaharu mittumat met velaasot moshe efer para, veen matzor laAdonai laasot retzono yitbarach. vahagam sheyyesh lomar baze dechiyyot, af al pi chen lefi ma shekkatavnu yesh taam nachon lishvach, ki yisrael lo hayu temee met hagam shennagu veheehilu al hammet ki adayin lo kibbelu hattora, vedanu bahem az din ger shennitgayyer beyom arbaa asar sheshshochatin alav veen choshshin letuma shennitma kodem shennitgayyer. vetimtza sheamru bifsachim (fesachim tzav.) uchetavo harambam beferek 6 mehilchot pesach veze leshono: ger shennitgayyer beyom arbaa asar umal vetaval, en shochatin alav et happesach, gezera dilshana habbaa yihye teme met veyitbol laerev veyomar eshtakad mi lo tavalti" vechulei, ad kan leshono. mimma shennatan hattaam mishshum gezera dilshana habbaa, mizze atta lamed ki zulat gezera zo en choshshin letumat met, uchemo chen yisrael kesheasu pesach mitzrayim en bahem din tumat met, vehu maamar Adonai "zot chukkat hattora".

Uvederech remez yirtze beamro chukkat hattora, sheim yekayyemu mitzva zo, hagam heyotah chukka belo taam, maale alehem hakkatuv keillu kiyyemu hattora asher tzivva Adonai lemor, ki kiyyum hammitzva belo taam yaggid hatzedakat haemuna vehasekamat hannefesh lekayyem kol mitzvot habbore, veze lecha haot. veulay ki letaam ze ratza Adonai shettitmasser lahem hammitzva bederech chukka.

Asher tzivva Adonai lemor. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar maamar ze, vahalo roani ki Adonai hu hammetzavve lemor, shekken amar "vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor dabber el bene yisrael". od amro leshon nistar asher tzivva ufi Adonai hu hamedabber, vehaya lo lomar "asher anochi metzavvecha lemor". od lamma lo hispik bema sheamar lemor befasuk rishon vechazar lomar paam sheniyya lemor. od tzarich ladaat lamma lo hikdim maamar "dabber el bene yisrael" kodem maamar "zot chukkat hattora" al ze hadderech "dabber vegomer zot chukkat hattora".

Achen letzad shekkol mitzvot hattora hem sichliyyot veshimiyyot: sichliyyot – shehassechel mechayyevam, kegon kibbud av vaem, geneva, gezela, onaa, retzicha vechaddome. shimiyyot – shabbat ki bo shavat habbore, yom tov al hannes shennaasa lanu bahem, avoda zara shello laavod zulat elohenu ki hu hammotzi otanu vegomer vechaddome laze, veze hu taam hannigle. veen lecha mitzva umitzva sheen bah od sodot neelamim hanniglim lemoshe uleadam rauy hammassig liknot kinyan hattora bearbaim ushemona devarim hashshenuyim bemishnat chasidim (avot 86), sheaz megallin lo raze hattora sheggilla Adonai lemoshe besinay, umoshe gam ken gilla leyisrael bene doro sodot hannistarim vetaame hammitzvot visod kol davar.

Uvema shellefanenu tzivva Adonai elav sheyyistom haddevarim veyomar lahem haddavar bechukka belo taam, vehu ma sheheir otanu beamro vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor leyisrael, perush, uma hu hammaamar shetztzivva lo lomar lahem, zot chukkat hattora perush, mitzva zo hi chukkat hattora ken tzivva Adonai lemor lachem, ucheillu amar hakkatuv asher tzivva Adonai lemor lachem hu zot chukkat hattora. umittoch haddevarim atta lamed shenneemar lemoshe devarim mutamim bemitzva zo ella shemma shetztzivva alav lemor hu chukka, uvaze lo yitbauhu yisrael lomar lahem taam haddavar kevan she tzivva alav lomar haddavar bechukka.

Uvaze nityashshevu haddikdukim. gam nityashshev lamma lo hikdim maamar "dabber" vegomer lemaamar "zot chukkat" vegomer, ki maamar "zot chukkat hattora" hi mitzvat Adonai al mitzva sheyyomar leyisrael she tzivva lo sheyyomar lahem mitzva zo bechukka, umaamar "dabber" ba al ikkar hammitzva mitzvat Adonai leyisrael. uletzad sheyyomru yisrael hare haose mitzva belo yediat tamah vesodah nechshevet hammitzva keguf belo neshama, laze gamar omer dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu elecha fara vegomer, perush, yikchu lema sheatta yodea umechavven baddavar lihyotcha yodea sod hainyan ufelaav, uvaze tihye hammitzva naaset shelema bemaase uvemachshava hatztzericha. uchefi ze yeduyyak al nachon amro veyikchu betosefet vav bitchillat hatztziuuy lahem, shennitkavven lomar shemmillevad hallekicha atzmah sheyyikchu happara od yosifu sheyyechavvenu bilkichatah lema sheelecha kaamur.

Veim tomar, tenach otah para shel oto dor, para sheyyaasu bechol dor vador ma tehe aleha? efshar shello mikkullan heelim Adonai sodah ella mikkelalut yisrael, aval lammeyuchadim shehem aharon vechayyotze bo nimseru sodoteha vehem yimseru lammeyuchadim habbaim acharehem. o efshar shebbechol dor vador yechavvenu lema sheyyada moshe. umatzati sheamru bammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba kan) veze leshonam: "veyikchu elecha" – lelammed shekkol happarot shennaasu yihyu nikraim al moshe. vetzarich ladaat lamma asa Adonai shinnuy bemitzva zo mikkol hammitzvot shettikkare al shemo. velidvarenu yesh taam nachon baddavar kemo shepperashti.

O yomar al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19,8) sheamru sheummot haolam monim et yisrael: "ma mitzva hi zo" vechulei, laze ba maamar hakkatuv kan veamar zot chukkat hattora asher tzivva Adonai lemor, perush, sheyyomru yisrael laummot keshehen mekanterim otam veomrim lahem: "ma mitzva hi zot" vechulei, yomru lahem: "chukka chakak Adonai alenu laasot veen anu mehareharin acharav". ulefi ze efshar shehuresha moshe lomar lahem taam hammitzva vesodah, ella shello yomru hattaam laummot kesheyyidchaku otam bedivre kintur: "ma mitzva hi zot uma taam yesh bah"?

Fara adumma vegomer. roe ani ki chol simaneha mochichim al haddinim: "adumma" – ki hu ze siman tigboret haddinim, "temima" – been sear shachor, vechen amru zichronam livracha (fara 2,5) shete searot shechorot poslot otah, velo searoteha levad ella afillu karneha utelafeha tzerichim lihyot adummim, aval shechorot veen tzarich lomar levanot poslot. "asher lo ala aleha ol" – ki haol yamtik haddinim, besod maamaram (berachot 5.) yissurin memarkin kol avonotav shel adam, shehem bechinat haddinim. gam serefatah baesh hu bechinat haddinim, uvehitkabbetzut haddinim baefer yaasu haveracha lattuma haddevuka baadam mehammet, sheggam hi enah ella retzua raa mitztzad yissure hammishpat.

Veraiti besifre zuta (sifre zuta 19:2), ufasko rambam beferek 1 mehilchot para adumma: en lokchin egla umegaddelin otah, shenneemar "veyikchu vegomer fara" – velo egla, ad kan. ulefi ma sheamarnu shekkol maaseha hem bechinat hammishpat, yesh taam baddavar, ki shem para yaggid mispar hayyadua lemispar bechinat haddinim kayyadua leyode chen, laze tzivva Adonai sheyyiknu otah kesheyyesh bivchinat misparah mispar asher techavven elav. aval im yiknu egla, konim davar sheen bo hammispar asher anu tzerichin lo, vahagam shemmegaddelin otah ad shennikret para, af al pi chen yakpid Adonai al sheat hakkinyan kede sheyyihyu konim davar shehakkavvana bo shehem 285 dinim.

Achicha yisrael atta yadata vegomer. taam amro achicha, gam amro atta yadata, lomar ki telaa zo lo nisbeva mimmenni ella meavotenu, vaani veatta achim shavim baddavar, sheshshetar ze shel hattelaa haya katuv al avinu veechad min haachim perao. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 82) befasuk "vayyelech el eretz" (Bereshit 36,8) veze leshonam: mippene hachov, shello ratza lifroa chov aviv, ad kan.

Veamro atta yadata, perush, kevar kodem heyot lanu hattelaa yadata otah shennigzera ben habbetarim, vedavar ze davka hu sheyyedao, velaze dikdek lomar atta, haummot hayu choshvim ki mikre hayyerida haya lahem lihyot avadim ushefalim.

Veamro vayyerdu avotenu vegomer, perush, millevad haggalut, od nosaf shessavalnu tzara kefula shehaya haggalut bemitzrayim, al derech ma shekkatvu battosafot bemassechet shabbat (shabbat 10.) bema sheamru sham baggemara veze leshonam: leolam al yeshanne adam et beno ben habbanim, shebbishvil shene selaim melat vechulei nitgalgel haddavar veyardu avotenu lemitzrayim, ad kan. vehikshu hattosafot: vahalo haggezera hayta mibben habbetarim, vetertzu sheim lo haya shinnuy sheasa yaakov leyosef haya haggalut bemakom acher belo kol kach tokef hashshibud asher hifliu lemarer chayyehem. meatta heyot haggalut bemitzrayim hu nosaf al hayyadua baggezera, laze amar vayyerdu vegomer, perush, veod lanu shehayta hattelaa bemakom ze hara yamim rabbim.

Vayyareu lanu vegomer, venitkavvenu gam ken bemaamar ze lomar shehem paru shetar chov umitztzad ze zachu baaretz, vehodium gam ken ki paru peraon gadol bechol kach tzaar zeman aroch, keamro yamim rabbim.

rashi: Ki hu yatztzilcha mippach yakush vegomer. lechol echad veechad hu omer yoshev beseter elyon:
targum: Arum hu yiftzinach shelomo beri mippacha vetikla mimota veitregusheta:

ohc: Vayyavou vene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar kol haeda velo hispik bemaamar bene yisrael shemmin hassetam hem kol haeda? achen lefi ma shekkadam lanu middivrehem (Bamidbar Rabba sof parashat balak) ki kesheyyisrael hem bemadregat yesharim vetzaddikim nikraim bene yisrael, uchesheenam baggeder hannaot nikraim am, keamro (Bamidbar 14, 11) "ad ana yenaatzuni haam hazze" veharebe kayyotze baze. veharebe peamim yikraem hakkatuv am bene yisrael, hagam sheyyimmatzun bahem harebe asher enam reuyim legeder ze, vichavven hakkatuv el harov hakkesherim. vechan hodia hakkatuv ki chol haeda yeshnam begeder ze sheyyikkaru bene yisrael, vehu maamar vayyavou vene yisrael kol haeda, perush, kullan nikraim beshem yisrael begeder yesharim vetzaddikim. veze mechuvvan ledivre razal sheamru veze leshonam: "kol haeda" – eda hashshelema.
