Vehem zichronam livracha nire sheddarshu tevat "kol haeda" atzmah shettaggid hashshelemut vehakkiyyum, veshivim panim lattora. vehakkavvana behodaa zo hi leshalosh sibbot: ha, lefi shehu omer besamuch maase me meriva, veamru zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba parashat vaetchannan) shenneenash moshe al yadam, sheamar lahem "shimu na hammorim", laze hikdim lehodiacha ki chol haeda hayu tzaddikim vezo hayta sibba shenneenash moshe shekkeraam morim. 2, lehagedil maalat miryam aleha hashshalom, shehagam shekkol haeda hayu tzaddikim lo amad zechutam lehaamid lahem beer hammayim shehaya bizchut miryam (taanit 9.). 3, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni tashesag) sheamru sheyyisrael lo halchu ligmol chesed im miryam, ucheshennikhalu al moshe veal aharon chashav aharon shebbau ligmol chesed im miryam, vehem lo bau ella lariv immam kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha. umeatta yesh makom lachshod beyisrael shello hayu az beoto matztzav kesherim, veze lecha haot shello gamlu chesed im hannevia. laze kadam vehodiacha ki chol haeda tzaddikim asher beshem yisrael yechunnu, vetaam shello gamlu chesed amar hakkatuv besamuch "vattamat sham miryam vattikkaver sham", veamru baggemara (moed katan koach.) veze leshonam: "vattamat" vegomer samuch lammita kevura, ad kan. uletaam ze lo hirgishu lavo ligmol chesed, uvemeshech zeman muat ad sheyyadu kafatz alehem rugezo shel tzama, vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv samuch lemaamar "vattikkaver sham" – "velo haya mayim" vegomer:
Vayyeshev haam bekadesh. ba lehodienu shennitakkevu sham yamim rabbim, keamro (Devarim 1:46) "vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim". perush vayyeshev leshon akkava.

Vattamat sham vegomer. tzarich ladaat taam amro sham, verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (moed katan koach.) shello ikkevuha, uderasha zo nishmaat meamro vattikkaver sham. venire ki letzad shehizkir mita chash al kevod hatztzaddeket, shehare amru (berachot 18.) tzaddikim bemitatam keruyim chayyim, laze dikdek lomar sham, perush sham hu shemmeta velo nishara benehem ella bemakom acher yeshnah ben hatztzaddikim, ki hatztzaddikim domim lifne hakkadosh baruch hu lemargaliyyot hammunachim beargaz, keshehu chafetz beachat mehem hu motziah mehaargaz vekovah betachshit echad mittachshitav. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (moed katan koach.) "vattamat sham" ligzera shava, lomar sheggam hi meta binshika, veshivim panim lattora.

Zot hattora adam ki yamut. amro zot hattora, yitbaer gam ken al derech shepperashti befasuk "zot chukkat hattora", vehu letzad sheddikdek lomar adam ki yamut vegomer, vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (bava metzia 114.) attem keruyim adam, yisrael metammein beohel veen ummot haolam vechulei, laze hikdim latet hattaam shesovev haddavar veamar zot hattora shemmesibbatah hu sheoto shennikra adam metamme beohel, aval ummot haolam sheen lahem tora vechulei. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk "zot chukkat hattora".

Kol habba el vegomer vechol asher baohel. kashe, im habba tame, mi gara mimmennu asher baohel? veyitbaer al pi ma sheamru bifsikta zutarti veze leshonam: "kol habba el haohel" – shebba miktzato, ad kan. uchefi ze, im lo haya omer hakkatuv ella "kol habba", hayiti omer habba kullo, habba miktzato minnayin? umimma sheamar "kol asher baohel" hare kullo amur, ma ani mekayyem "kol habba" vegomer? ze habba miktzato. od sham bappesikta veze leshonam: davar acher "kol habba" vegomer – laasot karkao shel bayit kamohu ad hattehom, ad kan. nire shehuchrechu lidrasha zo, ki lisvara harishona haya lo lomar hakkatuv "kol asher baohel vechol habba el haohel", veyihye hakkatuv mitparesh bederech lo zo af zo, aval mimma shehikdim "kol habba", ze yaggid shemmaamar kol asher vegomer hu din chadash.

Ella shebbesifre raiti shene hadderachim: derech harishon tanna kamma, vederech sheni rav acha bar yoshiyya. vegamar omer tanna kamma shettaam shehutzrach hakkatuv lomar "kol asher baohel" hagam sheamar "kol habba", shehu ba miktzato, mishshum sheen onshin min haddin. vekashe li, halo ma sheanu omrim "en onshin min haddin" hu al onesh mita shel bet din shel matta, vechan lu yihye shennitma venichnas lammishkan tame – mitato bide shamayim. veod levad mizze, keshennaskil al davar nire ki ma shellefanenu eno nikra "onshin min haddin", ki bichlal habba kullo yesh miktzato, vahare mitchayyev hu al miktzato, ki chol chelek vechelek shebbo yikkare miktzato, veen anu onshin oto min haddin ella min hakkatuv. veulay shessover tanna ze shekkol kayyotze baze nikra "onshin min haddin".

rashi: Evilim midderech pisham. asher meavonotehem yitannu beyissure cholaim, af hem min hatztzerichin lehodot. yesh simmaniyyot befarasha zo (kelomar ketuvot shesh 166 hafuchin) uvain lidrosh bimkom akkin verakkin lemaet, lomar tzaaku kodem gezar din naanin, leachar gezar din enam naanin:
targum: Shatyan meorach meradehon umeavyatehon mistagfin:

rashi: Vayyillachamu vene ammon. hi haamura lemala (10:9):
targum: Vahava mizman yomin veagichu kerava bene amon im yisrael:

rashi: Omar laAdonai machsi. hu umetzudati, vehakkol yilmedu mimmenni. velamma ani omer ken?
targum: Amar david emar laAdonai ruchetzani ucherach tukefi elahi achle bememreh:

ohc: Bemattehu paamayim. taam shete peamim – keeved sheose shelichut adono bizrizut gedola. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin lod:) darshu derashot, uchefattish vegomer.

rashi: Vaachashsheva. belibbi:
Ladaat zot. ma hi middato shel hakkadosh baruch hu. ken hu amal veenay. niret hayta midda zot li amal velo mishpat:
targum: Vachashivet lemida yat da leut hu veenay:

rashi: Avel keramim. (targum:) meshar karmayya:
targum: Umechanun mearoer ad maalana deminit asrin kirvin vead meshar keramaya machata rabbeta lachada veitbaru bene amon min kodam bene yisrael:

ohc: Mishsham nasau vegomer. yesh lehair lamma shinna bemassa ze veshelleacharav lomar bederech ze mishsham vegomer, velo amar kederech sheamar bammikra shellefanav veshellifne fanav "vayyisu" vegomer "vayyisu" vegomer. veulay ki shene massaot ellu shel nachal zered veshel nachal arnon nasu meatzman velo al pi haananim kasseder haragil, velaze shinna hakkatuv veamar mishsham nasau perush meatzman. veraiti lehochiach keferushenu ze mimma sheamar hakkatuv befarashat devarim (Devarim 2:13) "atta kumu veivru lachem et nachal zared" uchetiv (sham) "kumu seu veivru et nachal arnon", haddevarim yaggidu shello nasu al pi heanan, sheim haya al pi heanan ma makom ledivre moshe, halo kesheheanan nosea yisu velo haya tzorech lomar lahem "kumu veivru". vahagam sheamar hakkatuv (Bamidbar 9:20) "al pi Adonai yachanu veal pi Adonai yissau", ze haya bechol hammassaot chutz meellu. vehattaam efshar sheshshene hammassaot hallalu hayu achar shemmet aharon venistalleku anne chavod, vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (taanit 9.) shechazru bizchuto shel moshe, ulay sheheanan shehayu nosim vechonim al piv nishar mesullak bizman shennasu shene massaot hannizkarim.

rashi: Ebera na veartzecha. middarom letzafon, likkanes leeretz kenaan:
Vegam el melech moav. shehayta artzo besof eretz edom, bemizrachah shel edom uvidromah shel eretz yisrael:
Velo ava. moshe remazah battora (Devarim 2:29): kaasher asu li bene esav hayyoshvim beseir vehammoavim hayyoshvim bear, keshem sheedom lo netanum laavor, kach moav lo netanum laavor:
targum: Ushelach yisrael izgadin levat malka deedom lememar ebar kean bearach vela shema malka deedom veaf levat malka demoav shelach vela kabbel vitev yisrael birkam:

ohc: Ase lecha saraf. amar tevat lecha, razal amru (avoda zara 44.) veze leshonam: hare hu omer "lecha" – mishshellecha, veen adam oser davar sheeno shello, ad kan. perush, kevan sheasao moshe eno neesar kesheyyaavduhu dorot habbaim. veinyan ze anu lemedin oto mimma sheanu roim achar haemet, aval dochak lomar she amar lo kach laasoto mishshello kede shello yeaser baavodat dorot habbaim, vetzarich ladaat lamma tzivva Adonai ken. od yesh lehair lamma Adonai amar lo saraf uvammaase moshe kore oto nachash. od yesh ladaat taam inyan ze shetztzivva Adonai laasot nachash ulehistakkel bo, ma yoil histakkelut benachash lerappeot hanneshicha, verazal amru (rosh hashshana 29.): kol zeman sheyyisrael mistakkelin kelappe mala vechulei, ad kan, veim hayta hakkavvana baze lehistakkel kelappe mala levad, yoter haya rauy lehistakkel bashshamayim veaz tihye hakkavvana nikkeret leoseha beyoter mehistakkelut benachash.

Venire lefi ma shepperashti sheheenisham Adonai bannechashim hasserafim keneged shene avonot sheasu, sheddibberu belohim uvemoshe. laze baa hatteshuva meAdonai veamar lo ase lecha saraf, kan ramaz sheyyaase hannachash beseder sheyyihyu remuzim shene perate hachet, shehem sheddibberu baAdonai vedibberu bemoshe. keneged ma sheddibberu bemoshe amar ase lecha, perush keneged davar hannogea lecha, ucheneged perat hachet sheddibberu baAdonai amar saraf, perush bidmut saraf, ki tzorech haya baddavar sheyyihye bo hekker lishne devarim, shehem lashon hara sheddibberu belohim vegam ma sheddibberu bemoshe, mittaam asher avaer.

Venitchakkem moshe laasot hekker lemin chet sheddibberu bo, shehu bechinat hannachash, bema sheasao min hannechoshet, ki zulat ze en bedimyon hassaraf hekker lishne perate hachet. vehu ma sheamar vayyaas moshe nechash, perush perat ze shel nachash shehu hekker perat hachet sheddibberu bo, asao lesaraf minnechoshet velo middavar acher. nimtza dugemat hannachash hu keneged hekker hassaraf shehare hu dome lo bidmuto, vehammin shemmimmennu naasa shehu hannechoshet hu keneged hekker perat hannachash shemmimmennu hu.

Vetaam kol hammaase nire behair od, lamma lo hoila tefillato shel moshe lehasir hannechashim hasserafim velo yihye noshech lehitztarech lirfuato? ella vadday ze yaggid ki baal hammishpat bachan shello asu teshuva hammaspeket lahem. vahagam sheamru "chatanu ki dibbarnu baAdonai vavach", haikkar chaser vehu haaziva, velo matzanu sheamru "lo nashuv od laddavar hara hazze", velaze lo husar hannega. laze nitchakkem habbore venityaetz letakkenam al ze hadderech, ki mi shettikken atzmo karauy hinne hu nitztzol velo yishshechennu nachash, umi shello nitkan kammitztarech yishshechennu nachash leorro bitshuva, vetzivva alav lehabbit el nechash vegomer, uvaze yetakken atzmo vashav verafa lo.
Vehabbatatam lannachash tirmoz leshiva devarim:

Ha teshuvat haggader al ze hadderech: hinne mi gorem lannachash linshoch? hu chet bene adam, dichtiv (Kohelet 10:11) "im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash", uchesheen lachash yease hannachash domem kannachash asher elav yabbitu kesheyyinshechem nachash, vezo hi hearat habbatatam bannachash haddomem, lomar: el ze abbit laasot kemaasehu liddom milledabber od, uvaze osim azivat hachet.

2) Lehakkir chetam, al derech amro bazzohar (Tikkunei Zohar 13) al hahu chivya dimkannena bemigdala, shehu 100 hannimshal lenachash sheppitta techilla laadam, vehu ma shemmeir nachash bemakom gavoah, sheyyakkiru shehem sibba bema sheddibberu lashon hara lehachenis nachash bemakom gavoah. gam sheasu maase nachash shehu lashon hara bemakom elyon, sheddibberu belohim. gam yesh heara sheddibberu bemoshe birotam min machtzav shemmimmennu naasa hannachash.

3) Lehairam ma yakru devarim gevohim middevarim artziyyim, ki nachash shellematta memit venachash elyon mechayye, uvaze yargishu et asher dibberu raa al hamman shebba min hashshamayim shehu lechem hakkelokel uvocharim ballechem asher totzi haaretz, shealehem neemar (yeshaya 5,20) hoy omrim al hattov ra veal hara tov:

4) Lahairam bitshuva ma shehitraamu lamma heviam Adonai derech hammidbar sheen sham sippuk, velo heviam derech makom asher ragil heyot sham bar valechem – ki Adonai chafetz sheenehem yihyu teluyot lelohim yoshev bashshamayim al michyatam veal kol tzarchehem, been mivtach zulato. mehattaam atzmo shello hesir hannechashim vehinnicham lenashcham, veyihyu mitrappeim kesheyyistakkelu kelappe mala laavihem shebbashshamayim. vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 29.), ella shello pershu haheara shebbaddavar, shehi teshuva ledivre leshon hara sheddibberu lamma heviam el hammidbar, she chafetz baze kede sheyyihye libbam tamid been hefsek karov laAdonai keven hammetzappe leshulchan aviv erev vavoker uvechol et uzeman. veim haya meviam derech yishshuv, lo hayta lahem haddevekut bitmidut kesheyyihye mezumman lifnehem sippukam. uma meod yesovev davar ze harechakat hallev mehakkarat hashegachat habbore veyirat rommuto.

Adonai) lahashivam al ma shennichlal battaromet sheamru lamma heviam derech midbar, shekkavvanatam hi sheen somchin al hannes mittaam sheen hannes matmid. vetze ulemad mimma sheomrim hakkofrim befile Adonai, shemmevakshim chachmot kozvim lehachechish bannes velaasot haddavar derech teva, sheyyihye hammaase hahu beoto zeman, vechol hishtannut tiviyyot lo yatmid. veefshar sheshshoresh laana ze haya belev hamedabberim toa, laze tzivva Adonai laasot nes kavua, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19,23) shezzarak moshe hannachash hashshamayma veamad baavir vesham kana mekomo been somech, vehaya kol hannashuch yabbit elav veyakkir behachechashat daat toa shehayta lo mikkodem, veyaamin ki Adonai asher heviam lammidbar aso yaase nissim behatemada ad geder sheyyeshammeshu hannissim katteva haragil, vehaya hammidbar keyishshuv lechol hatztzorech.

6) Lehareotam koach hatteshuva, al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma 86:) shebbaale teshuva naasim lahem haaverot zechuyyot, ki lo levad mechilat hachet ella adrabba yaamod lo zechut, vehu ma sheheir bahabbata el nechash hannechoshet, lomar shehannachash nashach vehu atzmo keshehu bivchinat hashshetika, perush shello yedabber od hagam shekkevar dibber, ki chol min hannachash yedabber lashon hara, af al pi chen hu atzmo mechayye venehpach meraa letova:
7) Ki chafetz Adonai sheyyakkiru banim el bederech perat, shekkol echad mehanneshuchim yabbit lemala veyakkir benisso, uvaze yatzdiku hashegacha happeratit.

Vehaya kol hannashuch. amar vehaya leshon simcha al hanneshicha, letzad hattoaliyyot hannimshachot mehabbatat el nechash hannechoshet beshiva devarim asher yakkir bahem baal hannes kemo shekkatavnu. veamar kol hannashuch perush, afillu shekkevar haya nashuch kodem maase nechash hannechoshet. veamro vachay betosefet vav lehair gam al chiyyut hannefesh kesheyyakkir bannes uferatim harmuzim yatzdik atzmo veyichye chiyyut hagguf vechiyyut hannefesh.

rashi: Omrim lenafshi. al nafshi:
En yeshuata lo velohim sela. lefi shebba al eshet ish:
targum: Sagiin amrin lenafshi let purekana leh belaha lealmin:

rashi: Ani shachavti vaishana. libbi atum bidaga vafachad:
Hekitzoti. middeagati, ki vatachti ki Adonai yismecheni:
targum: Ana shechivet udemachet itaret metul daAdonai samich yati:

ohc: Kach et hammatte vegomer vayyikkadesh bam. parasha zo ravu aleha kol mefarshe hattora, vetarti vah leor beor hachayyim. vekodem shennaamod al peshatan shel ketuvim nakdim lehavin ma hayta shiggato shel moshe beinyan ze asher haya sibba ligzerato, veraiti shenneemru asara derachim bainyan bedivre mefarshe hattora vehen henna biktzara:

1) Rashi zichrono livracha peresh sheshshiggat moshe hayta ki Adonai amar alehem dabberu vehu hikka. 2) rabbi avraham ibben ezra peresh shehashshegaga hayta sheggaram shello natna hassela memeha ad hakkaa sheniyya, bema sheibbed hakkavvana befaam rishona letzad merivat haeda. 3) hevio hannizkar, ki hakepadat Adonai hayta al shehikka shete peamim, sheim haya makke paam achat lo hayta hakepada ki haddibbur lassela hi hahakkaa. 4) hevio hannizkar, shehakepadat Adonai hayta al shello amru shira al hammayim kemo "ali veer". Adonai) hevio hannizkar, shehakepadat Adonai hayta al sheamar livne el chay "hammorim", veen rauy leish chasid letaev ulezalzel bivne avraham yitzchak veyaakov vegomer. 6) harambam (bishmona ferakim) peresh ki hikpid Adonai alav al asher nitraggez al haeda, umissibba zo chashvu ki gam Adonai bechaas immahem, asher lo chen haya. 7) rabbenu chananel, vehiskim elav ramban, shehakepadat Adonai hayta al asher amar "notzi lachem mayim" velo amar "yotzi lachem", shemmizze tau yisrael vechashvu ki hem bechachmatam osim et hammaase, ki lo haya lahem remez ki Adonai hu haose hannes, velaze hikpid Adonai veamar "lo heemantem bi lehakedisheni" vegomer. 8) rabbi moshe hakkohen peresh shehakepadat Adonai hayta al maamar moshe "hamin hassela hazze" vegomer, vechavvanat moshe hayta letzad yechalto im lo bechoach hannedar, vechashvu haanashim shello yuchal Adonai lehotzi mayim min hassela, vezo hi shiggat moshe. vehevi reaya leferusho mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Tehillim 106:33) "ki himru et rucho vayvatte bisfatav" vegomer. 9) harav yosef albo besefer haikkarim yishshev shehakepadat Adonai hayta al shello nitorru moshe veaharon meatzman lehotzi lahem mayim vehayu maridim, shezze yore miut habbittachon vegomer. 10) baal maase Adonai shepperesh ki haya vikkuach ben moshe uven yisrael, sheyyisrael hayu rotzim lehotzi lahem mayim mimmakom acher shechafru oto hem, velo ratza moshe ledabber leoto sela shechafru hem, venitkaes moshe vezarak hammatte beyado lo lehakkot ella bechaas, uvederech mikre hikka hammatte bassela vechulei, ayyen sham devarav.

Hinne kol haasara derachim enam motziim otanu yede chovat haemet, vetze ulemad ma shettaan ramban al shelosha mehem udechaam, uma shettaan rabbi avraham ibben ezra al shelosha acherim udechaam. vaani toen al hashshear vehem, derech echad shel rabbenu chananel shebbachar lo ramban shehahakpada hayta al shekkinna leatzmo hammaase veamar "notzi" vegomer, halo yadua haya moshe lishlucho shel makom vechol maasav hinnam bechoach hael, velu yehi ki kocho shel moshe hu, halo miggedullat haeved gedullat haadon nodaat beferek merubba. veod, halo timtza befarashat bo el paro amar hakkatuv (Shemot 12:21): "vayyikra moshe lechol yisrael vayyomer alehem mishchu ukechu" vegomer velo amar beshem Adonai, ki vadday haddavar yadua hu ki hu shelucho shel makom. veod, bema shellefanenu muchrach haya lomar "notzi lachem" leheyot ki hem hammotziim bedibburam o behakkaatam she natan hahotzaa beyadam. vedarko shel hary albo en dati holmo, ki achar sheraa moshe she mana mehem mayim venistallek habbeer, ech yiggash lehotzi mayim ad asher yeda daat habbore baruch hu, umi yomar ki Adonai chafetz leyasseram? laze hechreach haya haddavar lehishtatteach lifne Adonai vaAdonai yaase hattov beenav. vedarko shel baal maase Adonai ala kullo kimmesonim veen bo lo melach velo tavlin, vekallani mizzeroi litroach lidchot haddevarim haddechuyim bimchila mikkevodo.

Vetarti li menucha bedivre harishonim zichronam livracha, vaemtza bammidrash (yalkut shemauni 764) veze leshonam: "yaan lo heemantem" vegomer – arba chataot ketuvim kan: lo heemantem, lo kiddashtem, mealtem, meritem. "lo heemantem" – shello amarti lachem lehakkot vehikkitem, "lo kiddashtem" – lehavi mayim mikkol sela sherotzim, "mealtem" – sheamartem "hamin hassela hazze", "meritem" – sheamarti lachem "vedibbartem el hassela" shene alav perek echad vaavartem al devaray, ad kan leshonam.

Veal pi midrash ze naamod al perush imre kadosh bemaamar kach et hammatte vedibbartem el hassela vegomer, vehotzeta lahem mayim min hassela, veyesh lehair: 1 lamma yetzav Adonai lakachat hammatte kevan shehotzaat mayim hu bedibbur levad, 2 lamma chazar lomar vehotzeta lahem mayim achar sheamar "venatan memav", 3 hutzrach lomar paam sheniyya min hassela velo hispik bezichronah besamuch.

Hinne lefi hammidrash nitgalla lanu kavvanat hakkatuv lemafrea al nachon, ki ma sheamar kach et hammatte hu lehormanuta demalka vehoraat heyot beyado koach elyon velo lehakkaa, velo chash letaut shehu lehakkaa mimma sheamar beferush "vedibbartem", umoshe lo asa chen vehikka, vehu chet harishon sheamar baal hammidrash. umaamar vedibbartem el hassela hu sheyyishne alav perek echad, vehu lo asa chen vehu chet hashsheni, umaamar vehotzeta lahem mayim min hassela venitkavven bemaamar ze lomar afillu missela acher keshehem chafetzim lehotzi lahem mimmenna hotzi lahem meezo sela sheyyirtzu, velaze gam ken hizkir paam sheniyya hassela velo samach lezichron harishona ki lo zot hu ma shehizkir, vehu lo asa chen, veharaya mimma sheamar lahem "shimu na hammorim", ze yaggid shehayu morim eze davar, umimma sheggamar omer hamin hassela vegomer yaggid ki hayu morim bassela lomar missela zo vehu omer "hamin hassela hazze" vegomer, perush, shessela ze eno rauy lehotzi mayim. nimtzeu beyad moshe shete shegagot acherim: 1 she amar hotzi lahem missela sheyyachpetzu vehu lo asa chen, 2 sheasa lahem hechlet haefshariyyut keamro "hamin hassela" vegomer, vehem hashshete chataot shemmana baal hammidrash sheni ushelishi.
Vechal alenu chovat gavra latet taam leish haelohim al arbaat hashshegagot asher eno rauy leachat mehenna.

Venire ki moshe amad al maamar Adonai bechachma, uletzad otzem yirato baAdonai shagag, veze yatza rishona: ma sheamar lo Adonai "kach et hammatte" hevin bo shene derachim – 1 lehakkaa ve lehormana ulechoach elyon beyado, shebbeemtzaut hammatte shebbo chakuk shem hammeforash yaase pele. vehaemet sheyyoter tzodek peshatan shel devarim al lehakkot bo, ki letaam hashsheni hu tzad rachok ketzat. vahagam shemmatzinu sheamar lo Adonai (Shemot 4:17) "veet hammatte hazze tikkach beyadecha asher" vegomer, sham haya ose peullot bammatte. vezichron hahakkaa ba bemaamar Adonai besamuch "vehotzeta lahem mayim min hassela", shello haya tzarich lomar achar sheamar "vedibbartem vegomer venatan memav", uchemo sheddiyyaknu lemala. vehevin moshe ki kavvanat Adonai hi lomar lo shello dibbur levad yaspik, ella koach hammaase sheyyaase shebbo yotzi mayim. uvaze gilla sofo al techillato ki lekichat hammatte hi laasot bah maase lehotzi hammayim min hassela. vahagam sheala al daat moshe perush shennitkavven lo Adonai kemo sheamarnu, shebba lomar sheyyotzi missela asher yachpetzu, hitta lefaresh perush ze letzad shekkadam lo maamar lekichat hammatte, lo nire beenav shettihye lekicha levad mibbeli asot bah davar. vahagam sheen hechreach ze hechreach, besamuch avaer al nachon taam hattayato lema sheasa. umaamar "vedibbartem" vegomer peshat hainyan hu millevad maase hammatte, od ki tzarich sheyyedabberu lah beferush "hotze memecha", vehu ma shehevin moshe, velo ala al dato ki maamar "vedibbartem" hu sheyyishnu alav perek echad.

Vehammaskil been hassechel yire ki hishtannut mashmaut maamar vedibbartem yishtanne kefi kavvanat maamar kach et hammatte, ki haddaat notenet sheen hassela baalat chay shettavin dibbur bene adam kesheyyedabber elav moshe, ella beechad mishshene derachim: o beemtzaut hakkaa bammatte asher bo shem hammeforash chakuk, yeorer koach hamechayye shebbah, kemo shepperashti bemakom acher sheen lecha batztzemachim sheen lo chelek chiyyuni kefi techunato, veoto yair behakkaat matte shebbo chakuk shem elyon kemo shekken hevin moshe; o al yede sheyyishnu alav perek echad shel tora, shehu chayye olam mippe kadosh, yeorer koach shebbaddomem umizze yitorer latet mayim. laze im nefaresh kichat hammatte shehi al hahakkaa en tzorech lishnot perek echad shezze hu hearato, veim nefaresh kichat hammatte enah lehakkot nitztarech lefaresh vedibbartem lishnot alav perek echad. velaze daat elyon kesheamar "kach et hammatte" shehayta kavvanato kicha levad, hayta kavvanato bemaamar vedibbartem lishnot perek echad, ma sheen ken moshe shehevin kichat hammatte lehakkot peresh vedibbartem kifshuto.

Veal kol panim lo neelmu meene moshe shete hadderachim bemaamar Adonai "kach et hammatte", aval perush "vedibbartem" shehu lishnot alav perek echad en ze peshatan shel devarim shello ala al daat moshe perush ze, vedan bedato nevi Adonai veamar: hinne lefanay shete derachim, veim ani ose dibbur levad velo hakkaa ani choshesh shemma happerush haamitti hu lehakkot, uma gam shehu yoter peshati, veod shehu davar rachok shehaddomem yitorer bedibbur ben adam kemo shekkatavti besamuch, laze im ani medabber belo hakkaa shello kederech sheamar Adonai en hassela noten memav veyitchallel shem shamayim chillul gadol leene haeda asher ani ose hannes leenehem veetchayyev roshi lammelech, laze yoter evchar lehakkot veatte leferush hayyoter tzodek bemashmaut maamar "kach et hammatte", vikuyyam gam ken maamar "vehotzeta lahem mayim" vegomer kemo shepperashti, velo hakkaa bilvad asa ella beshittuf haddibbur hikka veamar lassela: "ten memecha", uvaze en mechush shello titten hassela memeha velo yitchallel shem shamayim.

Gam hitta lefaresh kavvanat hammaamar vehotzeta lahem mayim shehu al hahakkaa, hagam shennichnas etzlo begeder safek shehakkavvana hu missela sheyyihyu chafetzim, mehattaam atzmo ki chash lapperush shehevin shehu lehakkaa, uma gam shehu yoter mutte kannizkar. veim ken kesheyyavo lehotzi missela acher afillu al yede hakkaa lo yitten memav, lichshennomar sheen kavvanat Adonai ella al sela hayyadua, uvaze yitchallel shem shamayim chas veshalom. laze evchar lehotzi mehassela hayyadua, uchemo sheddiyyek el elyon bemaamar venatan memav, shezze yatzdik sheal sela hayyadua shebbo mayim hu omer, vehu beerah shel miryam shemmana memav. vahagam sheamar achar kach "vehotzeta lahem mayim min hassela", perush min hassela hayyadua haamur besamuch, venimtza shekkol kavvanat moshe lo hayta ella lachush al devar kevod shemo yitbarach, veyatzta hashshegaga beones.

Uvaze matzanu taam lechol shegagotav shel moshe: taam shehikka – chash lema shennishma middivre Adonai shetztzarich hakkaa, veim ken belo hakkaa lo yitten memav venimtza mitchallel shem shamayim. uma shello shana perek echad – en ze peshat "vedibbartem", umoshe lo hevin ken, kevan shehevin shehammatte hu lehakkot uchemo shekkatavti lemala. vetaam shello hotzi mayim missela acher – kevan sheeno muchrach bemashmaut maamar "vehotzeta lahem mayim" sheal sela acher hu omer, yesh mechush shello yitten veyesh chillul hashshem gadol. gam chashav ki lamma yaase nes chadash lehotzi mayim missela acher been tzorech elav, vedavar yadua ki en osin nes ella letzad hechreach gadol. umeatta en lehaashimo al maamar "hamin hassela" vegomer kevan sheen hechlet bemaamar Adonai sheamar lo chen, laze keshebbau veamru hotze lanu missela ze, amar lahem shimu na hammorim – leshon hameraa uleshon horaa, ki hayu mitkavvenim lenassot koach elyon im yotzi mikkol sela o missela zo levad, vehayu morim lo lehotzi missela acher, vehikpid moshe al haddavar veamar vegomer.

Veal yera beenecha lomar shemmoshe lo hevin amittut kavvanat Adonai, ki en hanneviut baa lehatztzaddik beiyyun, velaze timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (bava batra 12.) chacham adif minnavi, uvema shellefanenu lo nelam meene moshe gam ken hammashmaut shennitkavven elav Adonai, ella shennafal lo safek bemashmaut acher, umishshum mechush kevodo yitbarach hitta lema sheasa kannizkar.

Veachar shemmatzanu taam lemaase navi, essa enay lehavin maamaro yitbarach behakepadato bemaamar yaan lo heemantem bi lehakedisheni, perush, attem asitem hahachraa letzad chashasha shehassela lo titten mayim ella im tihye hassela hayyadua vedavka al yede hakkaa, velo hichratem letzad kedushshat shemi lehakedisheni behotzaat mayim missela asher yirtzu hem uvelo hakkaa, shebbaze haya Adonai mitkaddesh leenehem kesheyyiru sheafillu haddomem kol shehu mafli laasot bedibbur levad uveheara bishnot aleha perek echad, vehaya lachem levattel hammechush beotzem haemuna sheheyitem tzerichin laasot.

Veomek haddevarim hu, sheim hayu moshe veaharon osim kiddush hashshem haggadol beemtzaut shehayta haeda gam ken kullah shelema vetzaddikim, hayu machlitim emunat Adonai belibbam shelema vehaya nigrash mehem chelek hara, vehaya koach bahem lehaamid emunatam ledore dorot. umeatta hayu moshe veaharon nichnasim laaretz vehaya moshe bone bet hammikdash veen chashash lehashelachat chamato al yisrael kesheyyihyu chotim, kaamur bedivrehem (midrash tehillim et) befasuk "mizmor leasaf" vegomer, uchetavnuhu bimkomot acherim. vechevan shebba tikkun haddavar al yedehem velo asauhu, nechlat haddavar.

Veamar Adonai lachen – perush, bishvil ze, gam leshon shevua shello yaviu vegomer, ki raa Adonai ma sheatidin laasot beacharit hayyamim beeretz yisrael, uchemo sheamar lahem moshe atzmo (Devarim 31:29) "yadati ki hashechet tashchitun", velaze im yikkanes moshe laaretz veyivne bet hammikdash yitztarech Adonai lehashelich alehem chamato kesheyyarshiu velo al bet hammikdash veyichlu kol yisrael chas veshalom, laze amar lachen lo taviu vegomer.

Vedikdek lomar et hakkahal hazze, amru bammidrash (yalkut shemauni 764) hazze enchem meviim, aval attem machnisim et kol yisrael leatid lavo, dichtiv "veanta shamma kime neureha" (Hoshea 2:17) – ze moshe veaharon, ad kan. umittochiyyut haddevarim nishma sheim hayu mekaddeshim shem shamayim leenehem, haya haddor hahu kedor shebben david ba, sheyyaavir Adonai et ruach hattuma umala haaretz dea et Adonai.

Vehishkita et haeda. dikdek lomar vehishkita bechinnuy, ulay shennitkavven leechad mishshene derachim: o lefi shehayu yisrael tzemeim lemayim yetzav Adonai lehashekotam keshiur shello yihyu nizzokin, ki zulat ze im yishtu kecheftzam lerov tzimonam lemayim yishtu harebe veyistakkenu veyamutu. o yirtze ki yashkem kechol hatztzorech velo yakpid al hezzekam, ki hammayim hahem nissiyyim hem bechol peratehem ben bahavayatan ben bifullatam, vehu amro vehishkita shehagam sheyyirtzu lishtot behistappekut atta hasheke otam kechol hatztzorech.

Vehutzrach lehazekir eda uveiram, lehakedim haeda labbehemot, vahagam sheamar hakkatuv "venatatti esev besadcha livhemtecha veachalta" vegomer veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 40.) shetztzarich lehakedim maachal livhemto veachar kach hu, kol ze im en sakkana baddavar, aval kesheyyesh geder sakkana chayyav kodmin. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat rivka (Bereshit 24,19) behashekaat eliezer ugemallav:

rashi: Beevrato. kanaf:
Yasech. yesochech:
Techse. titkasse:
Tzinna vesochera. hu tzinna hammakkefet et haadam karov learba ruchotav, sochera leshon sechor sechor (shabbat 13.):
targum: Bitlal shechinteh yatlal alach utechot telal yekareh titrechetz terisa vaagila hemnuteh:

rashi: Rabbim kamim alay. bene adam gedolim battora, gedolim bechachma, gedolim beosher, gedolim bekoma; kegon shaul (Shmuel 1 16:7) vilide harafa (Shmuel 2 21:16-22), doeg (Shmuel 1 21:8) vaachitofel (Shmuel 2 15:12):
targum: Adonai kama sagiin meikay sagiin dekaymin alay:

ohc: Vayyillachem beyisrael. taam amro beyisrael velo amar im yisrael, uchemo sheamar befarashat beshallach "vayyavo amalek vayyillachem im yisrael" (Shemot 17:8), nitkavven lomar ki hem hayu sibba lammilchama zo letzad chetam. gam ma sheamar besamuch vayyishb mimmennu shevi, perush mimmennu haya hassovev lishbot shivyo, vehachet hu shehem hayu sibba leheder hatztzaddik mechamat me meriva, dichtiv (Tehillim 106:32) "vayyaktzifu al me meriva vayyera lemoshe baavuram", velo lemoshe bilvad ella gam leaharon kammuvan mehainyan, ella shemmazkir moshe shehu haikkar.

Vayyishb mimmennu shevi vegomer. yesh lehair lamma lo chardu yisrael birotam sheam echad lakach miyyisrael shevi, veyomru im am echad asa bahem peretz ma yaasu bichnisatam laaretz, uchemo shemmatzinu shennitraggesh yehoshua keshehikku anshe haay gibbor echad miyyisrael kaamur sham (Yehoshua 7:4), vahagam ki achar kach nitatztzemu bitfilla unetanam Adonai beyadam, sof kol sof lo matzinu shennitraggeshu mikkodem.

Venire al pi divrehem (Bamidbar Rabba 19,20) sheamru sheam ze amalek haya, vahagam shehakkatuv kerao kenaani hu letzad shebba bemalbush kenaani, velaze keshehitpallelu yisrael sheyyittenehu beyadam lo amru titten et hakkenaani hazze, meatta letzad shello haya mishsheva ummot shennatan lahem Adonai lo nitraggeshu biroto notzeach bammilchama shehare en lahem mimmennu kelum. od nire shello nitraggeshu ella az keshennichnesu laaretz shehiggia zeman sheshshalem avon haemori, ma sheen ken kodem shennichnesu laaretz sheefshar sheadayin lo shalem avono kede sheyyittenehu beyad yisrael. verazal darshu baze harebe derashot.

rashi: Ad. asher bati el mikdeshe el. asher birushalayim, veraiti ma sheera besancheriv (Melachim 2 19:35-36), veaz hevinoti leacharit harshaim shehu laavaddon veamarti: ach kol hattova habbaa lahem chalakot hem, shehakkadosh baruch hu machalik lahem hadderech shellahem, shettehe nocha vachalaka, lemaan lo yittenu lev lashuv elav veyovdu:
targum: Ad zeman purekana deete levat makdeshe elaha etbeyan lesofhon:

ohc: Hemma me meriva vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar meriva asher ravu velo hispik lomar "hemma mayim asher ravu bene" vegomer, od meamro ravu et Adonai ze yaggid shemmedabber al yisrael, umeamro vayyikkadesh bam mashma shemmedabber al moshe veaharon.

Venire shehakkatuv ba latet taam lehakepadato yitbarach al kedushshat shemo beinyan ze, veamar hemma me meriva vegomer, umeriva zo matzdikah hakkatuv beamro asher ravu, perush shettaanu taana neged Adonai vetzadku betaanat merivatam. vayyikkadesh bam, perush asa Adonai devarim lehitkaddesh benehem, perush beyisrael, bema sheamar lemoshe ledabber el hassela asher yirtzu bene yisrael, shebbaze yiru koach hashshallit shehagam sheheviam bammidbar lo mekom vegomer umayim ayin, yotzi lahem bemaamaro mayim mikkol min sela asher tihye lifnehem. umoshe veaharon lo asu chen, lachen hikpid Adonai alehem veamar "lachen" vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bamidbar Rabba 19,5) vayyikkadesh bam bemoshe veaharon sheggazar alehem shello yaviu vegomer, veshivim panim lattora.

Vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe. hagam sheyyodim shekkol hanehagatam hi al pi Adonai veen moshe ose davar middato, af al pi chen hitraamu alav shehiskim al daat kono velo hippil techinnato lefanav lahaviam derech nachon lemoade ragel. venire ki divrehem kan lo hayu laasot gezera alehem kederech sheamru bammeraggelim (bammidbar 14:3) "lama Adonai vegomer nittena rosh venashuva mitzrayma", ella kemi shemmitraem al chavero asher lo tov asa, veze yikkare medabbere lashon hara. velaze shalach Adonai bahem nechashim midda keneged midda, keamram zichronam livracha (taanit 8.) shaalu lannachash vechulei.

Venafshenu katza vegomer. ulay shehirgishu letzad hassibbuv shel eretz edom vekatzra nafsham badderech, chashvu ki ze nisbav letzad heyot mezonam mehamman velo mehallechem. vehattaam, ki mitteva holche derachim leechol davar shehu ketzat kashe lehitakkel, ki beemtzaut hahalicha memaher lehitakkel, vechol shennitakkel tzerichin lemazon paam acheret. velaze keshehem ochlim lechem hem mitchazzekim veholchim bechoach, ma sheen ken baachilat hamman shehu davar ruchani vetechef mitakkel, veze yesovev sheyyihye lahem torach hadderech ki habbeten rekanit. velaze hikdim hakkatuv veamar lisbov et eretz edom vegomer, veze sibba leharegashat haam sheddibberu veamru en lechem vegomer, venafshenu katza ballechem hakkelokel, perush, shemmitkalkel techef umiyyad veeno shohe lehitakkel. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (bammidbar Rabba 19,21) ki hammedabberim hayu shiyyure haam shennigzera alehem gezera lamut bammidbar, shello haya lahem nachat ruach bammidbar vehayu katzim bechayyehem, ma sheen ken hannichnasim shehaya lahem nachat ruach bammidbar.

Al asher meritem et pi. lefi divre hammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba 19,9) shekkatavti lemala sheyyiched maamar meritem pi keneged asher amar lahem lishnot perek echad al hassela, bachar Adonai leyached perat ze lemitat aharon ki hu shiggayon shalem beerech aharon, shehagam shemmoshe lo shana, haya leaharon lishnot happerek, ucheshello shana hare himra et pi Adonai. aval al shelosha devarim harshumim bedivrehem lo haya ella maskim lemaase moshe, shehahakkaa moshe levaddo hikka, vehotzaat mayim missela shello hayu rotzim yisrael gam ken hu maase moshe ella shehiskim aharon, vechen maamar hamin hassela hazze hu divre moshe levaddo. vetimtza shepperat ze shel chet hamin hassela yichado Adonai lemoshe beshaa sheamar lo (Devarim 32,49) "ale vegomer umut vegomer al asher mealtem" vegomer shepperash bah maal, uledivre hammidrash maamar ze ba al perat chet amro hamin hassela shepperat, vedavar ze bifrat en chelek leaharon bo ki lamma yeanesh aharon im moshe amar dibbur bilti hagun, bishlama beinyan hassela uvehakkaatah hem devarim shebba shelichut meAdonai leaharon al yede moshe veyeanesh al shinnuy asher yaase bo, ma sheen ken im moshe yedabber devarim lo hagunim en aharon nitpas alav, ella shekkelalo Adonai im moshe letzad ikkar haddavar sheshshaggu bo yachad.

Im naton titten. kafal lomar naton titten, letzad shello hayu yodim eze am hu. laze amru im naton, perush, im hu bichlal hashsheva ummot hannetunim – ma tov, veim lav titten. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (midrash lakach tov kan) naton – hakkenaani, titten – hashshivya.

rashi: Avar bene ammon. el bene ammon:
targum: Usherat al yiftach ruach gevura min kodam Adonai vaavar yat gilad veyat menashe vaavar yat mitzpaya degilad umimitzpaya degilad avar bene amon:

rashi: Mizmor ledavid bevarcho. harebe derashot darshu bene aggada baddavar, verabbotenu amru (berachot 7:): mishsheamar lo hannavi "hinni mekim alecha raa mittoch betecha" (Shmuel 2 12:11) haya libbo soer shemma eved o mamzer yakum alay sheeno merachem alay, kevan sheyyada shebbeno hu samach. umidrash aggada: al sheraa tachsiso kayyemet, shehayu avadav vehakkereti vehappeleti, shehem sanhedrin, machazikim adanuto alehem; kesheamar lahem "kumu venivrecha mippene avshalom" (Shmuel 2 15:14), ma ketiv sham? "kol asher yivchar adoni hammelech hinne avadecha" (Shmuel 2 15:15); ucheshebba machanayim, "veshovi ven nachash umachir ben ammiel uvarzillay haggiladi" (Shmuel 2 17:27) yatzu likrato vechilkeluhu sham:
targum: Tushbachta ledavid bemaarkeh min kodam avshalom bereh:

ohc: Vesaraf et happara leenav et orah. hifsik bemaamar "leenav" ben zichron happara lezichron perateha shehem orah vegomer, yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bemassechet para (84), uchetavo rambam beferek 4 mehilchot para adumma, shemmitzvat serefatah shelema, veim hifshitah venittechah vesaraf kullah keshera, ad kan. laze hivdil hakkatuv bammaase hammuvchar veamar vesaraf et happara, perush, kullah yachad, vaafillu avar vehifshitah vechulei veasa orah levad uvesarah levad ufirshah levad gam ken lo hifsid, vehu maamar "et orah veet" vegomer.

Al pirshah yisrof. chazar lomar yisrof paam sheniyya, velo hispik bema sheamar battechilla "vesaraf", lefi ma shepperashti ki hakkatuv yedabber bishne sugim: haechad serefat happara shelema, vehashsheni achar shehufeshta venitnattecha, laze amar yisrof keneged chalukka sheniyya. od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru betosefta defara (perek 2) uchetavo rambam beferek 4 mehilchot para adumma veze leshono: paka meorah vechulei afillu missearah kazzayit yachzir, veim lo hechzir pesula, ad kan, vehu maamar yisrof paam sheniyya lomar shehagam sheppaka yachzir veyisrof leikkuva.

rashi: Al yede arnon. etzel arnon, shehayu mimmoav, veyadu shello haya lahem laavor alehem, shehare missichon kevashum (Bamidbar 21:24), shellekacham mimmelech moav (sham sham 26):

Shelosh meot shana. mishshekkavshu et haaretz bime yehoshua ad yiftach mikkan yesh lilmod shenot hashshoftim hannizkarim ad henna, im shene hashshibud shel kol umma nimnim betoch yeme hashshofet im lav. shaninu beseder olam (perek 12): yehoshua pirnes et yisrael esrim ushemone shana, veen lo mikra mimmi lilmod. atniel (leel 3:11), arbaim shana, ushene shibud shel kushan rishatayim (sham sham 8) bichlalam. acharav ehud (sham sham 30), shemonim shana, shemone esre shanim shibud shel eglon (sham sham 14) betocham, hare mea arbaim ushemone shana. devora (sham 5:31) arbaim shana, ushene shibud yavin (sham 4:3) betocham, hare mea shemonim ushemone. acharav, sheva shanim shel shibud midyan (sham 6:1), vearbaim shel gidon (sham 8:28), veshalosh shel avimelech (sham 9:22), hare matayim sheloshim ushemone shanim. acharav, esrim veshalosh shel tola (sham 10:2), veesrim ushetayim shel yair (sham 10:3), ella shealta shana achat lishnehem, ushemone esre shel bene ammon (sham sham 8) ad shello ba yiftach, hare shelosh meot:
targum: Kad yatev yisrael becheshbon uvechafranaha uvearor uvechafranaha uvechol kirvaya deal techume arnon telat mea shenin uma den la shezavtun beidana hahi:

ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer al gevul eretz edom vegomer. taam shehutzrach lomar al gevul vegomer, perush al sibbat haggaatam ligvul risha nistallek aharon. shuv ba leyadi midrash echad (yalkut shemauni Bamidbar tashesad) veze leshonam: "behitchabbercha larasha" vegomer – bishvil shennitchabberu leedom chasru tzaddik echad, ad kan. vehem haddevarim atzman sheramaznu bemaamar al gevul vegomer. ulederech ze yitbaer amro lemor, sheyyetzav Adonai lemoshe lomar leyisrael perat ze sheramaz bemaamar "al gevul", shehitchabberam larasha sibbev petirat hatztzaddik. vahagam shekkevar nigzera gezera zo alav, efshar shehaya chay od yamim. od lomar megalgelin chova al yede chayyav.

Uvederech remez, kevan sheaharon omed im moshe laggeulla haatida, keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat 10.) befasuk "veanta shamma kime neureha" shekkatavti lemala, ugeulla haatida hi miyyad edom shehi malchut 100, laze amar al gevul eretz edom, perush, al sibbat gevulam asher higbil Adonai ketz leedom limmaser beyad yisrael, laze sham yeasef aharon. vegamar omer el ammav lirmoz leammav haatidim lareshet eretz edom.

Nabera na veartzecha. velo amar "na nabera", im nefarshah leshon bakkasha nitkavven lehasemich habbakkasha leartzo shehi ikkar hashsheela sheyyihye hammaavar beartzo. veim nefarshah leshon zeman yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 44) sheechad mishshalosh ummot shennatan Adonai lezaro shel avraham hu edom, laze dikdek moshe bishlichut ze veamar shekkol hattenaim shehu matne al atzmo "lo nitte yamin usemol" vegomer, kol ze eno ella bahaavara shel atta, aval kesheyyaavru leatid lavo ki moshe hu asher haya moshia varav az lo yekabbel alav kol hattenaim ella lehorisham ulehummam velavoz bizzam, dichtiv (Ovadya 1): "bet yaakov esh vegomer uvet esav lekash" vegomer:

rashi: Lo tira. im tivtach bo:
Mechetz yauf yomam. shed hammeofef kechetz:
targum: La tidchal min delucha demazike deazlin belelya min girra demalach mota deshade vimama:

rashi: Shafteni. hakkemeni:
Miggoy lo chasid. hu edom, sheggar ben shene tzaddikim velo lamad mimmaasehem (sanhedrin lat:):
targum: Don yati Adonai bedin keshot vaalach lemintzi matzuti min ama dela zakkay min gevar nachil uteluma teshezvinani:

ohc: Vayyarev haam vegomer velu gavanu. perush, nitraamu alav shehitpallel alehem shello yamutu baddever.

rashi: Ach bachalakot tashit lamo. kol hattova habbaa lahem, shehare sofam hippaltam lemashshuot:
targum: Beram bekivlaya shavita lehon demitinun leshahvata:

ohc: Et hannechashim hasserafim. nire ki letzad sheyyisrael dibberu bemoshe vehosifu lachato ledabber belohim, shalach Adonai bahem ma shennoldu mechetam, ki kevar katavnu bimkomot acherim ki mehaavera yotze mazzik, uvaze taamod al amittat maamaram zichronam livracha (taanit 8.) sheamru: shaalu lannachash, ari dores veochel vechulei, atta ma hanaa yesh lecha? veheshiv: imru levaal hallashon, ad kan. perush teshuvato ki yesh min avera shemmimmenna yetze min nezek shebbo, vechan noldu mechattatam shene devarim: nachash vesaraf, nachash sheyyesh bo shinnayim memit adam vesoref hannefesh, vayshallechem Adonai bam, keamro vayshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hasserafim. veamar vayshallach al derech amro (Iyov 8:4) "vayshallechem beyad pisham". hannechashim hem keneged ma sheddibberu bemoshe, shekkol hamedabber lashon hara bachavero umikkol shekken berabbo nachash makkisho. vehasserafim hem keneged ma sheddibberu belohim. shuv raiti bammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba 19,22) veze leshonam: "hasserafim" shehem sorfim hannefesh, ad kan, veze mechuvvan lidvarenu.

rashi: Min ballahot. min shedim:
targum: Hechden havo letzado cheshata kalu ishtetzun min itragashyan:

ohc: Kaasher tzivvahu. hutzrach lomar ken, lomar shello nitakkev, ella samuch letziuuyo yitbarach lakach hammatte. od nitkavven lomar davar ze asa kaasher tzivvahu, veha lamadta shemma sheasa meaz vahala lo kaasher tzivvahu, uchemo shekkatavnu lemala sheshshagag beferusham shel devarim.

rashi: Ad yam suf. bidromah shel eretz edom, veeretz edom bidromah shel eretz kenaan:
targum: Are bemisakhon mimitzrayim vaazal yisrael bemadbera ad yama desuf vaata lirkam:

ohc: Az yashir yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat shira zo ma tivah, gam lamma lo amru shira al hamman kemo sheamru shira al hammayim, gam kol happarasha tzericha beur. veefshar ki shira zo al hattora amaruha, uvaze gam ken lo nikra tiggar al haddor hahu, lamma lo shorru shira chadasha keshennittena lahem tora morasha asher lah nava tehilla (Devarim 33:4), ki vadday hi zot shirat hattora shennikret beer mayim – nikret beer al shem hammakor shehi shechina elyona shennikret beer, gam lefi shehattora nimshela lemayim. veamro ali veer leshon aliyya ki lo al beer shellematta hem omrim ella al beer ali, perush elyon. enu lah al derech amro (Shemot 15:21) "vattaan lahem miryam", shehu derech hashshir.

Veamro chafaruha sarim vegomer – yitbaer al pi divrehem (Bereshit Rabba 64,8) sheamru ki beemtzaut esek hattora metakkenim makor elyon shennikra beer, vehattikkun hu kefi bechinat maalat haoskim battora. hatztzaddikim harishonim shehayu bemadrega gedola hem shechafru et habbeer vaasauha lishtot mimmenna, vehem haavot, besod (Bereshit 29:2) "vehaeven gedola al pi habbeer vayyagel et haeven vayyashk et hatztzon", umeaz hayta reuya hattora linnaten leyisrael, veodenna lo hayta bivchinat hahassaga lishtot mimmenna ad shekkaruha nedive haam, hem moshe asher horidah lanu, veamdu acharav mekabbelim mimmennu zekenim uneviim veanshe keneset haggedola ufershuha vegillu matzpuneha. vehu amro karuha nedive haam, ki tora shebbichtav belo tora shebbeal pe en adam yachol lishtot mimmemeha.

Veamro bimchokek bemishanotam, hu ma shehosifu lechaddesh battora chachme haddorot, veen ze ella kechokek bah chakika, veeno kemiddat harishonim shechafru vecharu, vegam ze eno ella bemishanotam shel rishonim, shekkol dikduk vedikduk sheyyedakdek battora tzarich lefarsho al pi divrehem, vechol davar shello yihye meyussad al pi divre hakkadmonim en lismoch alav.

Veamro umimmidbar mattana – perush, ma shezzachu nochaleha lo zachu ella letzad shehayu machshivin atzman kemidbar, uchemo shepperashnu befasuk (Shemot 19:2) "vayyachanu bammidbar" shehattora enah niknet ella beemtzaut haanava vehashshiflut. veamro umimmattana nachaliel shebbeemtzaut hattora shennittena lanu nachal otanu el, dichtiv (Devarim 32:9) "yaakov chevel nachalato". gam yirtze shennachalnu el lihyot meyuchad lanu leloah, dichtiv (Tehillim 135:4) "ki yaakov bachar lo yah". gam sheshshachan betochenu veazav mador elyon.

Veamro uminnachaliel bamot, perush, umeemtzaut davar ze shennachalnu el – bamot, naasenu bemadrega elyona al hammalachim, shebbachar banu Adonai yoter mehem. veamro umibbamot haggay asher vegomer, yitbaer al pi ma shekkadam lanu sheikkar tachlit sechar haadam bemitzvotav veashrav enam ella baolam haelyon, aval baolam hazze eno mekom hassagat osher haruchani.

Umeatta hechreach hu lehistallek haadam min haolam hazze lehishtallem gemulav keyad Adonai hattova. uma sheanu roim shehammita nisbeva al chet haadam shezze yaggid shezzulat ze haya haadam chay tamid, vetomar im ken yihye haadam chaser gemulo hattov, laze amru baale hassod ki zulat hachet haya haadam ole larakia vedar baaliyya uvechatzer, veze lecha haot eliyyahu hannavi sheala hashshamayma lehishtallem gemulo velo taam taam mita. vehagguf hen emet sheeno yachol laamod baaliyya haelyona hagam shennizdakkech hagguf veamad begeder ruchani af al pi chen beerech ruchaniyyut elyon yechashev legeshem, ella sheamru zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 1 209.) bemaase eliyyahu zichrono livracha ki behaggio legalgal chamma sham nifshat miggufo vehinniach oto begalgal chamma ucheshehu yored lematta lovsho veyored bo. veamru zichronam livracha od shekkeshennatan Adonai tora leyisrael behar sinay naasu yisrael bene chorin mehammita, vechazru lihyot keadam kodem shechata, dichtiv "charut al halluchot", veamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 41,7): al tikre charut ella cherut, cherut mimmalach hammavet, vechevan shekken beet haggia tachlit shelemutam hayu olim guf venefesh ufoshtim gufam begalgal chamma keeliyyahu, vehu maamar hakkatuv kan umibbamot haggay perush, mimmadrega haelyona shehissagnu beemtzaut hattora yesh od hassaga acheret mitztzad davar ze shehu haggay, shehi yeridat gashmenu baggay shehi hakkever, asher bisde moav shehaaretz tikkare sade, veamro moav shebberaah av haolam.

O yirmoz lehaishsha shennikret gam ken sade, kaamur bedivrehem (Zohar chelek 1 36:), vehakkavvana hi al ze hadderech: haggay asher ba mippeat haishsha shehi chavva, shebbaa meav kol hannivraim shellekachah Adonai mitztzalotav, veen ishsha baolam shebbaa kederech ze mitztzalot haadam ki im zot, vehi hayta sibbat hammavet lehappil haatzamot baggay. meatta, meemtzaut hassagat hattora yachzor haddavar lekadmuto kodem shechata chavva, veyihye hagguf kemo shehaya baggay lemala.

Veen ani yodea geder makom ze shehu omer "rosh happisga", sheamarnu bimkom galgal chamma, vehu amro rosh happisga, shemma hu lemala bimkom hanneshamot. laze amar venishkafa vegomer al pene haolam hazze shehu nikra yeshimon, leshon shemama, sheatid lihyot shamem. o nikra chen lefi sheshsholet bo yetzer hara hashshomem et hannivraim. vee ze makom shehu nishkaf al panim shel olam hazze – hu galgal chamma, sham yunnach ma shehaya rauy lihyot baggay. venimtza ki beemtzaut toaliyyot hattora kammitztarech yussag lehanechil hannefesh vehagguf bachayyim.
Chassalat parashat chukkat

Unetattem otah. amar otah, lefi ma sheamru razal (para 4:1) shemmippi hashshemua lamdu sheshshear parot naasot ben bechohen gadol ben bechohen hedyot, diyyek lomar "otah el elazar", aval mikkan ulehala en chiyyuv bassegan.

rashi: Et kol devarav. hattenay shebbenehem:
Lifne Adonai bammitzpa. lemakom shenneesfu kullam, shehashshechina shora al rov tzibbur:
targum: Vaazal yiftach im save gilad umaniu ama yateh alehon leresh ulerabba usedar yiftach yat kol pitgamohi kodam Adonai bemitzpaya:

rashi: Vayyirshu vegomer mearnon vead hayyabbok. sheatta omer shehu shellecha (pasuk 13), hem missichon lakchu:
Umin hammidbar vead hayyarden. midbarot hayu sham lifne hayyarden:
targum: Viritu yat kol techum emoraa mearnona vead yuveka umin madbera vead yardena:

rashi: Shelach orcha vaamittecha. melech hammashiach shennidma leor, shenneemar (tehillim 132:17) "arachti ner limshichi", veeliyyahu hannavi shehu amitti, navi neeman:
Yanchuni. minteront moy belaaz:
targum: Shedar nehorach vehemnutach hinun yedabberunani yealun yati letur bet mukedasha umedreshe bet shechintach:

rashi: Middever umikketev. shemot shedim hem, ze mazzik ballayla veze mazzik batztzohorayim (fesachim ki:):
Yashud. "yeshoded" (Hoshea 10:2):
targum: Min muta di vekivla mehalech misiat shedin dimchabbelin betihara:

ohc: Al ken yeamar vegomer. razal darshu shete derashot bakkatuv: 1 (kiddushin 30:) shehakkatuv medabber bemilchamtah shel tora shehi milchemet Adonai, shehagam shennaasim sonim ze laze bahalacha naasim ohavim levassof, vehu maamar et vahev besufa. 2 (berachot ned.) ki shene anashim metzoraim hayu beyisrael, echad shemo "et" veechad shemo "vahev", vehayu mehallechim besof hammachane letzad heyotam metzoraim, vehayu modiim hannes shehayu osim pegiat heharim vechulei, ad kan.

Venire lefaresh hakkatuv bederech peshat, ki kevan shehizkir arnon gevul moav veamar aleha ki arnon gevul moav, perush veen lahem bo leyisrael chelek, laze gamar omer al ken yeamar besefer, perush bassefer asher lifne Adonai beinyan hammilchamot asher yanchil laammim umotzi mizze venoten laze, vesham gam ken yeamar asher yanchil Adonai et yisrael mehaummot kaasher hivtiach lehaavot, veamar yeamar ki sham bassefer yeamar al gevul ze sheyyittenu leyisrael besofa, velo bazzeman hahu ella bevo meshichenu az yanchilenu Adonai moav ugevulo shehu echad mehashshelosha hannisharim lanu linchol otam shehem hakkeni vehakkenizzi vehakkadmoni (Bereshit 15:19).

Uferush tevat vahev mitparesh bishte derachim: haachat leshon ahava, al ze hadderech ki Adonai ahav letittah besof velo atta, o leshon netina al derech (Daniel 2:21) "yahev chachmeta lechakkimin". umatzinu shehakkatuv yedabber lifamim teva bilshon targum, kemo (Bereshit 21:7) "mi millel leavraham", "veata merivvot kodesh" (Devarim 33:2).

Veamro veet hannechalim vegomer, perush, ba lesadder haggevul shel moav shekkatuv besefer milchamot Adonai sheatid Adonai latet lanu, veamar "veet hannechalim" shel arnon gam ken bichlal hannittan leyisrael, gam eshed hannechalim asher nata vegomer:

Velama havetem vegomer. taromet sheniyya: lamma hevium derech midbar shehu mekom sakkanat mitat tzama, shehaya lahem lehaalotam shello al derech hammidbar. vehakkavvana baze, kevan sheen koach beyad moshe latet lahem mayim bammidbar, al mi samach lahaviam derech sham?

Veamram velama heelitunu vegomer, perush, veim tashivu otanu ki en derech muvtach lehaavir etchem bo ella derech midbar, o hechreach haya haddavar shettaavru derech midbar, laze nitraamu veamru: im ken lo haya lachem lehaalotenu mimmitzrayim, kevan shehu muchrach lehavi otanu el hammakom hara hazze sheyyesh bo sakkana sheeno mekom zera vegomer, keamram zichronam livracha (chullin pach:) midbar eno maale tzemachim.

Veamru el hammakom beHei hayedia, lomar shemmiddot raot shebbammidbar yeduot hem sheeno makom vegomer, umayim ayin lishtot perush afillu lishtot shehu davar hahechrechi veattem enchem yecholin lehametzi lanu mayim. velo haya maane befi moshe, veamad bitfilla lifne Adonai hu veaharon, dichtiv "vayyippelu al penehem".

Hitpallel vegomer veyaser vegomer. perush hitpallel limchol hachet, vehinne yishtanne mechilat hachet kodem sheyyetze hammechabbel leachar sheyyatza, sheaz hagam shennimchal hachet tzarich zechut lehasir hammazzik, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat lev.) veze leshonam: leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim kodem sheyyechele, sheim yechele omrim lo have zechut vehippater. laze nitchakkemu dor dea veamru keneged ma shetztzarich zechut lehatztzalatam mehannechashim, "veyaser" perush sheyyitpallel gam ken laAdonai bizchuto shel moshe lehasir vegomer:

Et hannachash. nitkavvenu lomar sheyyasir afillu hezzek hakkatan shehi akitza hahoreget, veim hayu omrim et hassaraf o nechash hassaraf haya nishma sheal perat nachash shehu soref et hannefesh hu shemmakpidim, aval im yamut kederech haolam enam mevakkeshim mimmennu, talmud lomar et hannachash afillu perat hannachash shehu haonesh hammechuvvan keneged ma sheddibberu bemoshe, gam dikdeku lomar lashon yachid shello yishshaer afillu nachash echad ki echad yachol lehamit kamma vechamma:

Vayyomer Adonai. kashe lema shekkadam lanu ki leshon amira yore al devarim hammesaadim et hallev ugedulla vechavod yevasser, vechan roani shello amar ella besorat gezera raa. veyitbaer al pi ma sheamru bammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba 19,12) sheamar moshe lifne Adonai: hare gazarta alay lamut bammidbar im haddor hara hazze vechulei, yomru haddorot sheani shave lahem, yikkatev alay al ma neenashti, lefichach ketiv yaan lo heemantem bi vegomer, ad kan. vehu ma sheramaz Adonai beamro vayyomer leshon rommut lemoshe uleaharon, shennichtav chetam shealav metu shehu "yaan lo" vegomer, velo yachshevu haddorot shehem shavim laddor hara chas veshalom.

targum: Vaavar yiftach levat bene amon leagacha kerava vehon umesarinun Adonai bideh:
Vaana la chatet lach veat aved imi bisha leagacha kerava vi yedin Adonai daavad dina yoma den ben bene yisrael uven bene amon:
Arum ant hu elaha usheni lema shevaktani lema chakir ezel bidchok bael devava:
Vaamar malka divne amon leizgade yiftach are nesiv yisrael yat ari bemiskeh mimitzrayim mearnona vead yuveka vead yardena uchean atev yathen bishlam:
Vaamar yiftach lesave gilad im metivin attun yati leagacha kerava bivne amon veyimsar Adonai yathon kodamay ana eheve lechon leresh:
Kali kodam Adonai atzale yekabbel tzeloti min tur bet makdesheh lealmin:
Uchean hatav tav at mibbalak bar tzippor malka demoav hamedan dan im yisrael im kerava agiach behon:
Vekayem yiftach keyam kodam Adonai vaamar im mimsar timsar yat bene amon bidi:
Vaamaru save gilad leyiftach bechen kean tavna levatach utehach imana vetagiach kerava bivne amon utehe lana leresh lechol yatve gilad:
Veosif od yiftach ushelach izgadin levat malcha divne amon:
Uchean Adonai elaha deyisrael tarich yat emoraa min kodam ameh yisrael veat medame lemerteh:
Kol mechla tarchik nafshehon umatyan ad maalane mota:
Vela hemin sichon yat yisrael lemebar bitchumeh uchenash sichon yat kol ameh ushero beyahtza veagiach kerava im yisrael:
Veyiftach gilada hava gibbar chela vehu bar itteta punedkita veolid gilad yat yiftach:
Hala yat deyachseninach kemosh taavatach yateh tachsin veyat kol detarech Adonai elahana min kodamana yateh nirat:
Viledat ittat gilad leh benin ureviu vene itteta vetarichu yat yiftach vaamaru leh la tachsen bevet avuna are bar itteta ochari at:
Vetzalu kodam Adonai kad ayek lehon mimikathon yifrekinun:
Vahava kad agichu kerava bene amon im yisrael vaazalu save gilad lemidbar yat yiftach meara tav:
Ushelach yiftach izgadin levat malka divne amon lememar ma li velach are ateta levati leagacha kerava beari:
Vaamaru leyiftach ita utehe lana lerabba unegiach kerava bivne amon:
Yeshader pitgame asuteh veyase yathon vishezev milchabbalutehon:
Vaarak yiftach min kodam achohi vitev beara tava veitkenishu levat yiftach gavrin serikin unefaku imeh:
Vaamar yiftach lesave gilad hala attun senetun yati vetarichtuni mibbet abba uma den atetun levati kean kad akat lechon:
Ushelach yisrael izgadin levat sichon malka deemoraa malka decheshbon vaamar leh yisrael nebar kean bearach ad atri:
Vaamaru save gilad leyiftach memra dayya yehe sahid benana im la kefitgamach ken nabed:
Veant Adonai teris ale yekari umerim reshi:
Vela kabbel malka divne amon lefitgame yiftach dishlach levateh:
Umesar Adonai elaha deyisrael yat sichon veyat kol ameh bida deyisrael umechonun viret yisrael yat kol ara emoraa yatev ara hahi:
Vihe deyippok mefak bar midashe veti lokodamuti kad etuv bishlam mibbene amon vihe kodam Adonai veaskineh alata:
Vaamar leh kidnan amar yiftach la nisiv yisrael yat ara demoav veyat ara bene amon:

bart: Hammakdish nechasav. usetam hekdesh levedek habbayit:
Vehayu vahem devarim haruyim lekarbenot tzibbur. kegon ketoret, o yenot, shemanim uselatot:

Yinnatnu laummanin bischaran. veyotzin lechullin, af al pi sheen davar acher nichnas tachtav. dekasavar hekdesh mitchallel al hammelacha, dichtiv (Shemot 25) veasu li mikdash, shettihye hammelacha naaset min hahekdesh:

Enah min hammidda. kelomar en midda zo sheatta omer kammidda haamura leel bakketoret, veen rauy ella shettashve middotecha. hilkach mafrishim mehen sechar haummanim kulei‏ kidamrinan leel gabbe motar hakketoret. sheen hekdesh mitchallel al hammelacha. vahalacha keven azzay:

Rabbi yehuda ben bava heid. shemmemaanim et hakketannot. kegon shene achim nesuim shete achayot yetomot, achat gedola veachat ketanna, met balah shel gedola venimtzet zekuka leyavam baal hakketanna, vedocha zikkatah et nissue achotah hakketanna veosartah alav, sheen nissue ketanna kelum, melammedim et hakketanna shettemaen bo, umeun oker nissuim harishonim, umuttar leyabbem haggedola. vechen yesh acheret kayyotze bezo bemassechet yevamot perek bet shammay:
Veshemmassiin et haishsha. shehalach balah limdinat hayyam uva ed echad bilvad veamar shemmet, massiin otah al piv:

Veshenniskal tarnegol sheharag et hannefesh. shennikker mocho shel tinok. veaf al pi dechi yiggach shor ketiv, echad shor veechad kol behema chayya vaof, shekkol makom shenneemar shor anu lemedin shor shor mishshabbat, ma lehalan hu haddin lechol behema chayya vaof, af kan hu haddin lechol behema chayya vaof:
Veal hayyayin ben arbaim yom. umikkamme hachi pasul, dahava leh yayin miggitto:

Shekkarav bearba shaot. sheppaam achat bime malchut yavan lo hayu lahem kevasim lattemidin venishtahu lehakeriv hattamid, ad sheheir hakkadosh baruch hu et enehem umatzu shene telaim mevukkarim belishkat hattelaim, vehikrivu tamid shel shachar bearba shaot bayyom:
Kikkerot hakkodesh. kegon shete hallechem velechem happanim umenachot vechayyotze bahen:

Shebbetoch gummotehen mayim hamekuddashim. shehayu betoch haggummot sheal gabbe hakkikkar mayim shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh, venitma kikkar echad besheretz, venaga hakkikkar shennitma bashsheni, vehashsheni bashshelishi, vaafillu hen mea kullan temeim, veaf al pi shello nagu bammayim shebbakkikkar ella naga kol kikkar bachavero, nitmeu kullan, shechibbat hakkodesh osa keillu hammashke shebbetoch kol kikkar shehu naasa techilla hu shennaga bakkikkar vetimmeo. aval batteruma eno ken, ella hakkikkar harishon hannitma bashsheretz bilvad metamme et chavero lihyot sheni, vehashsheni posel et hashshelishi, vetu lo, velo chayshinan lemashke shebbetoch haggumma:

Im yesh ben hakkikkarot mashke tofeach af batteruma kullan temeot. hammashke tofeach shebben kol kikkar vechikkar chozer lihyot techilla, umetamme hakkikkar shehu nogea bo laasoto sheni, vechen leolam. perush acher, kikkerot hakkodesh hammunnachot betavla haasuya gummot gummot, vechol kikkar munnach betoch gumma shello. vehammayim hamekuddashim garsinan, perush, vechen hammayim hamekuddashim hammunnachim bichli heasuy gummot gummot, im nitma echad mehen besheretz, nitmeu kullan, shehakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma, devatteruma eno metamme ella rishon vesheni ufosel shelishi hecha denagu ze baze, veen keli metzaref. veim yesh ben haggummot mashke tofeach hakkol tame, shehakkikkar shehu sheni ose hammashke rishon vechozer umetamme kikkar haacher, vechen kullam:
Nivlat of tame. sheen sofah letamme tuma chamura, sheenah metammea adam uvegadim:
Tzericha machashava. sheyyachashov aleha laachila:
Vehechsher. mayim o shear mashkin, veachar kach tigga besheretz:
Lifsol et haggeviyya. im nitmet veachal mimmenna chatzi peras shehi betza umechetza, nifsal gufo leechol batteruma ad sheyyitbol:

Veen bah kazzayit bevet habbelia. dichtiv (sham 22) nevela uterefa lo yochal letama vah, mi sheissuro mishshum ochel nevela metamme baachila bevet habbelia, yatza ze sheen issuro mishshum bal tochal nevela ella mishshum bal tochal davar tame:

Vehaochlah en taun heerev shemesh. haochel chatzi peras mimmenna leachar shennitmet, shehu posel et haggeviyya leechol batteruma, im taval leachar sheachalah muttar batteruma miyyad veen taun haarev shemesh:
Veen chayyavim aleha al biat mikdash. im achal chatzi peras nivlat of tame venichnas lammikdash. detuma derabbanan hi, af al gav desorfin aleha teruma:

Vehaochel evar min hachay mimmenna eno sofeg et haarbaim. veaf al gav deochel kazzayit ben basar vegidim vaatzamot, dehashta afillu leman deamar evar min hachay tzarich kazzayit daachila ketiv beh, hacha ikka kazzayit, afillu hachi eno sofeg et haarbaim. umishshum tame lo michayyav, delekka kazzayit basar:

Veen shechitatah metahartah. baachila, leven noach shemmuttar beof tame veasur beevar min hachay, veim shechatah vehi mefarkeset lo tiharattah shechitatah baachila ad shettamut, af al gav devithora afillu mefarkeset matteret hashshechita leven noach miggo demikkashshera leyisrael. vehachi mipparsha matnitin beshilhe perek gid hannashe:

Adam shehu natun tachat hassedek. achsadra shennisdeka tikratah venechleka lishnayim, vechelim mitztzad ze vetuma mitztzad ze, hakkelim tehorim, sheavir hassedek mafsik vegorem sheen hattuma overet latztzad hashsheni. veim adam natun sham baaretz beritzpat haachsadra keneged hassedek:
Bet shammay omrim eno mevi et hattuma. sheen mevi et hattuma ella davar sheyyesh bo chalal tefach:
Uvet hillel omrim adam chalul hu. veaf al pi shebbene meav betocho, chalal shebbetoch hagguf chashev chalal tefach:

Betza shennolda veyom tov. beyom tov shel achar shabbat askinan. vetaamayhu devet hillel deamre lo teachel, mishshum dechol betza demityalleda haidna meetmol gamra la, venimtzet shabbat mechina leyom tov, vehattora amra (Shemot 16) vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu, usetam shishshi chol hu, chol mechin leshabbat vechol mechin leyom tov, deyom tov nammi ikre shabbat, veen yom tov mechin leshabbat velo shabbat mechina leyom tov. vahachana devetza af al gav devide shamayim hi mikkarya hachana:

Seor bechazzayit. leinyan achila chulle alma lo felige deze vaze bechazzayit, middefatach hakkatuv bisor, seor lo yimmatze bevattechem (sham 12), vesiyyem bechametz, ki kol ochel machmetzet, lomar lach zehu seor zehu chametz, kaze ken ze. ki felige leinyan biur, bet shammay savre middechatav rachamana letarvayhu seor vechametz, shema minna shiuro shel ze lo keshiuro shel ze, velo yalfinan biur meachila. uvet hillel savre yalfinan biur meachila:

Parato yotza birtzua shebben karneha. lenoy. veamru chachamim masseoy hu veeno tachshit lah. velo parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta, ella shel shechento, veal shello micha bah nikret al shemo:
Umekardin beyom tov. kemin megera ketanna shel barzel sheshshinneha dakkot umechakkechin umegardin bah et habbehema, veaf al gav daavid chabbura:
Barechayim shellahen. ketannot haasuyot lechach:
Mekartzefim. bimgera shel etz sheshshinneha gassot veen osin chabbura:

Af lo mekartzefim. degazrinan kirtzuf attu kerud. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya ella bimkardim et habbehema bilvad, mishshum divha kam leh beshittateh derabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkavven muttar, vekayma lan kevateh. vachachamim diflige aleh savre kerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkavven asur, veen kach halacha:
Shennitmeu achorav. bemashkin temein. delishar tohorot lo nitma tocho, aval lechattat eno chen:
Hazzog vehainbal chibbur. sheim hizza al echad mehen, chavero tahor. vezog hu happaamon, veinbal hu happattish shebbifnim hammakke vappaamon sheal yado mekashkesh:
Kush shel rovan. pelech shettovin bo arbi, hu haggemi sheosin mimmennu machtzelaot:
Lo al hakkush velo al happika. kelomar lo yazze lo al ze levaddo velo al ze levaddo, delo havu chibbur. aval tzarich lehazzot al shenehen:
Pika. ma shemmesimin besof hakkush lehachebido karuy pika. belaaz 382:

Veim hizza. al echad mehen bilvad, muzze. verambam peresh, lo al hakkush velo al happika, ella al kene habbarzel shergilin latet berosh hakkush shennikra tzinnora. vealav mazzin mippene shehu ikkar hakkeli, veola hahazzaa lakkush velappika:
Shel pishtan chibbur. shehappelech shettovin bo fishtan darko lihyot happikka mechubberet bakkush:
Or shel arisa. or shemmesimin baarisa shel katan vedarko lihyot mechubbar baarisa:
Hammalben. kemin kearot shel etz chakukot shemmachnisin bo chare hammitta shello yerakvu millachluchit haaretz. vedome lo beferek hammocher et habbayit bevava vatra, malbenot shel kare hammitta:
Eno chibbur lo letuma. deim nitma ze lo nitma ze:
Velo letohora. deim hizza al ze lo hizza al ze:

Hakkeduchot chibbur. kegon yedot hassakkinim shehabbarzel nichnas letoch habbet yad shel etz o shel etzem umechubbar bo have chibbur, nitma echad mehen nitma chavero, vechen im hizza al echad mehen hizza al chavero. keduchot, leshon makdeach:

Af hacharukot. leshon vayyacharku shen (Eicha 2), kelomar af hayyadot shehen chaddot beroshan umachnisan chuddan bannekev sheosin berosh hakkeli, kegon bet yad shel romach, af ellu havu chibbur. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Hashsheni shebbechullin metamme mashke chullin. dechol happosel et hatteruma metamme mashkim lihyot techilla:
Metamme mashke kodesh. dechol happosel et hakkodesh metamme mashkin (kodesh) lihyot techilla lakkodesh:

Shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh. kelomar, ha deamrinan dishlishi shel teruma posel velo metamme ochale kodesh, hane mille keshennaaset al tohorat hakkodesh. aval naaset al tohorat teruma, shello shemarahu al tohorat hakkodesh, hashshelishi metamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh. shettohoratah shel teruma tuma hi etzel hakkodesh, vahare ze hashshelishi ditruma chashuv etzel hakkodesh keillu nitma bashsheretz atzmo:

Zecharim yimmachru letzarche olot kulei‏ udemehem yippelu im shear hannechasim levedek habbayit. desavar setam hekdesh levedek habbayit, vaafillu bemide dachazi lammizbeach, aval harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach, shehammakdish temimim levedek habbayit en nifdim ella lammizbeach, vehaddamim yippelu levedek habbayit:

Veyavi vidmehen olot. kasavar mide dachazi lemizbeach mistama lammizbeach akdeshinhu, hilkach zecharim atzman yikkarvu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzarche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot, aval hen atzman en kerevin shelamim, dehammakdish nechasav dato sheyyihyu kullam legavoah, hilkach behemot sheruyot likkarev olot yikkarvu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzarche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot, dechevan diruyot lammizbeach chala alehen kedushshat mizbeach, vaafillu al hannekevot sheen gufan rauy lema sheddato lehakedishan, kevan dilshem karban miha chazyayn, lo chal alehen kedushshat bedek habbayit, veyavi bidmehem olot:

Shehammakdish beferush. sheamar behema unechasay lahekdesh. dechevan shehifrishan vehivdilan zo mizzo veaf al pi chen lo amar behema lammizbeach unechasay levedek habbayit, shema minna dedato haya shebben behema uven nechasav hakkol yelech el makom echad. aval hammakdish setam kol nechasav, dato lehakedish kol davar lema shehu rauy. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Metzarfin shekalim ledarkonot. bene hair shekkibbetzu shiklehem yecholim lehachelifam baddarvonot. vehu matbea shel zahav kedichtiv beezra darkemone zahav, lehakel mealehem masseoy hadderech:

Shofarot. tevot sheppihen tzar lemala, keen shofar sheppiv tzar millemala veholech umarchiv, kede shello yuchelu littol mehen kelum. kehahi dichtiv bihoyada (Melachim 2 12) vayyaasu aron echad vayyittenuhu behechal vechulei‏ vayyikkov chor bedalto. vehayu omdim baazara, vechol echad mevi shiklo venoten bo:
Kach hayu bammedina. birushalayim. uledivre rambam bishar are yisrael:
Bene hair sheshshalchu shiklehem. beyad shaliach leholicham lallishka:
Im nitrema hatteruma. shehayu regilim litrom mehakkuppot letzorech hakkarbanot. vehayu tormim al haggavuy veal heatid ligbot, kede sheyyihye chelek bakkarbanot af leotam sheadayin lo shaklu:
Nishbain. hashsheluchim:

Laggizbarim. dehoil venitrema teruma al hammaot hallalu kodem shenneevdu hare naasu keillu hayu birshut haggizbarim mishshaa shennitrema teruma alehen, ucheshennignevu o avdu birshut haggizbarim nignevu o avdu, hilkach nishbaim hashsheluchim laggizbarim veniftarim. veaf al gav deen nishbain al hahakdashot, shevua zu takkanat chachamim hi kede shello yezalzelu bahakedashot:

Veim lav. shebbashshaa sheavdu adayin lo nitrema teruma velo hotziu maot min hakkuppot al heatid ligbot, birshut habbealim avdu, hilkach nishbaim hashsheluchim leanshe hair veniftarim. veanshe hair chozrin veshoklim shekalim acherim tachtehen, shehashshekalim harishonim sheavdu lo alu lahen:
Hakkol modim shehi mutteret. vehu sheyyodea baubbar shekkalu lo chodashav:
Veefroach sheyyatza. hakkol modim shehu asur, mishshum sheretz haof:
Hashshochet chayya vaof. habba lishchot chayya vaof beyom tov, venimlach bevet din ketzad yaase:

Bet shammay omrim. bet din morim lo sheyyishchot lechattechilla vayyachpor bedeker nautz sheyyesh lo mibbeod yom, kelomar sheyyaakor oto mimmekom neitzato veyaale afar vichasse bo. umayre keshehu nautz beafar tichoach harauy lechassot, sheeno mechussar ketisha:
Deker. yated shennoatzin baaretz. leshon vayyidkor et shenehem [bemidbar ko]:

Sheefer kira muchan hu. lav ammilletayhu devet shammay uvet hillel kae, ella milleta beanpe nafshah hi. vehachi kaamar, veefer kira muchan hu, velo shanu ella shehussak meerev yom tov, aval hussak beyom tov, asur, delekka lememar meetmol dateh aloye. veim rauy litzlot bo betza, sheadayin hu remetz cham, muttar lechassot bo, ayde dachazi lehappoche bo litzlot bo betza, shakel leh nammi umechasse bo:

Bayyom vehizza vallayla pasul. dichtiv vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii, bayyom velo vallayla. veittakkash tevila lehazzaa, dichtiv vetaval bammayim ish tahor vehizza, ma hazzaa vayyom af tevilat ezov bayyom:

Tovel ballayla umazze vayyom. hecha deshaha tevilato velo hizza vayyom hashshevii, keshebba lehazzot bashshemini o vatteshii vaasiri yachol lehakedim tevila lehazzaa. aval hattovel bashshevii kemitzvato, mazze techilla veachar kach tovel, dichtiv vechitteo bayyom hashshevii, vahadar vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim:

Mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher. demishsham vaelach hu yom, dichtiv (banechameyh 4) vaanachnu osim bammelacha vechetzyam machazikim barmachim mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim, uchetiv (sham) vehayu lanu hallayla mishmar vehayyom melacha:

Haochel ochel rishon. naase gufo rishon lihyot maggao sheni. vehaochel ochel sheni naase gufo sheni, veim naga batteruma pesalah. ellu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo bayyom. vedavka sheachal chatzi peras, shehu betza umechetza leharambam ushete betzim lerashi, shezehu shiur ochalim lifsol et haggeviyya:

Rabbi yehoshua omer haochel ochel rishon veochel sheni naase gufo sheni. disvira leh delo meshavvinan leh laochel kammaachol atzmo, vehay dimshavve laochel ochel sheni sheni velo shelishi, lefi shemmatzinu sheni ose sheni al yede mashkin, shehammashkin shennitmeu besheni hen naasim techilla vehannogea bahem have sheni, vei hava meshavvinan leh laochel ochel sheni shelishi lo haya posel et hatteruma, deen shelishi ose revii batteruma, vachachamim gazru al haochel ochel sheni sheyyihye posel et hatteruma, mishshum dezimnin achel ochalim temeim veshade mashkin shel teruma letoch piv beod sheochalim temeim befiv ufasel lehu, hilkach af al gav divochel ochel rishon lo meshavvinan leh laochel kammaachol atzmo, beochel ochel sheni meshavvinan leh sheni kemo hammaachol, kede sheyyifsol et hatteruma:
Shelishi sheni lakkodesh. haochel ochel shelishi naase gufo sheni lakkodesh, vaavid shelishi urevii bakkodesh:
Velo sheni latteruma. dei naga batteruma lo pesalah. umihu asur hu leechol batteruma, vehachi muchach baggemara perek 2‏ dechullin [daf lod]:

Bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma. kelomar hay ochel ochel rishon veochel ochel sheni ushelishi ditninan bematnitin, bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma kamayre, dechullin gereda en bahem shelishi:
Hassallim shebbakkantal. sallim sheddarkan leholich bahen perot o zevalim al gabbe hachamor vehen mechubbarin ze vaze:
Mitta shel tarbal. kemin ez shel barzel sheddashin bo et hattevua:
Keren shel keliva. hammitta shel metim osim lah kemin keren shel barzel vekoshrin bo hammet shello yippol. vekorim lemitta shel metim keliva, shehi asuya kichluv shel ofot:
Vekarnayim shel yotze derachim. karne vehema vechayya shemmolichim immahem ovre derachim lemalleot bahen mayim lishtot:
Veshalshelet hammaftechot. shalshelet shettolim bah hammaftechot:
Veshalal shel kovsim. derech hakkovsim lishlol habbegadim ze im ze hakkatan im haggadol bishvil shello yovad:

Vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim. shete chatichot shel beged tzemer shettefaran bechute fishtan vesofo lehippared mishshum issur kilayim, vechen shalal shel kovsim sofo lehippared, vaafillu hachi have chibbur lattuma:
Hammazze mechallon shel rabbim. sheomed bechallon shel rabbim vehizza sham al hattemeim haovrim, vehizza al hattame kesavur shehammayim shebbeyado tehorim lehazzaa:

Venimtzeu fesulim. im nichnas behazzaa zo lammikdash, patur hattame mikkarban, dahave chisfek tuma virshut harabbim disfeko tahor. uferesh harambam hattaam, detame ze anus hu, delo hava leh leassoke addateh velivdok im hammayim kesherin lehazzaa im lav, kevan shehaya omed birshut harabbim umazze al harabbim. aval haomed bechallon shel yachid umazze, hava leh lattame livdok al hammayim im kesherim im lav, vechevan delo vadak, shegaga hi zo velo ones, veim nichnas lammikdash behazzaa zo chayyav karban, dahave chisfek tuma virshut hayyachid disfeko tame:

Sheen kohen gadol chayyav al biat hammikdash. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) venichreta hannefesh hahi mittoch hakkahal, mi shecheto shave lakkahal dehaynu lichidim, perat lechohen gadol sheen cheto shave lichidim:
Machalikin hayu. kelomar kol kach me chattat hayu sham ad shehayu machalikin bahen bene adam, vaafillu hachi dorsim bahen, mishshum delo metammein, hoil venaaset mitzvatan:

Meshaarin et hallishka. poskim shaar leyenot shemanim uselatot, shaar sheyyaamod ze hashshaar sheloshim yom. velokchim bechol yom mimmochre yenot shemanim uselatot ma shehen tzerichin beoto hassechum sheppasku, veim nityakker hammikkach en mosifim damim, veim huzal lokchim lefi hazzol:

Hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot. bimot ketzir chittim uvetzirat anavim umesikat zetim hayu haggizbarim makdimim maot lachenvani, vehaya hachenvani mekabbel alav lesappek yenot shemanim uselatot kol hashshana. veim hayu az nimkarim arba sein besela vehukeru veamdu shalosh sein besela, tzarich litten arba sein, dehekdesh kone bechesef, dichtiv venatan hakkesef vekam lo. veim kibbel lesappek shalosh sein besela vehuzelu veamdu arba besela, noten arba besela, delo gara mehedyot delo kane ella bimshicha:
Hitlia lo. vaafillu mashach haggizbar venatan maot, acharayutam al hachenvani:
Eno mekabbel et meotav. kelomar enam necheshavim meotav shel chenvani velo zacha bahem, veaf al pi shekkibbelam min haggizbar:
Ad sheyyihye hammizbeach meratztze. sheyyaale leratzon al hammizbeach. hilkach im hechemitz hayyayin o hitlia hassolet, acharayutam al hachenvani:
Bearbaa devarim. sear pekudda vedam hayyarok usear bechor hattalush vehashekaat giyyoret umeshuchreret:

Mutav lehanniach divre hayyachid. mishshum dehu nammi merabbim kibbel vahavu devarav kedivre rabbim, mishshum hachi kaamar mutav lehanniach vechulei. dei lav hachi may mutav dekaamar, vahalo deorayta hi, dichtiv (Shemot 23) achare rabbim lehattot, vechayyav lehanniach divre hayyachid beal karcho. ella taama deamar mutav velo amar chayyav, mishshum deaf hu merabbim kibbel kedifrishit. veen halacha kaakavya ben mahalalel bechol arbaa devarim hallalu:

Kazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay. ever shepperash min haadam hachay, dino shehu metamme kol zeman shehu ever shalem, bemagga uvemassa uveohel, kammet atzmo, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) bachalal cherev o bemet, ever shehivdilattu hacherev min hachay hare hu kammet. vehabbasar happoresh min hachay eno metamme ad sheyyihye ever shalem. ucheshepperash kazzayit basar meevar min hachay, rabbi eliezer metamme kedimfaresh taama veazel:

Etzem kasseora. min hammet, metamme bemagga uvemassa veeno metamme beohel, dichtiv (sham) veal hannogea baetzem, vahalacha lemoshe missinay shehu metamme bechasseora. ucheshepperash meevar min hachay rabbi nechuneya metamme vechulei:
Matzinu ever min hachay kemet shalem. kidyalfinan mikra bachalal cherev o bemet:
Im timmeta kazzayit basar happoresh min hammet. kelomar din hu shekkazzayit basar happoresh min hammet yehe tame, shekken yesh bo chumra acheret, sheetzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu nammi tame:
Aval netamme kazzayit basar happoresh meevar min hachay. bitmiyya. shehare en bo zot hachumra:

Shekken tiharta etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu. deha tenan leel etzem kasseora happoresh meevar min hachay rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua metaharin. umiddivre atzmo asu pircha lema matzinu shehevi, vechen lerabbi nechuneya:

Shehabbasar noheg bannevelot uvashsheratzim vechulei. dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vehannogea benivlatam, benivlatam velo baatzamot velo bakkarnayim velo battelafayim, alma en haatzamot metammeim mishshum nevela:

Ever sheyyesh alav basar karauy. ever eno metamme ella im ken yesh bo basar vegidim vaatzamot, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) o beetzem adam, ma adam sheyyesh bo basar vegidim vaatzamot, af kol sheyyesh bo basar vegidim vaatzamot. veim chaser min habbasar shehaya alav venishar bo basar karauy sheyyaale arucha veyavri im haya mechubbar beadam chay, metamme mishshum ever. vehayenu dekaamar chaser habbasar tame. aval im nechsar kol shehu min haetzem shebbaevar, shuv eno metamme mishshum ever. vehayenu dekaamar chaser haetzem tahor, kelomar tahor mishshum ever aval tame mishshum basar, veim ken matzinu shemmerubba tumat basar mittumat etzem:
Vehu kivriyato. basar vegidim vaatzamot:
Kazzayit basar metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. amru lefi shettechillat beriyyato shel adam kazzayit, lefichach shiur tumato bechazzayit:
Verov atzamot. rov minyan atzmotav shel adam, shemminyan atzmotav shel adam matayim arbaim ushemone, nimtza harov mea veesrim vechamesh:
Chaser habbasar. mishshiur shel kazzayit:
Tahor. gamur milletamme, lo bemagga velo bemassa velo beohel:
