Chaser rov atzamot metamme vemagga uvemassa. deetzem kasseora metamme bemagga uvemassa veeno metamme beohel, alma merubba tumat atzamot mittumat basar, deillu atzamot keshennechseru mishshiuran adayin nishar bahen tuma, uvasar keshennechsar mishshiuro tahor gamur:
Rov binyano. kegon shete shokayim veyarech echad. vechol binyano shel adam hen shete shokayim vehayerechayim vehatztzelaot vehashshidra:

Af al pi sheen bahen rova. derova kav atzamot shel met metammeim beohel af al pi sheen bahem rov minyan velo rov binyan. vechen rov minyan o rov binyan metammeim af al pi sheen bahen rova. aval basar keshehu pachut mikkazzayit en lecha bo davar sheyyavi lo et hattuma:
Im amartem bammet sheyyesh bo rov verova verakav. din hu shekkazzayit basar veetzem kasseora happorshim min hammet sheyyihyu temeim, shekken yesh bammet chumrot shel rov verova verakav:
Tomru vachay sheen bo. chumrot hallalu, sheeno din sheyyihyu lo kazzayit basar velo etzem kasseora happorshim meevar min hachay temeim ella tehorim. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Verakav. gufo shel met keshekkala lachuto venaasa kemin afar, zehu rakav, shemmetamme kimlo tarvad, veshiuro melo chafnayim shel adam benoni. veen melo tarvad rakav metamme ella min hammet shennikbar arom bearon shel shayish umechusse bechissuy shel shayish, ad shennoda bevadday sheen bo taarovet rikkavon shel beged o shel etz o afar acher. aval met shennikbar bichsuto o bearon shel etz o beafar, en lo rakav. vechen met shennikbar chasar ever en lo rakav:
Hannoten shiklo lachavero lishkol al yado. bishvilo, vehalach hashshaliach veshakal bishvil atzmo:
Im nitrema hatteruma. kodem shennatan hashshekel laggizbar:

Maal. ze sheshshakal bishvil atzmo, demiyyad shennitrema hatteruma al heatid ligbot, haya ze hashshekel shennatan lo chavero lishkol alav birshut hekdesh, ucheshennetano al atzmo nehene min hahekdesh, shehare im lo haya noten shekel ze bishvil atzmo hayu memashkenin oto, keditnan leel beferek kamma mishsheyyashvu bammikdash hitchilu lemashken, venimtza nehena min hahekdesh, vechayyav karban meila:

Hashshokel shiklo min hahekdesh. shehayu beyado maot shehukdeshu levedek habbayit, uchesavur shehem shel chullin, veshakal mehem shiklo, venitrema hatteruma vekanu behema beotah teruma vehikrivuha, az nitchayyev hashshokel karban meila, aval lo kodem, lefi shezze hahekdesh nishar hekdesh kemo shehaya bechol makom shehu velo nishtanna, ucheshennikreva habbehema vehu nitkavven shehi mimmamon kol mi sheshshakal bitrumat hallishka, naasa keillu kana behema beotan maot shel hekdesh vehikriva, venehena shello mishkenuhu bishvil shiklo, venitchayyev bekarban meila. veresha nammi dekatane keshennatan lo chavero lishkol al yado veshakal al atzmo demaal, hayenu nammi shekkarva behema achar shennitrema hatteruma. vehai delo tanyeh baresha, mishshum desamich assefa shemmefaresh bah meilat shenehem. vehayenu taama sheeno moel miyyad af al pi shennehena kevar, lefi sheen meila ella bemotzi min hahekdesh lechullin, aval hammotzi mehekdesh lehekdesh af al pi shennehena eno moel ella achar sheasa maase bahekdesh hashsheni. vechen muchach bayrushalmi:

Yochal kenegdan. yavi shekel veyomar, kol makom shehem maaser sheni o sheviit yihyu mechullalim al shekel ze, dishviit tofeset dameha kehekdesh, veyochal perot sheyyikne beoto shekel birushalayim kedin maaser sheni, o yochlem bikdushat sheviit im happerot shechillel hayu sheviit:
Mechabbedin ben hammittot. sheochlin sham. uregilin hayu lehasev al gabbe mittot veleechol:
Mugmar. levona al gabbe gechalim kede lehariach bah. aval legammer et hakkelim, divre hakkol asur:

Mekullas. keraav uvene meav teluyin betziddo chutza lo keshetztzolehu. vehayu osim zecher lappesach dichtiv beh (Shemot 12) rosho al keraav veal kirbo. mekullas, kegibbor ze shekkele zenav immo. targum vechova nechoshet [shemuel 1 17], vekulesa dinchasha:

Vachachamim osrim. bishlashtan. kibbud, mishshum ashvoye gummot. umugmar, mishshum delav tzorech lechol nefesh hu, sheeno ella limunnagim beyoter o lemi sherecho ra. gedi mekullas, mippene shennire keochel kadashim bachutz. vahalacha kachachamim:
Motar sheyare hallishka. ma shennishar achar shennaasa mehen tikkun tzarche hair:
Lokchim mehen yenot shemanim uselatot. umochrim otan lemi shetztzarich yayin linsachim ushemanim uselatot limnachot:
En mistakkerin beshel hekdesh. sheen aniyyut bemakom ashirut, ugenay hu lahekdesh:
Veaf lo beshel aniyyim. dilma mitreme ani velekka lemetav leh. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Hefker laaniyyim hefker. mi shehifkir laaniyyim velo laashirim, din hefker yesh lo, veeno chayyav beleket shichcha ufea velo bemaasrot, dichtiv beleket ufea (Vayikra 19) leani velagger taazov otam, ma talmud lomar taazov otam, limmed al aziva acheret, dehaynu hefker shehi kezo, ma zo laaniyyim velo ashirim, af hefker laaniyyim:

Ad sheyyafkir af laashirim kashshemitta. dichtiv (Shemot 23) vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah, ma talmud lomar unetashtah, limmed al netisha acheret, dehaynu hefker, shehi kashsheviit, ma sheviit laaniyyim velaashirim af hefker laaniyyim velaashirim:

Kol amre hassade shel kav kav. im hayu kol amre hassade kol echad mehen kav veechad shel arbaat kabbin, ushechacho, hare ze shichcha, yater al ken eno shichcha. vechen im hayu kol hoomarim shene kabbin veechad mishshemona kabbin, ushechacho, hare ze shichcha, yater al ken enah shichcha:
Mikratzot. chatichot shel batzek. leshon keretz mitztzafon ba (yirmeya 46):
Noshchot zo et zo. shehen devukot zo bazo vei efshar lehaferishan ella im ken noshchot zo mizzo:
Kullan techilla. dachashuvot keachat ucheillu naga bechullan:
Pershu. hachatichot zo mizzo:
Bemashkin kullan sheniyyot. demashkin techilla havu veosin sheni:
Beyadayim kullan shelishiyyot. deyadayim sheniyyot hen, veosot shelishi batteruma:
Mecham. kumkum shel nechoshet shemmechammemim bo hammayim:

Chutz mittumtum veanderoginos. lefi shehen sefek ishsha, veishsha enah keshera lehazzot, dichtiv vetaval bammayim ish tahor, ish velo ishsha, tahor, lerabbot et hakkatan. vehazzaa yalef mittevila deittakkush lahadade:
Haishsha mesaadto. mesayyato, kedimfaresh bassefa deochezet lo vammayim:

Im achaza veyado afillu vishat hazzaa pasul. lo mibbaya vishat tevila, dechi chetiv ish velo ishsha, bitvila hu dichtiv, ella afillu vishat hazzaa delo chetiv kera behazzaa, afillu hachi im achaza veyado, pasul, degamrinan hazzaa mittevila:
Haezov hakkatzar mesappeko. maaricho kede sippuko:
Uvechush. hu happelech shehannashim toot bo:
Vetovel umaale. veaf al gav dichtiv velakach ezov vetaval bammayim, vehu lokeach happelech shehaezov natun berosho, shappir karinan beh velakach ezov, dilkicha al yede davar acher shemah lekicha:
Veochez baezov umazze. devahazzaa bainan sheyyehe ochez haezov beyado:
Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon:
Uvabbehema haor veharotev. kulla matnitin mipparsha bechullin perek haor veharotev:
Harishon shebbachullin tame umetamme. teruma. shekkikkar shel teruma shennaga berishon shel chullin, naase sheni ufosel et hashshelishi:
Vehashsheni. shebbachullin. posel et hatteruma veeno metamme, dishlishi ditruma la avid revii, hilkach shelishi ditruma lo mikre tame ella pasul:
Vehashshelishi. shel chullin. hachi kaamar, veim yesh beotan chullin shelishi, kegon shennaasu al tohorat teruma:

Neechol binzid haddama. betavshil [shetteruma] meorevet bo. vehatteruma keruya dema, shenneemar (Shemot 22) meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher. uveferek 2‏ dechullin mochiach dedavka kesheen binzid haddema kazzayit teruma bichde achilat peras hu deshare leh leechol ochel shelishi, aval i ikka kazzayit teruma bichde achilat peras, asur, dekayma lan haochel ochel shelishi mechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma, nifsal gufo milleechol batteruma:
Al ever min hammet. sheen bo kazzayit. dechazzayit min hammet leolam metamme ledivre hakkol kammet atzmo. velo nechleku ella al ever katan sheen bo kazzayit:
Lo amru. evarim en lahem shiur, ella al ever min hachay, aval ever min hammet shiura bae letammoye:

Merubba tumat hachayyim. hasheta parech al kal vachomer, vehachi kaamar, din hu sheyyehe ever min hachay metamme bechol shehu af al pi sheen ever min hammet metamme bechol shehu, shekken matzinu shemmerubba tumat hachayyim mittumat hammetim:
Shehachay. dehaynu hazzav keshehu chay:
Ose mishkav umoshav. kol kelim shettachtav vaafillu hen mea, letamme adam letamme begadim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 15) veish asher yigga bemishkavo yechabbes begadav:

Veal gabbav maddaf. kol hakkelim sheal gabbe hazzav afillu hen mea ze al gav ze temeim tumat maddaf, dehaynu tuma kalla, sheenan metammein adam vechelim kemo mishkav umoshav shehen tachtav, aval metammeim ochalim umashkim. umaddaf hu leshon kol ale niddaf (Vayikra 26) kelomar tuma kalla. perush acher, leshon recho nodef, shereach tumat hazzav holechet lemerachok letamme kol hakkelim sheal gabbav af al pi shello naga bahem:

Ma sheen hammet metamme. dechelim shettachtav shel met en temeim ella rishon vesheni ushelishi bilvad, middin magga. shehakkeli shennaga bammet hare hu kammet, veose hakkeli shennaga bo av, vehashshelishi shennaga bo naase rishon, vetu enan metammein kelim, deen kelim mekabbelim tuma ella meav hattuma. vechen kelim sheal gabbav shel met enan temeim ella rishon sheni ushelishi bilvad middin magga, velo middin mishkav umoshav:

Bichnafo. bichnaf bigdo. lefi shehakkardom hatztzarich hazzaa hu av hattuma, uchesheochez bichnafo naase hakkanaf rishon, en haochazo tame, deen adam vechelim mekabbelim tuma ella meav hattuma. veaf al pi sheyyesh al hakkardom mayim kede hazzaya, en haochazo tame mishshum nose me hannidda, hoil venaaset mitzvatan kevar:
Kede sheyyatbil rashe givolin veyazze. chutz mimma shehaezov bolea:

Keillu hen al ezov shel nechoshet. sheeno volea. deroim hammayim habbeluim baezov keillu hen been lehashelim shiur hazzaa lihyot hannosan tame. veha dichtiv (sham) umazze me hannidda dedarshinan minneh lannose cheshiur hazzaa, hayenu sheillu hayu veen haya vahen shiur hazzaa. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Al davar hamekabbel tuma. adam vechelim:
Al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma. behema uchele avanim:

Im yesh baezov lo yishne. im nishtayyer baezov kede hazzaa en tzarich lachazor velitbol paam sheniyya, ella mazze meoto shennishtayyer baezov al haddavar hattame vealta lo hazzaa, dichtiv vehizza hattahor al hattame, ad sheyyitkavven lehazzot al hattame, hilkach keshennitkavven bishat tevilat haezov lehazzot al hattame lo yishne, ella yazze mimma shennishtayyer baezov. aval im taval haezov kede lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, hoil utechillat tevilato pesula, kach hazzaato fesula, velo yazze bema shennishtayyer baezov ad sheyyishne:
Hammayim hamenattefin. min haezov shehitbilo leshem davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, im hitbil beotam tippot ezov vehizza mehen, kesherin:
Lefichach hen metammein. lefi shello asu mitzvatan, shehare hattevila harishona pesula hayta, vahare ellu hattippot kishar me chattat hakkesherim shehen metammein:
Motar hatteruma. hayenu ma shennishar bakkuppot berosh chodesh nisan, sheaz meviin karbanot mitteruma chadasha:
Tzippuy levet kadshe hakkadashim. laritzpa velakketalim:

Motar perot. rabbi yishmael letaameh, deamar leel motar sheyare hallishka konim mehen yenot shemanim uselatot, vehassachar shemmistakkerim bahen karuy motar perot, kelomar ma shehotiru venistakkeru bapperot shekkanu:

Kayitz lammizbeach. keshehammizbeach batel meviim mehen olot, kemo shedderech bene adam lehaalot mine metika al hashshulchan bigmar seudatan, kach achar sheggamru lehavi chovat hayyom meviim olot hallalu kesheen nedarim unedavot vehammizbeach batel:
Motar teruma lichle sharet. mikra daresh leh dichtiv (divrei hayamim 2 24) veet shear hakkesef vayyaasehu chelim levet Adonai, ezehu kesef sheyyesh lo shirayim, have omer zo terumat hallishka:
Motar teruma lekayitz hammizbeach. shelletzorech karbanot hufresha:

Motar nesachim. gizbere hekdesh hayu mamtziim maot levaale yenot ushemanim uselatot, lesappek limnachot unesachim kol hashshana, veim kibbel alav lesappek shalosh seim besela veamdu arba seim besela, tzarich sheyyitten arba sein, veotah sea hi motar nesachim. vechen keshemmoddin lahekdesh hayu moddin bemidda mevoretzet ugedusha, vehaggizbar haya mochek hammidda, habberutz nikra motar nesachim, veosin mehen kele sharet, shehannesachim mitkaddeshim bichle sharet:
Motar nesachim lekayitz hammizbeach. shehannesachim kalil vehaola kalil:
Ze vaze. rabbi akiva verabbi chanina:
Lo hayu modim bapperot. kidamar rabbi akiva leel, sheen mistakkerim beshel hekdesh. umaskana ditnay bet din hu al hammotarot sheyyihyu kullan kerevim olot. vechen halacha:

Arbaa chotamot hayu vammikdash. shalosh chotamot lishlosha nesachin chalukim shel behemot. chotam rishon leniske bakar, vehen shelosha esronim solet balul bachatzi hahin shemen, veyayin lenesech chatzi hahin, vechotaman egel. vehashsheni zachar leniske ayil, shettargum ayil dichra, unesachav shete esronim solet balul bashshemen shelishit hahin, veyayin lannesech shelishit hahin. vehashshelishi gedi, leniske keves ben shenato, vehen issaron solet balul birviit hahin shemen, veyayin lannesech reviit hahin. veharvii chote, vehem nesachav shel metzora ashir shemmevi shalosh behemot vetzarich asara luggin shemen, tisha lishlosha kevasim veechad lemattan tenuch uvehonot. vekari leh chote, mishshum deamrinan baarachin (16.) al shiva devarim negaim bain:
Chamishsha hayu. shene chotamot hayu lamtzora:

Chote dal vechote ashir. lefi shemmetzora ani eno mevi ella behema achat. veim lo haya lammetzora ella chotam echad, hayu notnim limtzora ani shelosha esronot. vetanna kamma savar limtzora ani notnim lo chotam gedi. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Vaaramit katuv alehen. sherov dibburam bilshon arammi haya:
Zecharim unekevot. ben leniske olot sheenan baot ella zecharim, ben leniske shelamim shebbaim zecharim o nekevot. veolot ushelamim hen shetteunin nesachim, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 15) ola o zevach:

Taram et harishona umechappe vekatavlaot. teruma rishona shehayta bifros happesach, leachar shettaram otah haya mechasse kol hashshekalim hannisharim ballishka vekatavlaot, dehaynu or shaluk, kede sheyyittenu alav hashshekalim sheyyaviu mimmedinot shesseviv eretz yisrael shello yachlu lehavi kodem happesach umeviim mippesach vead atzeret, venotnim otam al gabbe hakketavla kede sheyyitrom mehen bifros haatzeret, velo yitrom min haddavar shettaram kevar bifros happesach. veachar shettaram bifros haatzeret chazar vechissa kol hammaot shebballishka viktavlaot, venotnin alehem kol hashshekalim hammeviim mibbavel umimmaday umin hammedinot harchokot, vetormin mehen bifros hechag. veod lo haya mechappe, sheen od teruma achareha:
Harishona leshem eretz yisrael. shehem shalchu shiklehem techilla, shehaacherim adayin lo heviu:

Leshum kerakkim hammukkafim. hassemuchim. kemo ammon umoav vechayyotze vahen. vedugmato, litrom shello min hammukkaf [gittin 30], en makkifin bevue [chullin 46:]. umikkol makom bechol paam ufaam hayu tormin al shem kol yisrael, al haggavuy veal heatid ligbot. velo hizkir hattanna chilluke mekomot hallalu ella lehodiacha shettikkenu shelosha perakim ellu lefi sheaz yitkabbetzu kol shikle yisrael:
Para adumma vesair hammishtalleach. laazazel:

Bain mitterumat hallishka. af al gav defara enah nishchetet baazara, baa mitterumat hallishka, dechattat karyah rachamana. vesair hammishtalleach, lefi shetztzarich likkach shene seirim veen yadua al eze mehem yaale haggoral laAdonai:

Velashon shel zehorit. sheni tolaat shemmashlichin el toch serefat happara. vehu haddin leetz erez veezov, ella nakat lashon shel zehorit levad lechallek ben lashon shel zehorit ze lallashon shel zehorit shel sair hammishtalleach:
Kevesh para. shehayu osim shene gesharim ze al gabbe ze mippene kever hattehom mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha, vaalehen hayu motziin et happara:
Vechevesh [sair]. shehayu osin kemin gesher ad chutz lair, vealav haya holech hameshalleach et hassair, mippene habbavliyyim shehayu tolshim searo veomrim lo tol vetze shello tashhe avonotenu:

Velashon shebben karnav. leda im hilbin venitkapperu avonotehen shel yisrael. vehane enam tzorech karban, lefichach enan bain mitteruma shehufresha leshem karbanot, ella mimma shennishtayyer ballishka achar haferashat hatterumot:
Veammat hammayim. haoveret baazara, im tzericha tikkun:
Vechol tzarche hair. lachpor borot shichin umearot, vetikkun rechovoteha ushevakeha, ushemirat hair:
Abba shaul omer kulei. veen halacha keabba shaul:
Rabbi yehuda omer. dam nevelot bet shammay metaharin. legamre, dela chashev kinvela:
Betzat nevela. kegon shennitnabbela bashshechita. venimtzeu bah betzim leachar shechita:
Im kayyotze vah nimkeret bashshuk. shekkelippatah kasha venigmeret kishar betzim hannimkarot bashshuk:
Veim lav. sheenah nigmeret:
Asura. dechivne meeha hi chashuva:

Dam nachrit bet shammay metaharim. dichtiv befarashat zav (Vayikra 15) dabberu el bene yisrael, bene yisrael metammeim bazziva veen hannachrim metammeim bazziva, verabbanan gazur alayhu sheyyihyu kezavim lechol divrehen. bet shammay savre, ki gazur rabbanan berukkah umeme ragleha shehen metzuyin tadir, aval dam hazziva sheen matzuy kol kach lo gazru bah rabbanan, avadu rabbanan hekkera velo timmeu dam ziva shel nachrit kede sheyyedu detumat hannachri derabbanan hi, ki hechi dela nisrefu ala teruma vekadashim:
Vedam tohora shel metzoraat. dam tohar sheraata hametzoraat sheyyalda, leachar shiva lezachar ushevuayim linkeva:

Kerukkah uchememe ragleha. dam hannachrit metamme kerukkah uchememe ragleha, dehaynu lach velo yavesh. vezo hahekkera bilvad asu lah, sheim hayta tuma deorayta haya haddam metamme lach veyavesh, achshav sheen metamme ella lach makkirim detuma derabbanan hi:
Betova. shehaochel machazik tova levaal happerot sheheechilahu mipperotav:
Veshello vetova. sheeno machazik lo tova:
En ochlim betova. sheasur lehachazik tova labbealim, derachmana afkerinhu:
Hachemet. kemin nod shel or shennikkav utzeraro:
Tzerura omedet. enah mekabbelet tuma ella im ken hi tzerura, kelomar shehayta keshura venikmat haor venitkashsha al hammakom hatztzarur ad shehu omed meelav umachazik ma shemmesimin betocho:
Af al pi sheenah tzerura. shello nikmat haor meelav velo nitkashsha al mekom hakkesher, hoil ukesharo umachazik, hare ze mekabbel tuma:
Veachar kach ba laaretz. sheen nezirut noheget ella baaretz, mishshum tumat eretz haammim. umi shennadar nezirut bechutz laaretz mechayyevin oto laalot leeretz yisrael velihyot noheg sham neziruto:
Nazir sheloshim yom. kansinan leh sheyyekayyem setam nezirut beeretz yisrael, shehu sheloshim yom:
Nazir battechilla. tzarich linhog beeretz yisrael keminyan hayyamim shennadar bannezirut. vehayyamim shennahag nezirut bechutz laaretz keillu lo nahag bahem nezirut kelal:
Ellu meidin shennadar shetayim. shete nezirut:
Veellu meidin shennadar chamesh. beotah shaa sheattem omrim shennadar shetayim anu meidim shennadar chamesh neziruyyot. vehu omer shello nadar kelal:
Nechleka haedut. hoil umachchishot zo et zo nitbattelu divrehem veen kan edut kelal:
Uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim. veyihye nazir shetayim:
[Kol hanach bavot peshutot hen]. vechol makom sheani yachol litlot sheyyesh kabbetza min hechamur baze uvaze, azlinan batar chamur. veim lav, azlinan batar hakkal:
Choltzot velo mityabbemot. dechevan detarvayhu zekukin lehay ulehay, kamma dimyabbem paga baachot zekukato dehavya keishto:

Mishshum bet shammay yekayyemu uvet hillel omrim yotziu. baggemara bivamot perek 4‏ achin mappechinan la, bet shammay omrim yotziu uvet hillel omrim yekayyemu. vechen halacha, sheim kadmu vechansu yekayyemu:
Motar hakketoret. hannotar bechol shana:

Me hayu osin bah. lehaketirah lashshana habbaa. sheen lecha shana sheen bah motar, shehakketoret hayta naaset shelosh meot shishshim ushemona manim, shelosh meot shishshim vachamishsha manim keminyan shelosh meot shishshim vachamishsha yemot hachamma, ushelosha manin shemmehem kohen gadol machnis melo chafnav beyom hakkippurim, velo hayu nichnasim kullan bechafnav. veod, bechol shana peshuta haya motar, sheshshana peshuta yameha shelosh meot chamishshim vearbaa:
Mafrishin mimmenna. min hallishka:

Sechar haummanin. mippattame hakketoret, shehen notlim secharan mitterumat hallishka. umezakkin hammaot laummanin al yad echad min haggizbarim, vahare hen chullin. veaf al pi sheen hekdesh yotze lechullin im lo sheyyikkanes davar acher tachtav likdushsha, terumat hallishka shane, devet din matne alehem littenam lechamma devarim. veachare shezzachu bammaot letzorech haummanin mechallelin hakketoret al otan hammaot, vehammaot kedoshim litruma yeshana, venotnim hakketoret laummanim bischaram, vechozrin vekonin otah mehen bemaot shel teruma chadasha. vehachi tzenia milleta tefe, velo lemachrah velachazor veliknotah:
Im ba hechadash bizmanno. sheheviu shekalim chadashim kodem rosh chodesh nisan, shehu zeman hatteruma hachadasha, lokchim motar hakketoret mitteruma chadasha al yede chillul kidfarshinan leel:

Veim lav. shello heviu shekalim chadashim adayin, lokchim otah min hatteruma yeshana, im chilleluha kevar. veim lo chilleluha, maktirin otah, dechevan shello ba hechadash tzarich lehavi min hayyeshana:
Mamtinin lo ad haarev. sheyyizdavvegu yachad yochanan vaachiyya, im nimtzeu maot yeterim beyad yochanan keneged hachotam sheomer ze shenneevad mimmennu, notnim lo:
Veshem hayyom katuv. al hachotam, yom peloni vechodesh peloni:

Mippene harammain. shemma matza chotam shennafal mechavero o meachiyya o miyyochanan, uva achshav likkach, uvayyom shemmetzao eno rashshay lehotzio, shehaoved mechazzer acharav. veod yesh lachush shemma lakach chotam keshaar hazzol, vehitznio ad shennityakker hashshaar:

Bishlosha ferakim bashshana tormin et hallishka. kol hashshekalim hayu notnim letoch lishka achat shebbammikdash, veshalosh peamim bashshana notlin mimmenna, venotnim letoch shalosh kuppot, shekkol kuppa hayta mishshalosh sein, kede liknot mehen karbenot tzibbur. velo hayu notlim hakkol befaam achat letzorech kol hashshana, lefi sheharchokim lo heviu adayin kol shiklehem:
Bifros happesach. chamishsha asar yom kodem hammoed kare peros hammoed, lefi sheshsheloshim yom kodem haregel shoalim vedorshim behilchot haregel, uferos hu leshon perusa dehaynu chetzi:

Vehen geranot shel maaser. shelosha perakim hallalu hen shalosh geranot shel masar behema, shezzemannim ellu kavu chachamim leasser behemot shennoldu. uchemo shehaggoren kovaat lemasar dagan, kach zemannim ellu kovim leesor habbehemot shennoldu baachila ad sheyyeasser, aval kodem happerek muttar leechol af al pi shello isser. vekavu chachamim hanach telata zemanne lemasar behema, kede sheyyihyu behemot metzuyot leole regalim, deaf al gav demuttar limkor velishchot veleechol kol zeman shello higgia moed haggoren, afillu hachi lo shachate lehu eynashe ad demiasseran, denicha leh leeynish lekiyyume mitzva bemamoneh bedavar sheen chaser bo kelum, kegon masar behema, shehu atzmo mevi maaser veochlo shelamim, veim lo hayu measserim bishlosha perakim hallalu hayu harebe nimnaim limkor, lefi shello isseru, velo hayu behemot metzuyot leole regalim:
Ben azzay omer beesrim vetisha vaadar. tamayhu dechol hane tannae umachloktan meforash perek batra divchorot:
Haishsha. beishsha tehora ayre:

Shehayta choveshet yarak. shel teruma bikdera. veoto yarak lo huchshar lekabbel tuma, ella kederech hakkovshim shemmechattechim et hayyarak belo mashke umolchim oto venotnim bikdera o bechavit veachar kach notnim alav yayin o chometz o shemen, (vehechsher oto haola):
Naga. beyadayim mesoavot shepposlim et hatteruma:
Beale. shel yarak shehaya chetzyo bakkedera im hammashkin vechetzyo chutz lakkedera naguv, venaga bemakom hannaguv:
Af al pi sheyyesh bo chabbetza. shehu shiur letamme ochalim:
Hu tame. oto heale:
Vehakkol tahor. shear hayyarak vehammashkin shebbakkedera. delo ate hay ale shemmiktzato bakkedera umetamme lehu, deyadayim sheniyyot, veheale shelishi, veen shelishi ose revii batteruma:
Naga. bistam yadayim shehem sheniyyot:

Bimkom mashke. kelomar bemakom sheen heale naguv, naasa mashke shealav techilla, dechol happosel et hatteruma metamme mashkin lihyot techilla, vehammashke ose et heale sheni, hilkach kesheyyesh beale kabbetza hayenu shiur letamme acherim:

Hakkol tame. af hakkedera atzmah, demiktzat ale shebbakkedera ose mashke shebbakkedera techilla vechozrin umetammein et hakkedera, kidita beferek kamma deshabbat, hoochalim vehakkelim shennitmeu bemashkin:
En bo chabbetza hu tame. oto ale shennaga vo:
Vehakkol tahor. defachot mikkabbetza en metamme acher:
Chazar lakkedera. oto mekom hammashke shennaga bo:
Hakkol tame. af al pi sheen beale kabbetza, shehammashke shennaga bo chazar vetimme kol ma shebbakkedera, veaf hakkedera atzmah:
Hayta magga teme met. ishsha zo shekkoveshet et hayyarak. hare haishsha rishon veheale shennaga bo sheni, hilkach im yesh bo kabbetza hakkol tame:

Hayta tevulat yom menaeret et hakkedera. dehashta yesh beishsha zo shete tumot, chada ditvulat yom veidach distam yadayim shehem sheniyyot, kiddekatane beyadayim mesoavot. vetarvayhu tzerichin mishshum sefa. menaeret, meara ma shebbetoch hakkedera. lishana acharina, menaeret, megisa betoch hakkedera bechaf shebbeyadah:
Safek min hakkedera nittezu. velo nitma ma shebbetochah:
Safek shehakkelach. shekkullo male mashke vehu betoch hakkedera naga beyadeha:

Hayyarak pasul. mishshum sefeka ditvul yom. aval mishshum sefek yadayim lo, keditnan beferek 2‏ ditvul yom (mishna 2), chomer bitvul yom shessefek tevul yom posel et hatteruma, vehayyadayim sefekan tahor:

Vehakkedera tehora. demishshum tevul yom lo metammea afillu vadday naga bammashkin, deen tevul yom ose mashke techilla, keditnan (para 88 46), kol happosel et hatteruma metamme et hammashkin lihyot techilla chutz mittevul yom. vei mishshum yadayim, lo metammea, dechevan disfeka hu shemma nittezu al yadeha, missefeka kedera tehora, shessefek yadayim letamme, tahor:
Hammazze veezov tame. kegon ezov shel ginna shellikketo laachila:
Im yesh bo chabbetza. dezehu shiur ochel, ben lekabbel tuma ben letamme acherim:
Vehazzaato fesula. dichtiv [sham] vehizza hattahor, sheyihye hammazze tahor vehaezov tahor:
Afillu hen mea. kullan temein lechattat, deen monin rishon vesheni bechattat ella chullan hen techilla:
Kalbon. kal bon. kelomar davar kal umuat shemmosifin al machatzit hashshekel lehacheria benehem:

Hashshokel al yede ishsha kulei‏ patur. kegon shehilva lahem, dechevan difturim hen lo michayyeve bekalbon. vei lo hilva lahem ella shepporea bishvilam, afillu shokel bishvil bar chiyyuva patur min hakkalbon kedilkamman:
Im shakal al yado veal yad chavero. beshehilvahu mayre, veshokel shekel shalem, machatzit hashshekel bishvilo umachatzit hashshekel shemmalve lachavero:

Chayyav kalbon echad. desavar hannoten machatzit hashshekel hakkatzuv battora patur min hakkalbon, dichtiv ze yittenu, kaze yittenu velo yoter. ushenayim sheshshaklu shekel shalem en notnin ella kalbon echad:
Rabbi meir omer shene kalbonot. rabbi meir savar hashshokel machatzit hashshekel chayyav bekalbon, hilkach shenayim sheshshaklu shekel shalem chayyavin shete kalbonot. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Hannoten sela. dehaynu shekel shalem leshulchani shel hekdesh, venotel mimmennu machatzito shennishar lo mimmennu. veshekel haamur kan hayenu machatzit hashshekel:

Noten shene kalbonot. beha mode tanna kamma denoten shete kalbonot, echad kalbon lehechrea machatzit hashshekel shehu notel min hahekdesh, veechad dechevan shello shakal machatzit hashshekel kemo shekkatzuv battora nitchayyev bekalbon:
Vezorko lifne hattorem. mitkavvenim hayu sheyyippelu shiklehem letoch hakkuppa veyiknu mehem karbenot tzibbur. velo yihyu mishsheyare hallishka:

Shalosh peamim. al kol paam ufaam haya omer etrom, vehem omrim lo terom. vechen derech leshon chachamim lihyot meshullash. vedugmato matzinu baomer, maggal zu maggal zu maggal zu, ektzor ektzor ektzor. vechen chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal shelosha peamim:
Mekabbelin miyyadam. uvitnay sheyyimserum latztzibbur legamre, ki hechi delo lahave karban tzibbur karev mishshel yachid:
Kinne zavim vezavot. torim uvene yona shezzavim vezavot meviim. uvechutim bilvad mayre, deen zavim vezavot beovde kochavim:

Kol shehu niddar veniddav mekabbelin miyyadam. detanya [menachot ag:] ish ish, lerabbot et haggerim shennodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael. veen li ella ola kedichtiv (Vayikra 22) asher yakrivu laAdonai‏ ola, shelamim minnayin, talmud lomar lechol nidrehem. minnayin lerabbot haofot vehammenachot hayyayin vehallevona vehaetzim, talmud lomar lechol nidrehem ulechol nidvotam:

Vechen hu meforash al yede ezra. kesheratzu hakkutim lesayyean veshalchu lahem nivne immachem ki chachem nidrosh lelohechem, ma heshivu lahem, lo lachem velanu livnot bayit beshuttafut lelohenu, velachem en chelek utzedaka vezikkaron birushalayim:

Mattirin et hatztzarot laachin. tzarat erva mattirin otah lehityabbem leachiv. delet lehu derasha deishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror demashma minneh lo tikkach lo hi velo tzaratah velo tzarat tzaratah:
Chaltzu. hatztzarot min haachin:
Bet shammay poslin. hatztzarot: min hakkehunna. shechalitzatan chalitza:
Uvet hillel machshirin. shechalitzatan shello letzorech hayta, vahare hi kecholetzet min hannachri:
Nityabbemu. laachin:
Bet shammay machshirin. otam lakkohanim im nitalmenu mivamehen:
Uvet hillel poslim. shennivalu leasur lahen, vehannivelet leasur lah asaah zona, vezona asura lechohen:

Lo nimneu. veaf al pi shebbene hatztzarot shennityabbemu kedivre bet shammay mamzerim hem ledivre bet hillel, shehare beissur eshet ach hem alehem, veeshet ach becharet uvene chayyave keretot mamzerim hem, af al pi chen lo nimneu bet hillel millissa nashim mibbet shammay, lefi shehayu modiim lahem otam habbaot min hatztzarot uforshim mehem:
Ellu al gav ellu. mashilim kelehem ellu leellu:
Hamechannes maot. kones meat meat peruta achar peruta leshiklo, veomer keshehitchil lechannes, hare ellu leshikli, ucheshebba lechashshev ma shekkinnes matza shehotiru al shiklo:
Bet shammay omrim motaran nedava. yippelu lashshofarot shebbammikdash, sheomdim lehakeriv bidmehen olot kayitz lammizbeach. uvet shammay letaamayhu deit lehu hekdesh betaut shemeh hekdesh:
Uvet hillel omrim motaran chullin. delo nitkavven ze lehakedish ella ad kede shiklo:
Sheavi mehen shikli, shavin shehammotar chullin. dahave keomer beferush im achnis yoter mishshekel avi mehem shekel vehammotar yehe chullin:
Ellu lechattati. veim kinnes maot veomer hare ellu lechattati, modu bet hallel shehammotar nedava:
Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta. kegon sheamar yeaser hanaat tashmishech alay. aval hanaat tashmishi asur alayich, lo mittasra, deha meshubad lah, dichtiv (Shemot 21) veonatah lo yigra:
Bet shammay omrim shete shabbatot. im hiddirah shete shabbatot, tamtin, shekken matzinu beyoledet nekeva shettemea shevuayim:

Uvet hillel omrim shabbat echat. shekken matzinu benidda shehi temea shiva, vegamrinan mide dishchiach dehaynu hakkaas shekkoes adam al ishto umaddirah, dehu mide dishchiach, minnidda shehu mide dishchiach, laafoke yoledet nekeva dela shechiach kulle hay. uvet shammay savre gamrinan mide dehu garam la, dehaynu neder haish shehu gorem lah lishhot, milleda sheal yado baa lah, laafoke nidda demimmela kaate lah. veyoter al shabbat achat levet hillel o shete shabbatot levet shammay, yotzi veyitten ketubba, vaafillu haya gammal sheonato lishloshim yom, o sappan sheonato leshishsha chodashim:
Hammappelet leor shemonim veechad. sheyyalda nekeva, velel shemonim veechad, shehayta reuya lemachar lehavi kapparatah, hippila:

Bet shammay potrim min hakkarban. milleda sheniyya, af al gav dilachar melot hu, hoil velayla hi velo yatza leshaa reuya lekarban, delayla mechussar zeman karban hu dichtiv (Vayikra 7) beyom tzavvoto, hilkach leinyan karban keyom melot dame:
Uvet hillel mechayyevin. hoil uleachar melot hu dehippila:
Sadin. shel pishtim:

Bet shammay potrin. lefi shedderech sadin shellovshin oto ballayla, vetzitzit sheyyesh bo petil techelet shehu tzemer tzavua bedam chillazon have kilayim besadin shel pishtim. uvayyom, shehu mitzvato, ate ase detzitzit vedache lo taase delo tilbash shaatnez, aval ballayla, sheen mitzvat tzitzit noheget ballayla, dichtiv ureitem oto, perat lichsut layla, i lavesh tzitzit bassadin, michayyav mishshum lo tilbash shaatnez. vesavre bet shammay gazrinan sadin betzitzit afillu bayyom delo michayyav, gezera mishshum kesut layla demichayyav mishshum kilayim. uvet hillel savre lo gazrinan:
Kalkalat hashshabbat. kalkala melea perot sheyyichadah leshabbat:
Bet hillel mechayyevin. bemaaser miyyad, afillu kodem hashshabbat, dechevan sheyyichadah leshabbat hukbea miyyad. uvet shammay savre deen hashshabbat kovaat ella leachar shettikkanes:

Shelosha asar davar. tzericha machashava. sheyyachashov aleha laachilat adam. shekkol hoochalim hammuttarim en tzerichim machashava, aval zo hoil vehi asura baachila tzericha machashava veachar kach tetamme. vedavka bakkefarim delekka rov am, aval bashshevakim enah tzericha machashava, shekkevan sheyyesh rov am habbaim lashshuk ikka tuva deachle nivlat of tahor. vehachi meforash beferek batra deokatzin:

Enah tzericha hechsher. ella metammea tumat ochalim kechol shear ochalim shennagu besheretz shehem naasim rishon lattuma. veen tzarich sheyyavou alehem mayim o shear mashkim velo shettigga besheretz. dehechsher bizraim hu dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechi yuttan mayim al zera vegomer, vedarshinan ma zeraim sheen sofan littame tuma chamura tzarich hechsher, af kol sheen sofo littame tuma chamura tzarich hechsher, yatza nivlat of tahor shessofah littame tuma chamura, shehi metammea adam uvegadim bevet habbelia, sheenah tzericha hechsher:
Umetammea tumat ochalin bechabbetza. dechabbetza mimmenna im naga beochalin tehorim nitmeu:

Vechazzayit bevet habbelia. adam sheachal kazzayit mimmenna nitma, venitmeu begadav keshettaggia levet habbelia. dichtiv (sham 17) vehannefesh asher tochal nevela uterefa vegomer, uvenivlat of tahor hakkatuv medabber, uchetiv tochal, veen achila pachot mikkazzayit:
Vetaun heerev shemesh. velo saggi bitvila lechoda:
Vechayyavim aleha al biat hammikdash. kishar kol hattumot. dichtiv betumat mikdash vekadashav (Vayikra 5) lechol tumato asher yitma bah, vedarshinan lerabbot bolea nivlat of tahor:
Vesorfin aleha et hatteruma. im naga nivlat of tahor batteruma, nisrefet, shekkesheenah bevet habbelia din rishon lattuma yesh lah umetammea et hatteruma bingia lihyot sheni:

Vehaochel evar min hachay mimmenna sofeg et haarbaim. vaafillu haya haevar pachot mikkazzayit. usetam matnitin delo kerabbi meir, deillu rabbi meir ha shaminan leh beshilhe gid hannashe deamar evar min hachay eno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad:

Shechitatah umelikatah metaharot et terefatah. umotziah mide nevela shello tetamme. lefi shehammelika matteret bifnim lakkohanim kederech shehashshechita matteret bachutz, ucheshem shettiharatto shechitato, kach tetaharennu melikato. ushechita dimtaheret et hatterefa mide nevela nafka lan mikkera, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechi yamut min habbehema vegomer‏ kol hannogea benivlatah yitma, yesh min habbehema shehi metammea, veyesh sheenah metammea, perat litrefa shennishchata, vehu haddin litrefat of:
Rabbi yehuda omer enan metaharot. delo yalfinan terefat of mitterefat behema:
Rabbi yose omer shechitatah metaheret velo melikatah. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Sear pekudda. leshon pikkadon, shehifkida habbaheret et hasear beor habbasar vehalcha lah, kegon shehayta bo baheret uvah sear lavan, halcha habbaheret vehinnicha lesear lavan bimkomo, veachar kach chazra habbaheret. akavya ben mahalalel metamme, kevan shennehefach sear lavan babbaheret, af al pi shezzo habbaheret shehi achshav enah otah shehafcha oto lesear lavan, tame:
Vachachamim metaharin. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) vehi hafcha sear lavan, shehafachattu hi velo shehafachattu chavertah:
Vedam hayyarok. akavya ben mahalalel metamme, desavar kekeren karkom haya, shehu min haddamim hattemeim, ella shellaka:
Haya mattir sear bechor baal mum shennashar. hatztzemer shennashar min habbechor baal mum, haya mattiro bahanaa lakkohen:

Vachachamim osrim. dei sharet leh tzemer hannosher mechayyim, ate leashhoye labbechor kede sheyyashir tzimro kol shaa, veatu bah lide takkala sheyyigzoz veyaavod bo, ufesule hammukdashim asire begizza vaavoda, dichtiv (Devarim 12) tizbach veachalta vasar, tizbach velo gizza vechulei. vaakavya share, demiggo dimhanneya shechita latztzemer hamechubbar bo lehattiro leachar shechita, mahane nammi latztzemer hattalush umunnach bachallon:
En mashkin. me sota:
Lo et haggiyyoret velo et hameshuchreret. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) leala velishvua betoch ammecha, perat leellu sheenan betoch ammam:

Dugma hishkuha. mippene shehayu dugmatah, kelomar gerim kemotah, lefichach hishkuha, velo min haddin. perush acher, dugma hishkuha, asu dugma vedimyon veheru lah keillu mashkim otah me hammarim, aval lo hishkuha:
Venidduhu. lefi shezzilzel bichvodan shel shemaya veavtalyon:

Sheen azara ninelet. bearve pesachim keshennichnasim lishchot pischehem. deamrinan nichnesa kat rishona ninalu daltot haazara vechulei, vechen bechat sheniyya vechen bechat shelishit, lo haya nimtza bechol haazara muchtar baanava uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel:
Sheppikpek. shezzilzel:
Soklim et arono. lav davka soklim, ella mannichim even bilvad lehekker shechaverav hayu bedelim mimmennu:
Mufne. sharuy belo ishsha:
Maamar. kiddushin. uvivama en tofsim ella middivre sofrim:
Ishto immo. desavre bet shammay baalat maamar hi chashuva kichnusa, ucheshennafla achotah leachar ken lo mittassera mishshum achot zekuka:
Vehalla. zo tetze af min hachalitza, mishshum achot ishsha:

Motzi ishto beget. delo allim maamar leshavveya kichnusa, vezo osartah mishshum achot zekuka. utzericha get mippene hammaamar dahave kiddushin bemiktzat velo pake kiddushin belo get. utzericha chalitza, dehoil velo have maamar kiddushin gemurin adayin zekuka hi utzericha chalitza lezikkatah. beresha yahev lah gittah vahadar chaletz lah:
I lo. oy lo al ishto shetztzarich lehotziah beget:
Vei lo al eshet achiv. shehu tzarich lachalotz lah:
Dam yoledet. sheshshahata shavua lezachar ushevuayim linkeva velo tavla:
Bet shammay omrim kerukkah uchememe ragleha. shemmetammeim lachim veen metammeim yeveshim, af damah metamme lach veeno metamme yavesh. veeno chashev kedam nidda shemmetamme lach veyavesh:
Uvet hillel omrim metamme lach veyavesh. kol zeman shello tavla kedam nidda hu chashev, veaf al pi shehu betoch yeme tohar:

Umodim beyoledet bezov. shetztzericha lispor shiva yamim nekiyyim kedin kol shear zavot, sheim lo safra velo tavla veraata dam betoch yeme tohar, shehu metamme lach veyavesh, dedam ziva hu chashev kol zeman shello safra velo tavla:
Mittammeot. im naga bahen sheretz nitmeu. veim temeim hen venagu hakkenafayim vehannotza beochalin tehorim, nitmeu, dachashive yad lehachenis ulehotzi, vechol shehu yad mittamme umetamme:
Velo mitztarfot. im haya ochel pachot mikkabbetza en hakkenafayim vehannotza mitztarfot lehashelimo lechabbetza letamme tumat ochalim, dela chashive shomer shemmitztaref, keditnan beresh okatzin:
Hannotza mitztarefet. dachashiv la shomer. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:
Hachartom. shehaof menakker bo:

Rashe agappayim verosh hazzanav. hannisharim mechubbarim lagguf achar shemmartu hannotza, regilim lechattecham ulehashlicham, delo chazu laachila, ella shebbaofot hamefuttamim mannichim otan veochlim otan im haof, vehayenu dekaamar shekken mannichim bappetumot. veen halacha kerabbi yose. vehane shelosha asar davar dachashiv bematnitin, bevava kammayta ikka tisha, dishchitatah umelikatah chada chashiv lehu, detarvayhu havu tohora litrefatah, vehakkenafayim, vehannotza, vehachartom, vehatztzipparnayim, hare shelosha asar davar:
Safek min hakkush safek min hachut kulei. devainan hazzaa vadday min haezov, mishshum deamrinan haamed tame al chezkato:
Mechavero mitztza alav. shemma mittamtzit me chattat shel keli echad halach al haacher:
Hazzaato fesula. dei mechavero mitztza alav en zo hazzaa min haezov:
Tovel umaale chedarko. velo amrinan mittoch shennidchak befiha latzet shemma yachzeru hammayim letoch hakkeli velo yishshaer baezov kashshiur:

Rabbi yehuda omer hazzaya rishona. dehazzaa rishona lo chayshinan, aval hazzaa sheniyya mittoch shennidchaku latzet vegam hizza mehem, nitmaatu veyoter vechayshinan behazzaa sheniyya shemma lo nisharu vaezov kashshiur. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shello yesappeg. shello yekannach mitztzidde hakkeli o mishshulav. dichtiv vetaval, velo mesappeg:
Hazzaato fesula. devainan kavvanat hazzaa vahare lo naaset machashavto:
Vaafillu hen mea. velo vainan hazzaa vifne atzmah lechol ish veish o lechol keli ucheli:
Mikretzet. chatichat batzek shehayta techilla vechibber lah chatichot acherot:

Kullan techilla. vehannogea baacherot kenogea barishon lattuma, dachashiva chibbur. vechen nammi hayta sheniyya, chashuvot chibbur, meachar deim parshu ishteyar behu tuma. aval hayta shelishit, deim parshu let behu tuma, deen shelishi ose revii batteruma, afillu ki lo parshu la chashivan chibbur, utehorot:
Kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim. mippene shechachmato shel shelomo hi velo beruach hakkodesh neemra:
Metamme et hayyadayim. desavre af kohelet beruach hakkodesh neemra, hilkach metamme et hayyadayim kishar kitve hakkodesh:
Sheasu mitzvatan. leachar shehizzu otam al hattame vetihar bahem, im natfu miggufo al gabbe adam o al gabbe kelim:
Hakketzach. zera shachor shekkorin lo 106 belaaz. uregilim latet oto ballechem, sheharagil bo eno ba lide keev lev:
Bet shammay metaharin. delo chashev ochel:
Uvet hillel metammein. kevan dirgilin latet oto boochalin chashev ochel:
Vechen lammaasrot. kemo shennechleku battuma ken nechleku lammaasrot, shehametammeo tumat ochalim mechayyevo bammaasrot:

Ellu hen hamemunnim. chamishsha asar minim shel pekidut uminnuy shel serara dechashiv bematnitin hayu tamid bammikdash. mihu hanach gavre dechashiv, lo bizman echad hayu, ella hachasidim vehakkesherim shebbechol dor vador hu mone. verabbotay pershu, al shem shehammemunnim harishonim shennitmannu al kach, kach haya shemam, lefichach nikreu habbaim acharehem al shemam:
Al hachotamot veal hasselatot. meforash lekamman bematnitin:
Al happeyasot. lehorot seder haggoral mi yizke baavoda zo umi bezo, kimforash bemassechet yoma:

Al hakkinnim. mechussere kappara kegon zav vezava veyoledet shemmeviim kinne chova, dehaynu torim uvene yona, notnin meotehen lashshofarot shebbammikdash, vehammemunnim al hashshofarot lokchim hammaot umeviin bahen hakkinnim. vehaya tzarich sheyyitmanne al ze chacham gadol uvaki, kidamrinan bemassechet avot (83 58) kinnim ufitche nidda hen hen gufe halachot:
Shehaya poteach devarim kulei. vehu mardechay bilshan sheala min haggola. venikra ken, shehaya bolel leshonot harebe:
Al chole meayim. lefi shehakkohanim holchim yechefim al haritzpa veochlin basar harebe veshotin mayim, hayu meehen mitkalkelin, utzerichin tamid lerofe lomar lahem ze hassam tov lammeayim:
Chofer shichin. haya memunne lachpor borot shichin umearot, kede sheyyihyu mayim metzuyin lishtot leole regalim:
Gevini karoz. kach shemo shel haish hammachriz bechol boker bevet hammikdash imdu kohanim laavodatchem. veshomim kolo miyyericho:
Al neilat shearim. linol hashshearim baerev ulefatchan babboker:

Al happakia. lehalekot hakkohanim vehaleviyyim shennimtzeu yeshenim al mishmerotehem, shehayu shomrim et hammikdash ballayla, kidamran bemassechet middot (81 42) mi shehayu motzim oto yashen hayu chovtim oto vesorfim et kesuto. uvayrushalmi meforash, happakia, happetilot shel menora veshel bet hashshoeva, kidamrinan beferek hechalil (sukka 85 43) mibbelae michnese kohanim umehemyanehem hayu mafkiim petilot:
Tziltzal. keli shir sheyyesh lo kol gadol, lashon tetzillena aznav, 178 balaz. ucheshehayu shomin kolo hayu haleviyyim matchilin beshir:
Al hashshir. lehatechil et hashshir, ucheshehaya mesayyem hayu kullan mesayyemin:
Bet garmu. shem mishpacha:
Al lechem happanim. shehaya asuy kemin teva perutza, vehayu ummanim baasiyyato uvaafiyyato lirdoto min hattannur shello yishshaver velaasoto shello yitappesh:

Beyit avtinas. shem mishpacha shehayu bekiim lefattem hakketoret, umakkirin beesev sheshshemo maale ashan, ucheshehayu mearvin oto im sammane hakketoret haya ashan hakketoret mittammer veole kemin makkel:
Al happarochot. laasot parochot chadashot keshehayu tzerichim:
Hammalbish. haya memunne lehalebish hakkohanim bishat avoda ulehafshitam achar avoda, velishmor bigde kehunna balleshachot haasuyot lechach:
Megulgalim. kevushim bemelach kede lemattekan:

Eno tzarich lenakkev. hechavit, veaf al pi shehammohal hayyotze mehen tzaf al gabban, eno machshiran lekabbel tuma, delo nicha leh beoto mohal hayyotze, vaanan bainan mashke denicha leh, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechi yuttan mayim al zera, ketiv yitten, vekarinan yuttan, ma yitten denicha leh af yuttan denicha leh:
Tzarich lenakkev. laasot maase legallot dateh delo nicha leh beoto mohal sheyyihye tzaf al gabbe hazzetim verotze hu sheyyetze derech nekev sheose bechavit:
Usetamuha shemarim shehi tehora. shekkevan shennikkevah, gale dateh delo nicha leh, veshuv en oto hammohal machshiran lekabbel tuma:
Af al pi shehu menattef tahor. af al pi shehashshemen notef mibbesaro leachar shettaval, tahor:

Kede sichat ever katan. im lo nishar min hashshemen al besaro ella kede sichat ever katan, tahor. veyoter mishshiur ze, tame, bishvil hashshemen shennitma behittamo venishar al besaro vetimmeahu. vehashshemen sheal besaro lo tahar bammikve, sheen lecha mashke mekabbel tohora bammikve ella hammayim bilvad al yede hashshaka:
Bet shammay omrim kede sichat ever katan tahor. tefe mehachi, tame:
Mashke tofeach umatpiach. sheyyesh lachluchit bakkaf ad shekkesheyyigga bechaf acheret yidbak bah lachluchit gam hi. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hatteruma me hayu osin bah. ma shennatnu letoch hakkuppot ma osin bahen:
Vechol karbenot hatztzibbur. laatoye ketoret:

Sefichim. tevua haola meeleha mimma shennashar bakkatzir. venotnim sachar lashshomrim shello yelakketum aniyyim bashsheviit, umeviim mehem omer befesach ushete hallechem baatzeret, sheenam baim ella min hechadash umin haaretz. venotnim secharam min hatteruma, detzorech karban kekarban dami:
Shomer chinnam. veaf al gav dekana otam min hahefker kesheshshamram chinnam veheviam vahare hen shello, rabbi yose savar dekarban yachid mishtanne lekarban tzibbur:

Af atta omer kulei. kelomar i atta mode sheenan bain ella mishshel tzibbur, veim shomram chinnam veheviam vezacha bahem nimtza sheenam bain mishshel tzibbur, desavre rabbanan karban yachid eno mishtanne leshel tzibbur. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ma ben shekalim lechattat. may shena shekalim dimchannes maot veomer hare ellu [leshikli] amre bet hillel dahave hammotar chullin, umay shena chattat demodu levet shammay dahave nedava:

Shekalim yesh lahen kitzba. dichtiv (Shemot 30) heashir lo yarbe vehaddal lo yamit, hilkach bevadday lo nitkavven ze ella lashshekel, vehammotar have hekdesh taut. aval chattat en lah kitzva, im yirtze yavi chattat bemaa kesef, veim yirtze yavi bedamim merubbim, hilkach nitpesu haddamim umotaran nedava:

Hayu shoklim darkonot. matbea shel malchut maday sheala immahen min haggola veshel zahav haya, vehu shave shene selaim, uregilim lissa velitten beoto matbea. uchemo shebbizman bayit rishon sh?haya matbea shellahen shekel hayu notnim machatzit hashshekel, gam atta shehaya matbea shellahen darkon hayu notnim chatzi darkon:

Chazru lishkol selaim. achar sheavra malchut maday nitbattel matbea darkon, chazru lihyot nosim venotnim bislaim, shehu matbea rishon shehaya yotze bizman bayit rishon, venatnu machatzit hashshekel kevattechilla:

Chazru lishkol tevain. chazar matbea hayyotze bahotzaa lihyot tevain, dehaynu machatzit hashshekel. bikkeshu litten chatzi oto hammatbea, dehaynu dinar echad. shehassela arbaa dinarin, velo kibbelu mehen, derashshaim lehosif ashshekel deorayta lefi shinnuy hammatbeot hayyotzot beoto zeman, velo lifchot mimmennu. alma lashshekalim nammi en lahem kitzva, delifamim hashshekalim gedolim velifamim ketannim, shehare lo hayu notnim leolam ella machatzit hashshekel hayyotze beotah shaa:

Af al pi chen yad kullan shava. kelomar akkatti lo dame shekalim lechattat, divchol zeman uzeman haya machatzit hashshekel shave lakkol, ze shokel kemo ze, kol echad machatzit hashshekel hayyotze bazzeman hahu. aval chattat leolam eno shave, shezze mevi besela veze mevi bishnayim o bishlosha selaim. vehachi maskinan detaamayhu devet hillel kerabbi shimon:

Mitztarfin ze im ze letamme. im en beechad mehen kabbetza, mitztarfin leshiur letamme kakkal shebbishnehem, sheim naga batteruma pesalah, kedin ochel shennitma bivlad hattuma shepposel et hatteruma veeno metammeah:
Kachatzi vetza vechulei. shebbelalan ze baze:
Sheni. hattaarovet hazze torat sheni alav ufosel et hatteruma:
Shelishi. ufosel et hakkodesh:
Rishon. veose maggao sheni. deha ikka shiura derishon baggeviyya litten tuma:
Chillekan ze sheni veze sheni. shehare bechol echad chatzi shiur derishon vachatzi shiur desheni, utenan leel rishon vesheni mitztarfin lakkal shebbahen:
Hashshokel al yede ani. bishvil ani:
Patur. kevan shennoten lahem bemattana:
Haachin hashuttafin shechayyavin bekalbon. achim shehem shuttafim shechilleku vechazru venishtattefu, sheaz hen chayyavin bekalbon kishar shene anashim sheshshaklu selaim:

Peturim mimmasar behema. kol habbehemot hannoladot lahem kol yeme shuttafutan enan tzerichin leasseran, dedarshinan beferek [batra] divchorot, yihye lecha, velo shel shuttafut, umokminan lehay kera bemaaser, veaf al gav devivchor ketiv:
Ucheshechayyavin bemasar behema. hayenu keshello chilleku, sheaz chayyavim bemaaser, kiddarshinan yachol afillu kanu bitfusat habbayit, talmud lomar yihye mikkol makom:
Peturim min hakkalbon. shemmamon avihem bechezkato omed, vahave keav sheshshokel al yede banav veal yede shechenav defatur:
Maa chesef. echad meesrim vearbaa besela, umishkalah shishsha asar seorot:
Chatzi maa. echad mishshemona vearbaim, umishkalah shemona seorot. vahalacha kachachamim:
Yenot shemanim uselatot. shehen reuyim limnachot velinsachim:
Veofot. torim uvene yona:

Rabbi elazar. garsinan, velo rabbi eliezer, vetaama derabbi elazar meforash bayrushalmi, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) lechol nidrehem ulechol nidvotehem asher yakrivu laAdonai‏ leola, kol ma shehem nodrim umitnaddevim middevarim asher yakrivu laAdonai, afillu yenot shemanim uselatot, yihye leola. yachol yakriv bidmehen olat haof, o im hikdish of yakrivennu ola, talmud lomar (sham) babbakar bakkesavim uvaizzim, ha eno makriv bechol ma shehitnaddev ella olat behema bilvad:
Haof ole im haggevina. sheen issuro ella middivre sofrim:
Lo ole. gezera shemma yaale gevina im besar behema beilpas roteach, dehu asur min hattora, dehaynu mevashshel:

Uvet hillel omrim en tormin. mi sheyyesh lo shemen shechayyav lehaferish mimmennu teruma vezetim shechayyav lehaferish mehen teruma, eno yachol litrom min hazzetim kefi hashshiur sheyyesh lo litrom min hazzetim umin hashshemen veliftor hashshemen bitrumat hazzetim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) kaddagan min haggoren, min haggamur al haggamur velo mimma sheeno gamur al haggamur:

Hazzorea arba ammot bakkerem. shehu hashshiur shetztzarich adam leharechik hazzera min hakkerem, vehazzorea betoch shiur ze kiddesh shura achat shel kerem, kedichtiv (Devarim 22) pen tikdash hamelea vegomer‏ utevuat hakkarem. usevira lehu levet shammay deshura achat keruya kerem. uvet hillel savre deen nikra kerem pachot mishshete shurot, vechi kaamar rachmana ditvuat hakkerem kaddesha, shete shurot shel kerem kaamar:
Hammeisa. kemach shennetanuhu al gabbe mayim rotchim umitbashshel umitabbe sham. bet shammay potrim mechalla. uvet hillel mechayyevim. ufesak halacha baze katavnu beresh challa:

Chardalit. kemo har dalit. zerem mayim habba middalyo shel har, kelomar miggova hahar. vaafillu en mittechillatan vead sofan ella arbaim sea matbilin bahen levet shammay. uvet hillel omrim en matbilin ad sheyyehu arbaim sea bemakom echad, sheen chardalit metaheret ella veashboren:

Keforesh min hakkaver. vetzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii. velo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel ella bearel nachri shemmal beyom arbaa asar, devet hillel savre gezera shemma yittamme leshana habbaa veyomar eshtakad lo taharti mikkol tuma ad arbaa asar vetavalti veachalti, hasheta nammi etbol veochal, velo yeda deeshtakad nachri haya velo mekabbel tuma, achshav yisrael hu umekabbel tuma. uvet shammay savre lo gazrinan. aval arel yisrael, divre hakkol tovel veochel pischo laerev:
Bedinar uveshave dinar. umishkal haddinar tishim vashesh seorot kesef:
Peruta. chatzi seora kesef:
Issar. mishkalo arbaa garine seora. venikra italki, al shem shehaya matbea hayyotze beitalya:

Beget yashan. kedimfaresh veazel, shekkatav legaresh et ishto veachar shennichtav hagget nityached immah. bet shammay savre, lo amrinan gezera shemma yomru gittah kodem livnah, im yashhe et hagget shana o shenatayim ben ketiva lintina veyihyu lah banim mimmennu betoch zeman ze veachar kach yegarshenna bo, uchesheyyiru zeman hagget kodem leledat habben yihyu sevurim shennatan lah mishsheat ketiva vehave pegam, sheyyomru min happenuya nolad. ufesak hahalacha, lo yegaresh adam ishto beget yashan. veim geresh vehalach habbaal limdina acheret, tinnase bo lechattechilla:

Velana immo vefundeki. veyesh sham ede yichud, veen sham ede bia. bet hillel savre, hen hen ede yichud hen hen ede bia, veen adam ose beilato beilat zenut kesheyyesh yecholet beyado livol shello leshem zenut, vahare kiddeshah bevia. uvet shammay savre, lo amrinan hen hen ede yichud hen hen ede bia ad sheyyiru shennivala:

Harvii neechol binzid hakkodesh. kelomar, veim yesh beotah teruma revii, kegon shennaaset al tohorat hakkodesh. vechen hachamishi neechol binzid hakkodesh dekatane lekamman, hachi kaamar, veim yesh beoto kodesh chamishi, kegon shennaasa al tohorat chattat shel efer para, deamrinan bigde ochle kodesh midras lechattat neechol binzid hakkodesh, muttar learev bo tavshil shel kodesh tahor:
Laggappa. geder avanim sedurot zo al zo belo tit:
Velakkelim. kele hammacharesha:

Bet shammay omrim eno shichcha. pelugetayhu devet shammay uvet hillel beomer shehechezik bo leholicho lair unetano betzad haggappa o betzad haggadish ushechacho sham, shebbet shammay omrim eno shichcha, shehare zacha bo, uvet hillel omrim shichcha. perush acher, bet shammay omrim eno shichcha, afillu beomer shello hechezik bo kelal lo have shichcha, dehoil vehinnicho etzel davar hamesuyyam atid lezachro. uvet hillel omrim shichcha, kol zeman shello hechezik bo. umodim bet hillel sheim hechezik bo veachar kach shechacho sheeno shichcha:
Motar shekalim chullin. hammechannes maot veomer hare ellu leshikli, ucheshebba lechashshev ma shekkinnes matza shehotiru, hammotar chullin. usetama kevet hillel:

Asirit haefa. shemmakrivin bedalle dallut. im hifrish maot venittotru, baot nedava, dechol motar chattat veasham hammaot nedava liknot bahen olot lekayitz hammizbeach, kemidrasho shel yehoyada hakkohen. vaasirit haefa bimkom chattat hi:
Motar ola ola. im hifrish maot liknot ola venittotru, yavi beoto hammotar ola acheret:

Motar happesach lishlamim. dichtiv (Devarim 16) vezavachta pesach laAdonai‏ elohecha tzon uvakar, vechi pesach min habbakar hu ba, ella motar pesach yehe ledavar habba mitztzon uvakar, vehayenu shelamim:

Motar nezirim. im gavu maot lekarbenot nezirim venittotru, yishmerum ad sheyyiknu mehem karbenot nezirim acherim. veim nazir echad hifrish maot lekarbenotav venittotru, hammotar lindava lekayitz hammizbeach:
Motar ani. im gavu maot liknot lo malbush venittotru, notnin hammotar leoto ani:
Motar shevuyim. im gavu tzedaka letzorech pidyon shevuyim venittotar mehem, yishmerum ad sheyyifdu bahem shevuyim acherim. aval im pershu leshavuy ze, zacha oto shavuy bammotar:
Motar hammetim lemetim. im gavu letzorech kevurat met setam, hammotar likvurat metim acherim. lammet, ze hammotar leyorshav, deachole achil hammet ziluteh legabbe yorshav:
Yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. missafka leh i machil hammet ziluteh legabbe yorshav i lo, hilkach yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu:

Bonim lo nefesh al kivro. peshita leh lerabbi natan delo machil, hilkach bonim lo matztzeva al kivro meoto motar shekkevar zacha bo hammet. vahalacha ketanna kamma. vehecha degavu letzarche kevurat hammet mippene shehayu sevurim shello haya lo veachar kach nimtza shehaya lo, lo amrinan bichhay gavna motar hammet leyorshav, kevan shehaggeviyya betaut hayta, vehachi muchach bayrushalmi. veod muchach bayrushalmi uvaggemara shellanu, dehecha deikka shiva tove hair o chaver ir shekkol iske tzibbur nechtachin al piv, venire beenav leshannot motar shevuyim o motar aniyyim o motar metim lema sheyyerae beenav, yachol leshannot ulehotzi bema sheyyerae beenav shehu tzorech shaa, veen mochin beyado. vechen morin tamid halacha lemaase:

En tomnin et hachammin miyyom tov leshabbat. desavre bet shammay en ofin ella im ken erev befat, veen mevashshelin ella im ken erev betavshil, veen tomnin ella im ken hayu lo chammin temunin meerev yom tov. uvet hillel savre deofin umevashshelin vetomnin al eruv shel tavshil bilvad:
En zokfin. menora shel chulyot shennitparku chulyoteha, en machazirin otan, dahave kevone, veyesh binyan bechelim. uvet hillel savre en binyan bechelim:
Geritzin. kikkarot avot:
Ella rekikin. kikkarot dakkot. desavre bet shammay en ofin pat merubba beyom tov mishshum tircha. uvet hillel omrim ofin pat merubba beyom tov, shebbizman shehappat merubba yafe hi neefet:
Vachori. issa gedola hanneefet al gabbe gechalim. veen halacha kerabban gamliel bechol ma shemmachmir kedivre bet shammay:
Kerem revai. shehu tzarich pidyon im ba leachlo chutz lirushalayim. vehu haddin lechol etz maachol:
En lo chomesh. delo katva tora bo shehabbealim mosifin et hachomesh kadderech shekkatva bemaaser sheni:
Veen lo viur. eno chayyav levaaro min habbayit beerev pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit keshemmevaer hammaasrot kedichtiv (Devarim 26) biarti hakkodesh min habbayit:

Yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo viur. bet hillel yalfe kodesh kodesh mimmaaser, ma maaser yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur, af kerem revai yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur. uvet shammay lo yalfe kodesh kodesh mimmaaser:
Yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot. dichchullin chashve leh:
Vehaaniyyim podin leatzman. happeret vehaollot shellaktu, veochlin otan bimkoman, umaalin haddamim lirushalayim:

Uvet hillel omrim kullo laggat. mishshum deyalfe mimmaaser, usevira lehu maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu, hilkach en laaniyyim chelek bo, vedorchim haollot im shear hayyayin, vehabbealim maalin hakkol lirushalayim:
Noten lo maot. kefi hannesachim shehu tzarich:
Ba lo etzel achiyya shehaya memunne. liknot nesachim, yenot shemanim uselatot, kede shello yehe tzarich kol mevi karban lechazzer achar nesachim haasuyin al tohorat hakkodesh:
Veim hotiru hotiru lahekdesh. velo amrinan shemma meotav shel yochanan hem shennitarvu bemaot sh?l nesachim:
Heid rabbi yehoshua. pidyon peter chamor shemmet. se shehifrisho lefidyon peter chamor umet:
Kechamesh selaim. shel pidyon habben shechayyav beacharayutan:

Kefidyon maaser sheni. deim avad eno chayyav beacharayuto, dehahu kesef chayyeveh rachmana leechol birushalayim, veha azal leh. vetaama derabbi eliezer, shekken matzinu shehekish hakkatuv peter chamor livchor adam, shenneemar (Shemot 34) ufeter chamor tifde vese vegomer‏ vechol bechor banecha tifde:
Vachachamim omrim. amar kera (Bamidbar 18) ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde, lifdiyya hekashtiv velo ledavar acher:
Gizbarim. hen shemmamon hahekdesh tachat yadam, vehen podim hoorchin vehacharamin vehahakdashot, vechol melechet hakkodesh bahem naasim:

Amarkalin. lemala min haggizbarim. unesi nesie hallevi (Bamidbar 3) metargeminan vaamarkalaya demamona. uleshon amarkol, amar al kol. uvearvi korim legadol emir. me hayu shiva amarkalin osin, shiva maftechot haazara beyadam, ratza echad mehen liftoach eno yachol ad sheyyikkansu kullam veyiftechu, vehaggizbarim nichnasim acharehem umotziim ma shehen tzerichin. veod maala haacheret lemala min haamarkalim hayta sham, shello nizkera bammishna umayte la battosefta, vehen shene ketilokin. venimtzeu sham chamesh madregot, kohen gadol, segan, ketilokin, amarkalin, gizbarim:
En osin serara pachot mishshenayim. dichtiv (Shemot 28) vehem yikkechu et hazzahav, miut rabbim shenayim:

Tormin et hallishka. mafrishin hashshekalim min hallishka shehayu hashshekalim munnachim sham, venotlin mehen beshalosh kuppot, kol kuppa mehen shel shalosh sein. verambam katav shemmemallein techilla shalosh kuppot gedolot shel shiva veesrim sein, umehen tormin leshalosh kuppot ketannot shel tisha sein. uvechinnam dachak lomar ken:
Vechatuv alehen 1‏ 2‏ 3. leda e zo nitrema techilla, umimmenna hayu konim karbenot tzibbur rishona, veachar kach min hashsheniyya, veachar kach min hashshelishit:

Yevanit katuv alehen. hayu regilim bivanit mishshum dichtiv (Bereshit 9) yaft elohim leyefet veyishkon beohole shem, yefefuto shel yefet yishkon beohole shem [megilla 9], veen lecha lashon yafa bivne yefet kemo lashon yevanit:

Pargod chafut. keshehammalbush aroch vechoflin oto millematta, otah hassafa hakkefula keruya pargod chafut. veen hattorem nichnas im hassafa kefula hahi bemalbusho, shello yachsheduhu shennatan letochah mimmeot hallishka:
Velo vitfillin velo vekamea. shello yomru hittir hattefer venatan betochan maot:
